 157"cmt">// @Tags Website CA
 158"cmt">// @Summary Download CA file
 159"cmt">// @Accept json
 160"cmt">// @Param request body request.WebsiteResourceReq true "request"
 161"cmt">// @Success 200
 162"cmt">// @Security ApiKeyAuth
 163"cmt">// @Security Timestamp
 164"cmt">// @Router  /websites/ca/download [post]
 165"cmt">// @x-panel-log {"bodyKeys":["id"],"paramKeys":[],"BeforeFunctions":[{"input_column":"id","input_value":"id","isList":false,"db":"website_cas","output_column":"name","output_value":"name"}],"formatZH":"下载 CA 证书文件 [name]","formatEN":"download ca file [name]"}
 166func (b *BaseApi) DownloadCAFile(c *gin.Context) {
 167	var req request.WebsiteResourceReq
 168	if err := helper.CheckBindAndValidate(&req, c); err != nil {
 169		return
 170	}
 171	file, err := websiteCAService.DownloadFile(req.ID)
 172	if err != nil {
 173		helper.InternalServer(c, err)
 174		return
 175	}
 176	defer file.Close()
 177	info, err := file.Stat()
 178	if err != nil {
 179		helper.InternalServer(c, err)
 180		return
 181	}
 182	c.Header("Content-Length", strconv.FormatInt(info.Size(), 10))
 183	c.Header("Content-Disposition", "attachment; filename*=utf-8''"+url.PathEscape(info.Name()))
 184	http.ServeContent(c.Writer, c.Request, info.Name(), info.ModTime(), file)
 185}

 262"cmt">// @Tags Website SSL
 263"cmt">// @Summary Upload SSL file
 264"cmt">// @Accept multipart/form-data
 265"cmt">// @Param type formData string true "type"
 266"cmt">// @Param description formData string false "description"
 267"cmt">// @Param sslID formData string false "sslID"
 268"cmt">// @Param privateKeyFile formData file true "privateKeyFile"
 269"cmt">// @Param certificateFile formData file true "certificateFile"
 270"cmt">// @Success 200
 271"cmt">// @Security ApiKeyAuth
 272"cmt">// @Security Timestamp
 273"cmt">// @Router /websites/ssl/upload/file [post]
 274"cmt">// @x-panel-log {"bodyKeys":["type"],"paramKeys":[],"BeforeFunctions":[],"formatZH":"上传 ssl 文件 [type]","formatEN":"Upload ssl file [type]"}
 275func (b *BaseApi) UploadSSLFile(c *gin.Context) {
 276	var req request.WebsiteSSLFileUpload
 277
 278	req.Description = c.PostForm("description")
 279	req.Nodes = c.PostForm("nodes")
 280	req.PushNode, _ = strconv.ParseBool(c.PostForm("pushNode"))
 281	sslID := c.PostForm("sslID")
 282	if sslID != "" {
 283		req.SSLID, _ = strconv.ParseUint(sslID, 10, 64)
 284	}
 285
 286	privateKeyFile, err := c.FormFile("privateKeyFile")
 287	if err != nil {
 288		helper.InternalServer(c, err)
 289		return
 290	}
 291
 292	certificateFile, err := c.FormFile("certificateFile")
 293	if err != nil {
 294		helper.InternalServer(c, err)
 295		return
 296	}
 297
 298	privateKeyContent, err := readUploadedFile(privateKeyFile)
 299	if err != nil {
 300		helper.InternalServer(c, err)
 301		return
 302	}
 303
 304	certificateContent, err := readUploadedFile(certificateFile)
 305	if err != nil {
 306		helper.InternalServer(c, err)
 307		return
 308	}
 309
 310	uploadReq := request.WebsiteSSLUpload{
 311		Type:        "paste",
 312		PrivateKey:  string(privateKeyContent),
 313		Certificate: string(certificateContent),
 314		Description: req.Description,
 315		SSLID:       uint(req.SSLID),
 316		PushNode:    req.PushNode,
 317		Nodes:       req.Nodes,
 318	}
 319
 320	if err := websiteSSLService.Upload(uploadReq); err != nil {
 321		helper.InternalServer(c, err)
 322		return
 323	}
 324
 325	helper.Success(c)
 326}
 327
 328func readUploadedFile(fileHeader *multipart.FileHeader) ([]byte, error) {
 329	file, err := fileHeader.Open()
 330	if err != nil {
 331		return nil, err
 332	}
 333	defer file.Close()
 334
 335	return io.ReadAll(file)
 336}

 339"cmt">// @Summary Download SSL  file
 340"cmt">// @Accept json
 341"cmt">// @Param request body request.WebsiteResourceReq true "request"
 342"cmt">// @Success 200
 343"cmt">// @Security ApiKeyAuth
 344"cmt">// @Security Timestamp
 345"cmt">// @Router  /websites/ssl/download [post]
 346"cmt">// @x-panel-log {"bodyKeys":["id"],"paramKeys":[],"BeforeFunctions":[{"input_column":"id","input_value":"id","isList":false,"db":"website_ssls","output_column":"primary_domain","output_value":"domain"}],"formatZH":"下载证书文件 [domain]","formatEN":"download ssl file [domain]"}
 347func (b *BaseApi) DownloadWebsiteSSL(c *gin.Context) {
 348	var req request.WebsiteResourceReq
 349	if err := helper.CheckBindAndValidate(&req, c); err != nil {
 350		return
 351	}
 352	file, err := websiteSSLService.DownloadFile(req.ID)
 353	if err != nil {
 354		helper.InternalServer(c, err)
 355		return
 356	}
 357	defer file.Close()
 358	info, err := file.Stat()
 359	if err != nil {
 360		helper.InternalServer(c, err)
 361		return
 362	}
 363	c.Header("Content-Length", strconv.FormatInt(info.Size(), 10))
 364	c.Header("Content-Disposition", "attachment; filename*=utf-8''"+url.PathEscape(info.Name()))
 365	http.ServeContent(c.Writer, c.Request, info.Name(), info.ModTime(), file)
 366}

 136	fileHeader, err := c.FormFile("file")
 137	if err != nil {
 138		helper.BadRequest(c, err)
 139		return
 140	}
 141	file, err := fileHeader.Open()
 142	if err != nil {
 143		helper.InternalServer(c, err)
 144		return
 145	}
 146	defer file.Close()
 147	content, err := io.ReadAll(file)
 148	if err != nil {
 149		helper.InternalServer(c, err)
 150		return
 151	}
 152	filePath, variables, err := websiteTemplateService.SaveUploadZip(fileHeader.Filename, content)
 153	if err != nil {
 154		helper.InternalServer(c, err)
 155		return
 156	}
 157	helper.SuccessWithData(c, gin.H{"filePath": filePath, "variables": variables})
 158}

 100	}

  26func (a AgentService) BindWebsite(req dto.AgentWebsiteBindReq) error {
  27	agent, err := agentRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.AgentID))
  28	if err != nil {
  29		return err
  30	}
  31	if agent.WebsiteID != 0 {
  32		return buserr.New("ErrAgentWebsiteBound")
  33	}
  34
  35	website, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.WebsiteID))
  36	if err != nil {
  37		return err
  38	}
  39	if !isBindableAgentWebsiteType(website.Type) {
  40		return buserr.New("ErrAgentWebsiteTypeUnsupported")
  41	}
  42
  43	boundAgent, err := agentRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByWebsiteID(req.WebsiteID))
  44	if err == nil && boundAgent.ID > 0 {
  45		return buserr.New("ErrAgentWebsiteInUse")
  46	}
  47	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {
  48		return err
  49	}
  50
  51	agent.WebsiteID = req.WebsiteID
  52	if err := agentRepo.Save(agent); err != nil {
  53		return err
  54	}
  55	return ensureOpenclawWebsiteAllowedOrigin(agent, &website)
  56}
  57
  58func (a AgentService) UnbindWebsite(req dto.AgentIDReq) error {
  59	agent, err := agentRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.AgentID))
  60	if err != nil {
  61		return err
  62	}
  63	if agent.WebsiteID == 0 {
  64		return nil
  65	}
  66
  67	website, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(agent.WebsiteID))
  68	if err != nil {
  69		return err
  70	}
  71	if website.Type == constant.Deployment {
  72		return buserr.New("ErrAgentWebsiteUnbindUnsupported")
  73	}
  74
  75	agent.WebsiteID = 0
  76	return agentRepo.Save(agent)
  77}

  79func hydrateAgentWebsiteItems(items []dto.AgentItem) error {
  80	explicitWebsiteMap, err := loadAgentWebsiteMapByID(items)
  81	if err != nil {
  82		return err
  83	}
  84	websiteDomainMap, err := loadAgentWebsiteDomainMapByWebsiteID(items)
  85	if err != nil {
  86		return err
  87	}
  88	fillAgentWebsiteItems(items, explicitWebsiteMap, websiteDomainMap)
  89	return nil
  90}
  91
  92func loadAgentWebsiteMapByID(items []dto.AgentItem) (map[uint]model.Website, error) {
  93	websiteIDs := make([]uint, 0, len(items))
  94	for _, item := range items {
  95		if item.WebsiteID > 0 {
  96			websiteIDs = append(websiteIDs, item.WebsiteID)
  97		}
  98	}
  99	if len(websiteIDs) == 0 {
 100		return map[uint]model.Website{}, nil
 101	}
 102	websites, err := websiteRepo.GetBy(repo.WithByIDs(uniqueUintList(websiteIDs)))
 103	if err != nil {
 104		return nil, err
 105	}
 106	websiteMap := make(map[uint]model.Website, len(websites))
 107	for _, website := range websites {
 108		websiteMap[website.ID] = website
 109	}
 110	return websiteMap, nil
 111}
 112
 113func loadAgentWebsiteDomainMapByWebsiteID(items []dto.AgentItem) (map[uint][]model.WebsiteDomain, error) {
 114	websiteIDs := make([]uint, 0, len(items))
 115	for _, item := range items {
 116		if item.WebsiteID > 0 {
 117			websiteIDs = append(websiteIDs, item.WebsiteID)
 118		}
 119	}
 120	if len(websiteIDs) == 0 {
 121		return map[uint][]model.WebsiteDomain{}, nil
 122	}
 123	websiteDomains, err := websiteDomainRepo.GetBy(websiteDomainRepo.WithWebsiteIds(uniqueUintList(websiteIDs)), repo.WithOrderAsc("id"))
 124	if err != nil {
 125		return nil, err
 126	}
 127	websiteDomainMap := make(map[uint][]model.WebsiteDomain, len(websiteDomains))
 128	for _, websiteDomain := range websiteDomains {
 129		websiteDomainMap[websiteDomain.WebsiteID] = append(websiteDomainMap[websiteDomain.WebsiteID], websiteDomain)
 130	}
 131	return websiteDomainMap, nil
 132}

 134func loadAgentWebsiteResourceName(website model.Website) (string, error) {
 135	websiteDomains, err := websiteDomainRepo.GetBy(websiteDomainRepo.WithWebsiteId(website.ID), repo.WithOrderAsc("id"))
 136	if err != nil {
 137		return "", err
 138	}
 139	if len(websiteDomains) > 0 {
 140		return websiteDomains[0].Domain, nil
 141	}
 142	if website.PrimaryDomain != "" {
 143		return website.PrimaryDomain, nil
 144	}
 145	return fmt.Sprintf("%d", website.ID), nil
 146}
 147
 148func fillAgentWebsiteItems(items []dto.AgentItem, explicitWebsiteMap map[uint]model.Website, websiteDomainMap map[uint][]model.WebsiteDomain) {
 149	for index := range items {
 150		if items[index].WebsiteID == 0 {
 151			continue
 152		}
 153		website, ok := explicitWebsiteMap[items[index].WebsiteID]
 154		if !ok {
 155			items[index].WebsiteID = 0
 156			items[index].WebsitePrimaryDomain = ""
 157			items[index].WebsiteType = ""
 158			items[index].WebsiteProtocol = ""
 159			continue
 160		}
 161		items[index].WebsiteType = website.Type
 162		items[index].WebsiteProtocol = website.Protocol
 163		websiteDomains := websiteDomainMap[items[index].WebsiteID]
 164		if len(websiteDomains) == 0 {
 165			items[index].WebsitePrimaryDomain = ""
 166			continue
 167		}
 168		items[index].WebsitePrimaryDomain = websiteDomains[0].Domain
 169	}
 170}

 172func UniqueDeploymentWebsiteMapByAppInstall(websites []model.Website) map[uint]model.Website {
 173	websiteMap := make(map[uint]model.Website)
 174	duplicateAppInstallIDs := make(map[uint]struct{})
 175	for _, website := range websites {
 176		if website.AppInstallID == 0 {
 177			continue
 178		}
 179		if _, duplicated := duplicateAppInstallIDs[website.AppInstallID]; duplicated {
 180			continue
 181		}
 182		if _, exists := websiteMap[website.AppInstallID]; exists {
 183			delete(websiteMap, website.AppInstallID)
 184			duplicateAppInstallIDs[website.AppInstallID] = struct{}{}
 185			continue
 186		}
 187		websiteMap[website.AppInstallID] = website
 188	}
 189	return websiteMap
 190}
 191
 192func uniqueUintList(items []uint) []uint {
 193	itemMap := make(map[uint]struct{}, len(items))
 194	uniq := make([]uint, 0, len(items))
 195	for _, item := range items {
 196		if item == 0 {
 197			continue
 198		}
 199		if _, exists := itemMap[item]; exists {
 200			continue
 201		}
 202		itemMap[item] = struct{}{}
 203		uniq = append(uniq, item)
 204	}
 205	return uniq
 206}

 208func isBindableAgentWebsiteType(websiteType string) bool {
 209	return websiteType == constant.Proxy || websiteType == constant.Static
 210}

 212func bindDeploymentWebsiteToAgentByAppInstall(website *model.Website) error {
 213	if website.ID == 0 || website.Type != constant.Deployment || website.AppInstallID == 0 {
 214		return nil
 215	}
 216
 217	appInstall, err := appInstallRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(website.AppInstallID))
 218	if err != nil {
 219		return err
 220	}
 221	if appInstall.App.Key != constant.AppOpenclaw && appInstall.App.Key != constant.AppCopaw && appInstall.App.Key != constant.AppHermesAgent {
 222		return nil
 223	}
 224
 225	agent, err := agentRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByAppInstallID(website.AppInstallID))
 226	if errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {
 227		return nil
 228	}
 229	if err != nil {
 230		return err
 231	}
 232	if agent.WebsiteID != 0 {
 233		return nil
 234	}
 235
 236	agent.WebsiteID = website.ID
 237	if err := agentRepo.Save(agent); err != nil {
 238		return err
 239	}
 240	return ensureOpenclawWebsiteAllowedOrigin(agent, website)
 241}
 242
 243func ensureOpenclawWebsiteAllowedOrigin(agent *model.Agent, website *model.Website) error {
 244	if agent == nil || website == nil || agent.AgentType != constant.AppOpenclaw {
 245		return nil
 246	}
 247
 248	origins, err := buildWebsiteAllowedOrigins(website)
 249	if err != nil {
 250		return err
 251	}
 252	if len(origins) == 0 {
 253		return nil
 254	}
 255
 256	install, err := appInstallRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(agent.AppInstallID))
 257	if err != nil {
 258		return err
 259	}
 260	conf, err := readOpenclawConfig(agent.ConfigPath)
 261	if err != nil {
 262		return err
 263	}
 264
 265	allowedOrigins := extractSecurityConfig(conf).AllowedOrigins
 266	allowedOrigins, err = normalizeAllowedOrigins(append(allowedOrigins, origins...))
 267	if err != nil {
 268		return err
 269	}
 270	setSecurityConfig(conf, dto.AgentSecurityConfig{AllowedOrigins: allowedOrigins})
 271	if err := writeOpenclawConfigRaw(agent.ConfigPath, conf); err != nil {
 272		return err
 273	}
 274	if err := syncOpenclawAllowedOriginEnv(&install, allowedOrigins); err != nil {
 275		return err
 276	}
 277	return appInstallRepo.Save(context.Background(), &install)
 278}
 279
 280func buildWebsiteAllowedOrigins(website *model.Website) ([]string, error) {
 281	websiteDomains, err := websiteDomainRepo.GetBy(websiteDomainRepo.WithWebsiteId(website.ID), repo.WithOrderAsc("id"))
 282	if err != nil {
 283		return nil, err
 284	}
 285	if len(websiteDomains) == 0 {
 286		return nil, nil
 287	}
 288	defaultHTTPSPort := 443
 289	if strings.EqualFold(website.Protocol, "https") {
 290		nginxInstall, err := getAppInstallByKey(constant.AppOpenresty)
 291		if err == nil && nginxInstall.HttpsPort > 0 {
 292			defaultHTTPSPort = nginxInstall.HttpsPort
 293		}
 294	}
 295	return buildWebsiteAllowedOriginsFromDomains(website, websiteDomains, defaultHTTPSPort)
 296}
 297
 298func buildWebsiteAllowedOriginsFromDomains(website *model.Website, websiteDomains []model.WebsiteDomain, defaultHTTPSPort int) ([]string, error) {
 299	if len(websiteDomains) == 0 {
 300		return nil, nil
 301	}
 302	sort.Slice(websiteDomains, func(i, j int) bool {
 303		return websiteDomains[i].ID < websiteDomains[j].ID
 304	})
 305	origins := make([]string, 0, len(websiteDomains))
 306	for _, websiteDomain := range websiteDomains {
 307		origin, err := buildWebsiteDomainOrigin(website.Protocol, websiteDomain, defaultHTTPSPort)
 308		if err != nil {
 309			return nil, err
 310		}
 311		origins = append(origins, origin)
 312	}
 313	return origins, nil
 314}
 315
 316func buildWebsiteDomainOrigin(protocol string, websiteDomain model.WebsiteDomain, defaultHTTPSPort int) (string, error) {
 317	origin := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(protocol)) + ":">//" + formatWebsiteDomainHost(websiteDomain.Domain)
 318	switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(protocol)) {
 319	case "http":
 320		if websiteDomain.Port > 0 && websiteDomain.Port != 80 {
 321			origin = fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", origin, websiteDomain.Port)
 322		}
 323	case "https":
 324		port := websiteDomain.Port
 325		if !websiteDomain.SSL {
 326			port = defaultHTTPSPort
 327		}
 328		if port > 0 && port != 443 {
 329			origin = fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", origin, port)
 330		}
 331	}
 332	return normalizeAllowedOrigin(origin)
 333}
 334
 335func formatWebsiteDomainHost(domain string) string {
 336	host := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(domain), "[]")
 337	if ip := net.ParseIP(host); ip != nil && strings.Contains(host, ":") {
 338		return "[" + host + "]"
 339	}
 340	return host
 341}

  36func (u *BackupService) WebsiteBackup(req dto.CommonBackup) error {
  37	website, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(websiteRepo.WithAlias(req.DetailName))
  38	if err != nil {
  39		return err
  40	}
  41
  42	timeNow := time.Now().Format(constant.DateTimeSlimLayout)
  43	itemDir := fmt.Sprintf("website/%s", website.Alias)
  44	backupDir := path.Join(global.Dir.LocalBackupDir, itemDir)
  45	fileName := fmt.Sprintf("%s_%s.tar.gz", website.Alias, timeNow+common.RandStrAndNum(5))
  46
  47	record := &model.BackupRecord{
  48		Type:              "website",
  49		Name:              website.Alias,
  50		DetailName:        website.Alias,
  51		SourceAccountIDs:  "1",
  52		DownloadAccountID: 1,
  53		FileDir:           itemDir,
  54		FileName:          fileName,
  55		TaskID:            req.TaskID,
  56		Status:            constant.StatusWaiting,
  57		Description:       req.Description,
  58	}
  59	if err = backupRepo.CreateRecord(record); err != nil {
  60		global.LOG.Errorf("save backup record failed, err: %v", err)
  61		return err
  62	}
  63	if err = handleWebsiteBackup(&website, nil, record.ID, backupDir, fileName, "", req.Secret, req.TaskID); err != nil {
  64		markBackupFailed(record.ID, err)
  65		global.LOG.Errorf("backup website %s failed, err: %v", website.Alias, err)
  66		return err
  67	}
  68	return nil
  69}
  70
  71func (u *BackupService) WebsiteRecover(req dto.CommonRecover) error {
  72	website, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(websiteRepo.WithAlias(req.DetailName))
  73	if err != nil {
  74		return err
  75	}
  76	if err := handleWebsiteRecover(&website, nil, req.File, false, req.Secret, req.TaskID); err != nil {
  77		global.LOG.Errorf("recover website %s failed, err: %v", website.Alias, err)
  78	}
  79	return nil
  80}
  81
  82func handleWebsiteRecover(website *model.Website, parentTask *task.Task, recoverFile string, isRollback bool, secret, taskID string) error {
  83	var (
  84		err          error
  85		recoverTask  *task.Task
  86		isOk         = false
  87		rollbackFile string
  88	)
  89	recoverTask = parentTask
  90	if parentTask == nil {
  91		recoverTask, err = task.NewTaskWithOps(website.PrimaryDomain, task.TaskRecover, task.TaskScopeBackup, taskID, website.ID)
  92		if err != nil {
  93			return err
  94		}
  95	}
  96	recoverWebsite := func(t *task.Task) error {
  97		if !isRollback {
  98			rollbackFile = path.Join(global.Dir.TmpDir, fmt.Sprintf("website/%s_%s.tar.gz", website.Alias, time.Now().Format(constant.DateTimeSlimLayout)))
  99			if err := handleWebsiteBackup(website, recoverTask, 0, path.Dir(rollbackFile), path.Base(rollbackFile), "", "", taskID); err != nil {
 100				return fmt.Errorf("backup website %s for rollback before recover failed, err: %v", website.Alias, err)
 101			}
 102		}
 103
 104		fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
 105		tmpPath := strings.ReplaceAll(recoverFile, ".tar.gz", "")
 106		t.Log(i18n.GetWithName("DeCompressFile", recoverFile))
 107		if err = fileOp.TarGzExtractPro(recoverFile, path.Dir(recoverFile), secret); err != nil {
 108			return err
 109		}
 110		defer func() {
 111			_ = os.RemoveAll(tmpPath)
 112		}()
 113
 114		var oldWebsite model.Website
 115		websiteJson, err := os.ReadFile(tmpPath + "/website.json")
 116		if err != nil {
 117			return err
 118		}
 119		if err = json.Unmarshal(websiteJson, &oldWebsite); err != nil {
 120			return fmt.Errorf("unmarshal app.json failed, err: %v", err)
 121		}
 122
 123		if err = checkValidOfWebsite(&oldWebsite, website); err != nil {
 124			t.Log(i18n.GetWithName("ErrCheckValid", err.Error()))
 125			return err
 126		}
 127
 128		temPathWithName := tmpPath + "/" + website.Alias
 129		if !fileOp.Stat(tmpPath+"/website.json") || !fileOp.Stat(temPathWithName+".conf") || !fileOp.Stat(temPathWithName+".web.tar.gz") {
 130			return buserr.WithDetail("ErrBackupExist", ".conf or .web.tar.gz", nil)
 131		}
 132		if website.Type == constant.Deployment {
 133			if !fileOp.Stat(temPathWithName + ".app.tar.gz") {
 134				return buserr.WithDetail("ErrBackupExist", ".app.tar.gz", nil)
 135			}
 136		}
 137
 138		nginxInfo, err := appInstallRepo.LoadBaseInfo(constant.AppOpenresty, "")
 139		if err != nil {
 140			return err
 141		}
 142		if err = fileOp.CopyFile(fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s.conf", tmpPath, website.Alias), GetConfDir(*website)); err != nil {
 143			return err
 144		}
 145
 146		switch website.Type {
 147		case constant.Deployment:
 148			app, err := appInstallRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(website.AppInstallID))
 149			if err != nil {
 150				return err
 151			}
 152			taskName := task.GetTaskName(app.Name, task.TaskRecover, task.TaskScopeApp)
 153			t.LogStart(taskName)
 154			if err := handleAppRecover(&app, recoverTask, fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s.app.tar.gz", tmpPath, website.Alias), true, "", ""); err != nil {
 155				return err
 156			}
 157			t.LogSuccess(taskName)
 158			if _, err = compose.DownAndUp(fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s/%s/docker-compose.yml", global.Dir.AppInstallDir, app.App.Key, app.Name)); err != nil {
 159				return err
 160			}
 161		case constant.Runtime:
 162			runtime, err := runtimeRepo.GetFirst(context.Background(), repo.WithByID(website.RuntimeID))
 163			if err != nil {
 164				return err
 165			}
 166			taskName := task.GetTaskName(runtime.Name, task.TaskRecover, task.TaskScopeRuntime)
 167			t.LogStart(taskName)
 168			if err := handleRuntimeRecover(runtime, fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s.runtime.tar.gz", tmpPath, website.Alias), true, ""); err != nil {
 169				return err
 170			}
 171			t.LogSuccess(taskName)
 172			if oldWebsite.DbID > 0 {
 173				if err := recoverWebsiteDatabase(t, oldWebsite.DbID, oldWebsite.DbType, tmpPath, website.Alias); err != nil {
 174					return err
 175				}
 176			}
 177		case constant.Static:
 178			if oldWebsite.DbID > 0 {
 179				if err := recoverWebsiteDatabase(t, oldWebsite.DbID, oldWebsite.DbType, tmpPath, website.Alias); err != nil {
 180					return err
 181				}
 182			}
 183		}
 184		taskName := i18n.GetMsgByKey("TaskRecover") + i18n.GetMsgByKey("websiteDir")
 185		t.Log(taskName)
 186		if err = fileOp.TarGzExtractPro(fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s.web.tar.gz", tmpPath, website.Alias), GetOpenrestyDir(SitesRootDir), ""); err != nil {
 187			return err
 188		}
 189		if err := cmd.NewCommandMgr().Run("docker", "exec", "-i", nginxInfo.ContainerName, "nginx", "-s", "reload"); err != nil {
 190			return err
 191		}
 192		oldWebsite.ID = website.ID
 193		if err := websiteRepo.SaveWithoutCtx(&oldWebsite); err != nil {
 194			return err
 195		}
 196		isOk = true
 197		return nil
 198	}
 199
 200	if parentTask != nil {
 201		return recoverWebsite(parentTask)
 202	}
 203
 204	rollBackWebsite := func(t *task.Task) {
 205		if isRollback {
 206			return
 207		}
 208		if !isOk {
 209			t.Log(i18n.GetMsgByKey("RecoverFailedStartRollBack"))
 210			if err := handleWebsiteRecover(website, t, rollbackFile, true, "", ""); err != nil {
 211				t.LogFailedWithErr(i18n.GetMsgByKey("Rollback"), err)
 212				return
 213			}
 214			t.LogSuccess(i18n.GetMsgByKey("Rollback"))
 215			_ = os.RemoveAll(rollbackFile)
 216		} else {
 217			_ = os.RemoveAll(rollbackFile)
 218		}
 219	}
 220	recoverTask.AddSubTask(task.GetTaskName(website.PrimaryDomain, task.TaskRecover, task.TaskScopeBackup), recoverWebsite, rollBackWebsite)
 221	go func() {
 222		_ = recoverTask.Execute()
 223	}()
 224	return nil
 225}
 226
 227func handleWebsiteBackup(website *model.Website, parentTask *task.Task, recordID uint, backupDir, fileName, excludes, secret, taskID string) error {
 228	var (
 229		err        error
 230		backupTask *task.Task
 231	)
 232	backupTask = parentTask
 233	if parentTask == nil {
 234		backupTask, err = task.NewTaskWithOps(website.Alias, task.TaskBackup, task.TaskScopeBackup, taskID, website.ID)
 235		if err != nil {
 236			return err
 237		}
 238	}
 239	itemHandler := func() error { return doWebsiteBackup(website, backupTask, backupDir, fileName, excludes, secret) }
 240	if parentTask != nil {
 241		return itemHandler()
 242	}
 243	backupTask.AddSubTaskWithOps(task.GetTaskName(website.Alias, task.TaskBackup, task.TaskScopeBackup), func(t *task.Task) error { return itemHandler() }, nil, 3, time.Hour)
 244	go func() {
 245		if err := backupTask.Execute(); err != nil {
 246			markBackupFailed(recordID, err)
 247			return
 248		}
 249		backupRepo.UpdateRecordByMap(recordID, map[string]interface{}{"status": constant.StatusSuccess})
 250	}()
 251	return nil
 252}
 253
 254func doWebsiteBackup(website *model.Website, parentTask *task.Task, backupDir, fileName, excludes, secret string) error {
 255	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
 256	tmpDir := fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s", backupDir, strings.ReplaceAll(fileName, ".tar.gz", ""))
 257	if !fileOp.Stat(tmpDir) {
 258		if err := os.MkdirAll(tmpDir, os.ModePerm); err != nil {
 259			return fmt.Errorf("mkdir %s failed, err: %v", backupDir, err)
 260		}
 261	}
 262	defer func() {
 263		_ = os.RemoveAll(tmpDir)
 264	}()
 265
 266	remarkInfo, _ := json.Marshal(website)
 267	if err := fileOp.SaveFile(tmpDir+"/website.json", string(remarkInfo), fs.ModePerm); err != nil {
 268		return err
 269	}
 270	nginxConfFile := GetWebsiteConfigPath(*website)
 271	if err := fileOp.CopyFile(nginxConfFile, tmpDir); err != nil {
 272		return err
 273	}
 274	parentTask.Log(i18n.GetMsgByKey("BackupNginxConfig"))
 275
 276	switch website.Type {
 277	case constant.Deployment:
 278		app, err := appInstallRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(website.AppInstallID))
 279		if err != nil {
 280			return err
 281		}
 282		parentTask.LogStart(task.GetTaskName(app.Name, task.TaskBackup, task.TaskScopeApp))
 283		if err = handleAppBackup(&app, parentTask, 0, tmpDir, fmt.Sprintf("%s.app.tar.gz", website.Alias), excludes, "", ""); err != nil {
 284			return err
 285		}
 286		parentTask.LogSuccess(task.GetTaskName(app.Name, task.TaskBackup, task.TaskScopeApp))
 287	case constant.Runtime:
 288		runtime, err := runtimeRepo.GetFirst(context.Background(), repo.WithByID(website.RuntimeID))
 289		if err != nil {
 290			return err
 291		}
 292		parentTask.LogStart(task.GetTaskName(runtime.Name, task.TaskBackup, task.TaskScopeRuntime))
 293		if err = handleRuntimeBackup(runtime, tmpDir, fmt.Sprintf("%s.runtime.tar.gz", website.Alias), excludes, ""); err != nil {
 294			return err
 295		}
 296		parentTask.LogSuccess(task.GetTaskName(runtime.Name, task.TaskBackup, task.TaskScopeRuntime))
 297		if website.DbID > 0 {
 298			if err = backupDatabaseWithTask(parentTask, website.DbType, tmpDir, website.Alias, website.DbID); err != nil {
 299				return err
 300			}
 301		}
 302	case constant.Static:
 303		if website.DbID > 0 {
 304			if err := backupDatabaseWithTask(parentTask, website.DbType, tmpDir, website.Alias, website.DbID); err != nil {
 305				return err
 306			}
 307		}
 308	}
 309
 310	websiteDir := GetSitePath(*website, SiteDir)
 311	parentTask.LogStart(i18n.GetMsgByKey("CompressDir"))
 312	if err := fileOp.TarGzCompressPro(true, websiteDir, path.Join(tmpDir, fmt.Sprintf("%s.web.tar.gz", website.Alias)), "", excludes); err != nil {
 313		return err
 314	}
 315	if err := fileOp.TarGzCompressPro(true, tmpDir, path.Join(backupDir, fileName), secret, ""); err != nil {
 316		return err
 317	}
 318	parentTask.Log(i18n.GetWithName("CompressFileSuccess", fileName))
 319	return nil
 320}
 321
 322func checkValidOfWebsite(oldWebsite, website *model.Website) error {
 323	if oldWebsite.Alias != website.Alias || oldWebsite.Type != website.Type {
 324		return buserr.WithDetail("ErrBackupMatch", fmt.Sprintf("oldName: %s, oldType: %v", oldWebsite.Alias, oldWebsite.Type), nil)
 325	}
 326	if oldWebsite.AppInstallID != 0 {
 327		_, err := appInstallRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(oldWebsite.AppInstallID))
 328		if err != nil {
 329			return buserr.WithDetail("ErrBackupMatch", "app", nil)
 330		}
 331	}
 332	if oldWebsite.RuntimeID != 0 {
 333		if _, err := runtimeRepo.GetFirst(context.Background(), repo.WithByID(oldWebsite.RuntimeID)); err != nil {
 334			return buserr.WithDetail("ErrBackupMatch", "runtime", nil)
 335		}
 336	}
 337	if oldWebsite.WebsiteSSLID != 0 {
 338		if _, err := websiteSSLRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(oldWebsite.WebsiteSSLID)); err != nil {
 339			return buserr.WithDetail("ErrBackupMatch", "ssl", nil)
 340		}
 341	}
 342	return nil
 343}
 344
 345func recoverWebsiteDatabase(t *task.Task, dbID uint, dbType, tmpPath, websiteKey string) error {
 346	switch dbType {
 347	case constant.AppPostgresql:
 348		db, err := postgresqlRepo.Get(repo.WithByID(dbID))
 349		if err != nil {
 350			return err
 351		}
 352		taskName := task.GetTaskName(db.Name, task.TaskRecover, task.TaskScopeDatabase)
 353		t.LogStart(taskName)
 354		if err := handlePostgresqlRecover(dto.CommonRecover{
 355			Name:       db.PostgresqlName,
 356			DetailName: db.Name,
 357			File:       fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s.sql.gz", tmpPath, websiteKey),
 358		}, t, true); err != nil {
 359			t.LogFailedWithErr(taskName, err)
 360			return err
 361		}
 362		t.LogSuccess(taskName)
 363	case constant.AppMysql, constant.AppMariaDB:
 364		db, err := mysqlRepo.Get(repo.WithByID(dbID))
 365		if err != nil {
 366			return err
 367		}
 368		taskName := task.GetTaskName(db.Name, task.TaskRecover, task.TaskScopeDatabase)
 369		t.LogStart(taskName)
 370		if err := handleMysqlRecover(dto.CommonRecover{
 371			Name:       db.MysqlName,
 372			DetailName: db.Name,
 373			File:       fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s.sql.gz", tmpPath, websiteKey),
 374		}, t, true); err != nil {
 375			t.LogFailedWithErr(taskName, err)
 376			return err
 377		}
 378		t.LogSuccess(taskName)
 379	}
 380	return nil
 381}

  22type IComposeTemplateService interface {
  23	List() ([]dto.ComposeTemplateInfo, error)
  24	SearchWithPage(search dto.SearchWithPage) (int64, interface{}, error)
  25	Create(req dto.ComposeTemplateCreate) error
  26	Update(id uint, upMap map[string]interface{}) error
  27	Batch(req dto.ComposeTemplateBatch) error

  31func NewIComposeTemplateService() IComposeTemplateService {
  32	return &ComposeTemplateService{}
  33}
  34
  35func (u *ComposeTemplateService) List() ([]dto.ComposeTemplateInfo, error) {
  36	composes, err := composeRepo.List()
  37	if err != nil {
  38		return nil, buserr.New("ErrRecordNotFound")
  39	}
  40	var dtoLists []dto.ComposeTemplateInfo
  41	for _, compose := range composes {
  42		var item dto.ComposeTemplateInfo
  43		if err := copier.Copy(&item, &compose); err != nil {
  44			return nil, buserr.WithDetail("ErrStructTransform", err.Error(), nil)
  45		}
  46		dtoLists = append(dtoLists, item)
  47	}
  48	return dtoLists, err
  49}
  50
  51func (u *ComposeTemplateService) SearchWithPage(req dto.SearchWithPage) (int64, interface{}, error) {
  52	total, composes, err := composeRepo.Page(req.Page, req.PageSize, repo.WithByLikeName(req.Info))
  53	var dtoComposeTemplates []dto.ComposeTemplateInfo
  54	for _, compose := range composes {
  55		var item dto.ComposeTemplateInfo
  56		if err := copier.Copy(&item, &compose); err != nil {
  57			return 0, nil, buserr.WithDetail("ErrStructTransform", err.Error(), nil)
  58		}
  59		dtoComposeTemplates = append(dtoComposeTemplates, item)
  60	}
  61	return total, dtoComposeTemplates, err
  62}
  63
  64func (u *ComposeTemplateService) Create(composeDto dto.ComposeTemplateCreate) error {
  65	compose, _ := composeRepo.Get(repo.WithByName(composeDto.Name))
  66	if compose.ID != 0 {
  67		return buserr.New("ErrRecordExist")
  68	}
  69	if err := copier.Copy(&compose, &composeDto); err != nil {
  70		return buserr.WithDetail("ErrStructTransform", err.Error(), nil)
  71	}
  72	if err := composeRepo.Create(&compose); err != nil {
  73		return err
  74	}
  75	return nil
  76}
  77
  78func (u *ComposeTemplateService) Batch(req dto.ComposeTemplateBatch) error {
  79	for _, item := range req.Templates {
  80		template, _ := composeRepo.Get(repo.WithByName(item.Name))
  81		if template.ID == 0 {
  82			if err := composeRepo.Create(&model.ComposeTemplate{Name: item.Name, Content: item.Content, Description: item.Description}); err != nil {
  83				return err
  84			}
  85		} else {
  86			if err := composeRepo.Update(template.ID, map[string]interface{}{"content": item.Content, "description": item.Description}); err != nil {
  87				return err
  88			}
  89		}
  90	}
  91	return nil
  92}
  93
  94func (u *ComposeTemplateService) Delete(ids []uint) error {
  95	if len(ids) == 1 {
  96		compose, _ := composeRepo.Get(repo.WithByID(ids[0]))
  97		if compose.ID == 0 {
  98			return buserr.New("ErrRecordNotFound")
  99		}
 100		return composeRepo.Delete(repo.WithByID(ids[0]))
 101	}
 102	return composeRepo.Delete(repo.WithByIDs(ids))
 103}

 105func (u *ComposeTemplateService) Update(id uint, upMap map[string]interface{}) error {
 106	return composeRepo.Update(id, upMap)
 107}

  67	byteContent, err := files.NewFileOp().GetContent(configPath)

  90func (n NginxService) GetStatus() (response.NginxStatus, error) {
  91	httpPort, _, err := getAppInstallPort(constant.AppOpenresty)
  92	if err != nil {
  93		return response.NginxStatus{}, err
  94	}
  95	url := "http:">//127.0.0.1/nginx_status"
  96	if httpPort != 80 {
  97		url = fmt.Sprintf("http:">//127.0.0.1:%v/nginx_status", httpPort)
  98	}
  99	res, err := http.Get(url)
 100	if err != nil || res.StatusCode > 300 {
 101		return response.NginxStatus{}, err
 102	}
 103	defer res.Body.Close()
 104	content, err := io.ReadAll(res.Body)
 105	if err != nil {
 106		return response.NginxStatus{}, err
 107	}
 108	var status response.NginxStatus
 109	resArray := strings.Split(string(content), " ")
 110	active, err := strconv.Atoi(resArray[2])
 111	if err == nil {
 112		status.Active = active
 113	}
 114	accepts, err := strconv.Atoi(resArray[7])
 115	if err == nil {
 116		status.Accepts = accepts
 117	}
 118	handled, err := strconv.Atoi(resArray[8])
 119	if err == nil {
 120		status.Handled = handled
 121	}
 122	requests, err := strconv.Atoi(resArray[9])
 123	if err == nil {
 124		status.Requests = requests
 125	}
 126	reading, err := strconv.Atoi(resArray[11])
 127	if err == nil {
 128		status.Reading = reading
 129	}
 130	writing, err := strconv.Atoi(resArray[13])
 131	if err == nil {
 132		status.Writing = writing
 133	}
 134	waiting, err := strconv.Atoi(resArray[15])
 135	if err == nil {
 136		status.Waiting = waiting
 137	}
 138	return status, nil
 139}

 141func (n NginxService) UpdateConfigFile(req request.NginxConfigFileUpdate) error {
 142	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
 143	nginxInstall, err := getAppInstallByKey(constant.AppOpenresty)
 144	if err != nil {
 145		return err
 146	}
 147	filePath := path.Join(global.Dir.AppInstallDir, constant.AppOpenresty, nginxInstall.Name, nginxModuleConfDir, "nginx.conf")
 148	if req.Backup {
 149		backupPath := path.Join(path.Dir(filePath), "bak")
 150		if !fileOp.Stat(backupPath) {
 151			if err := fileOp.CreateDir(backupPath, constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 152				return err
 153			}
 154		}
 155		newFile := path.Join(backupPath, "nginx.bak"+"-"+time.Now().Format("2006-01-02-15-04-05"))
 156		if err := fileOp.Copy(filePath, backupPath); err != nil {
 157			return err
 158		}
 159		if err := fileOp.Rename(path.Join(backupPath, "nginx.conf"), newFile); err != nil {
 160			return err
 161		}
 162	}
 163	oldContent, err := os.ReadFile(filePath)
 164	if err != nil {
 165		return err
 166	}
 167	if err = fileOp.WriteFile(filePath, strings.NewReader(req.Content), constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 168		return err
 169	}
 170	if status, err := checkContainerStatus(nginxInstall.ContainerName); err == nil && status != "running" {
 171		if out, err := compose.DownAndUp(nginxInstall.GetComposePath()); err != nil {
 172			_ = fileOp.SaveFile(filePath, string(oldContent), constant.DirPerm)
 173			return fmt.Errorf("nginx restart failed: %v", out)
 174		} else {
 175			return nginxCheckAndReload(string(oldContent), filePath, nginxInstall.ContainerName)
 176		}
 177	}
 178	return nginxCheckAndReload(string(oldContent), filePath, nginxInstall.ContainerName)
 179}

 181func (n NginxService) Build(req request.NginxBuildReq) error {
 182	nginxInstall, err := getAppInstallByKey(constant.AppOpenresty)
 183	if err != nil {
 184		return err
 185	}
 186	taskName := task.GetTaskName(nginxInstall.Name, task.TaskBuild, task.TaskScopeApp)
 187	if err = task.CheckTaskIsExecuting(taskName); err != nil {
 188		return err
 189	}
 190	if err = task.CheckScopeTaskIsExecuting(task.TaskScopeApp, nginxInstall.ID); err != nil {
 191		return err
 192	}
 193	buildPath := path.Join(nginxInstall.GetPath(), nginxModuleBuildDir)
 194	if !files.NewFileOp().Stat(buildPath) {
 195		return buserr.New("ErrBuildDirNotFound")
 196	}
 197
 198	buildTask, err := task.NewTaskWithOps(nginxInstall.Name, task.TaskBuild, task.TaskScopeApp, req.TaskID, nginxInstall.ID)
 199	if err != nil {
 200		return err
 201	}
 202	buildTask.AddSubTaskWithOps("", func(t *task.Task) error {
 203		return executeNginxModuleBuild(nginxInstall, req.Modules, req.Force, req.Mirror, t, true)
 204	}, nil, 0, 120*time.Minute)
 205
 206	go func() {
 207		_ = buildTask.Execute()
 208	}()
 209	return nil
 210}

 212func (n NginxService) GetModules() (*response.NginxBuildConfig, error) {
 213	nginxInstall, err := getAppInstallByKey(constant.AppOpenresty)
 214	if err != nil {
 215		return nil, err
 216	}
 217	modules, err := loadNginxModules(nginxInstall)
 218	if err != nil {
 219		return nil, err
 220	}
 221	target, targetWarning, targetErr := resolveNginxModuleTarget(nginxInstall)
 222	if targetWarning != "" {
 223		global.LOG.Warn(targetWarning)
 224	}
 225	runtimeTarget := target
 226	runtimeTarget.BuilderDigest = ""
 227	setNginxModuleTargetKey(&runtimeTarget)
 228	runtimeTargetErr := targetErr
 229	if runtimeTarget.OpenRestyVersion != "" {
 230		runtimeTargetErr = nil
 231	}
 232	var resList []response.NginxModule
 233	for _, module := range modules {
 234		buildStatus := nginxModuleStatusPending
 235		loadStatus := nginxModuleLoadDisabled
 236		var artifacts []dto.NginxModuleArtifact
 237		if module.BuildMode == nginxModuleBuildStatic && runtimeTargetErr == nil {
 238			if build := findCurrentNginxModuleBuild(module, runtimeTarget); build != nil && build.Status == nginxModuleStatusReady {
 239				buildStatus = nginxModuleStatusReady
 240				if module.Enable {
 241					loadStatus = nginxModuleLoadEnabled
 242				}
 243			} else if findLatestNginxModuleBuild(module, runtimeTarget) != nil {
 244				if module.Enable {
 245					loadStatus = nginxModuleLoadEnabled
 246				}
 247			}
 248		} else if targetErr == nil {
 249			if build := findCurrentNginxModuleBuild(module, target); build != nil {
 250				buildStatus = build.Status
 251				artifacts = build.Artifacts
 252				if build.Status == nginxModuleStatusReady {
 253					if module.Enable {
 254						loadStatus = nginxModuleLoadEnabled
 255					}
 256				}
 257			} else if latestBuild := findLatestNginxModuleBuild(module, target); latestBuild != nil {
 258				artifacts = latestBuild.Artifacts
 259				if module.Enable {
 260					loadStatus = nginxModuleLoadEnabled
 261				}
 262			}
 263		}
 264		if module.BuildMode != nginxModuleBuildStatic && module.LastError != "" {
 265			buildStatus = nginxModuleStatusFailed
 266		}
 267		resList = append(resList, response.NginxModule{
 268			Name:        module.Name,
 269			Custom:      module.Custom,
 270			Script:      module.Script,
 271			Packages:    strings.Join(module.Packages, ","),
 272			Params:      module.Params,
 273			Enable:      module.Enable,
 274			BuildMode:   module.BuildMode,
 275			Provider:    module.Provider,
 276			LoadOrder:   module.LoadOrder,
 277			BuildStatus: buildStatus,
 278			LoadStatus:  loadStatus,
 279			Artifacts:   artifacts,
 280			LastError:   module.LastError,
 281		})
 282	}
 283	envs, err := gotenv.Read(nginxInstall.GetEnvPath())
 284	if err != nil {
 285		return nil, err
 286	}
 287
 288	return &response.NginxBuildConfig{
 289		Mirror:           envs["CONTAINER_PACKAGE_URL"],
 290		DynamicSupported: nginxModuleDynamicSupported(nginxInstall),
 291		Modules:          resList,
 292	}, nil
 293}

 295func applyNginxModuleUpdate(modules []dto.NginxModule, req request.NginxModuleUpdate) ([]dto.NginxModule, *dto.NginxModule, error) {
 296	switch req.Operate {
 297	case nginxModuleOperateCreate:
 298		if err := validateNginxModuleBuildMode(dto.NginxModule{Name: req.Name, BuildMode: req.BuildMode}); err != nil {
 299			return nil, nil, err
 300		}
 301		for _, module := range modules {
 302			if module.Name == req.Name {
 303				return nil, nil, buserr.New("ErrNameIsExist")
 304			}
 305		}
 306		modules = append(modules, dto.NginxModule{
 307			Name:      req.Name,
 308			Custom:    true,
 309			Script:    req.Script,
 310			Packages:  strings.Split(req.Packages, ","),
 311			Params:    req.Params,
 312			Enable:    req.Enable,
 313			BuildMode: req.BuildMode,
 314			Provider:  req.Provider,
 315			LoadOrder: req.LoadOrder,
 316		})
 317	case nginxModuleOperateUpdate:
 318		for i := range modules {
 319			if modules[i].Name != req.Name {
 320				continue
 321			}
 322			if modules[i].Custom {
 323				if err := validateNginxModuleBuildMode(dto.NginxModule{Name: req.Name, BuildMode: req.BuildMode}); err != nil {
 324					return nil, nil, err
 325				}
 326			} else {
 327				modules[i].Enable = req.Enable
 328				return modules, nil, nil
 329			}
 330			modules[i].Enable = req.Enable
 331			modules[i].Script = req.Script
 332			modules[i].Packages = strings.Split(req.Packages, ",")
 333			modules[i].Params = req.Params
 334			modules[i].BuildMode = req.BuildMode
 335			modules[i].Provider = req.Provider
 336			modules[i].LoadOrder = req.LoadOrder
 337			return modules, nil, nil
 338		}
 339		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("OpenResty module %s not found", req.Name)
 340	case nginxModuleOperateDelete:
 341		for i := range modules {
 342			if modules[i].Name != req.Name {
 343				continue
 344			}
 345			if !modules[i].Custom {
 346				return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("built-in OpenResty module %s cannot be deleted", req.Name)
 347			}
 348			deleted := modules[i]
 349			modules = append(modules[:i], modules[i+1:]...)
 350			return modules, &deleted, nil
 351		}
 352		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("OpenResty module %s not found", req.Name)
 353	default:
 354		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported OpenResty module operation %q", req.Operate)
 355	}
 356	return modules, nil, nil
 357}

 359func (n NginxService) UpdateModule(req request.NginxModuleUpdate) error {
 360	nginxInstall, err := getAppInstallByKey(constant.AppOpenresty)
 361	if err != nil {
 362		return err
 363	}
 364	if err = task.CheckScopeTaskIsExecuting(task.TaskScopeApp, nginxInstall.ID); err != nil {
 365		return err
 366	}
 367	modules, err := loadNginxModules(nginxInstall)
 368	if err != nil {
 369		return err
 370	}
 371	oldModules := cloneNginxModules(modules)
 372	modules, deletedModule, err := applyNginxModuleUpdate(modules, req)
 373	if err != nil {
 374		return err
 375	}
 376	if err = saveNginxModules(nginxInstall, modules); err != nil {
 377		return err
 378	}
 379	if err = reconcileDynamicNginxModuleConfig(nginxInstall, modules, true); err != nil {
 380		_ = saveNginxModules(nginxInstall, oldModules)
 381		_ = reconcileDynamicNginxModuleConfig(nginxInstall, oldModules, false)
 382		return err
 383	}
 384	if deletedModule != nil {
 385		_ = removeNginxModuleArtifacts(nginxInstall, *deletedModule)
 386	}
 387	return nil
 388}

 390func (n NginxService) OperateDefaultHTTPs(req request.NginxDefaultHTTPSUpdate) error {
 391	appInstall, err := getAppInstallByKey(constant.AppOpenresty)
 392	if err != nil {
 393		return err
 394	}
 395	websites, _ := websiteRepo.List()
 396	hasDefaultWebsite := false
 397	for _, website := range websites {
 398		if website.DefaultServer {
 399			hasDefaultWebsite = true
 400			break
 401		}
 402	}
 403	defaultConfigPath := path.Join(appInstall.GetPath(), nginxModuleConfDir, "default", "00.default.conf")
 404	content, err := os.ReadFile(defaultConfigPath)
 405	if err != nil {
 406		return err
 407	}
 408	switch req.Operate {
 409	case "enable":
 410		if req.SSLRejectHandshake {
 411			defaultWebsite, _ := websiteRepo.GetFirst(websiteRepo.WithDefaultServer())
 412			if defaultWebsite.ID > 0 {
 413				return buserr.New("ErrDefaultWebsite")
 414			}
 415		}
 416		if err := handleSSLConfig(&appInstall, hasDefaultWebsite, req.SSLRejectHandshake); err != nil {
 417			return err
 418		}
 419	case "disable":
 420		defaultConfig, err := parser.NewStringParser(string(content)).Parse()
 421		if err != nil {
 422			return err
 423		}
 424		defaultConfig.FilePath = defaultConfigPath
 425		defaultServer := defaultConfig.FindServers()[0]
 426		defaultServer.RemoveListen(fmt.Sprintf("%d", appInstall.HttpsPort))
 427		defaultServer.RemoveListen(fmt.Sprintf("[::]:%d", appInstall.HttpsPort))
 428		defaultServer.RemoveDirective("include", []string{"/usr/local/openresty/nginx/conf/ssl/root_ssl.conf"})
 429		defaultServer.RemoveDirective("http2", []string{"on"})
 430		defaultServer.RemoveDirective("ssl_reject_handshake", []string{"on"})
 431		if err = nginx.WriteConfig(defaultConfig, nginx.IndentedStyle); err != nil {
 432			return err
 433		}
 434	}
 435	return nginxCheckAndReload(string(content), defaultConfigPath, appInstall.ContainerName)
 436}

 438func (n NginxService) GetDefaultHttpsStatus() (*response.NginxConfigRes, error) {
 439	appInstall, err := getAppInstallByKey(constant.AppOpenresty)
 440	if err != nil {
 441		return nil, err
 442	}
 443	defaultConfigPath := path.Join(appInstall.GetPath(), nginxModuleConfDir, "default", "00.default.conf")
 444	content, err := os.ReadFile(defaultConfigPath)
 445	if err != nil {
 446		return nil, err
 447	}
 448	defaultConfig, err := parser.NewStringParser(string(content)).Parse()
 449	if err != nil {
 450		return nil, err
 451	}
 452	defaultConfig.FilePath = defaultConfigPath
 453	defaultServer := defaultConfig.FindServers()[0]
 454	res := &response.NginxConfigRes{}
 455	for _, directive := range defaultServer.GetDirectives() {
 456		if directive.GetName() == "include" && directive.GetParameters()[0] == "/usr/local/openresty/nginx/conf/ssl/root_ssl.conf" {
 457			res.Https = true
 458		}
 459		if directive.GetName() == "ssl_reject_handshake" && directive.GetParameters()[0] == "on" {
 460			res.Https = true
 461			res.SSLRejectHandshake = true
 462		}
 463	}
 464	return res, nil
 465}

 119func resolveNginxModuleTarget(install model.AppInstall) (dto.NginxModuleTarget, string, error) {
 120	target, warning, err := resolveNginxRuntimeTarget(install)
 121	if err != nil {
 122		return target, warning, err
 123	}
 124	builderPath := path.Join(install.GetPath(), nginxModuleBuildDir, nginxModuleBuilderFile)
 125	builderContent, err := os.ReadFile(builderPath)
 126	if err != nil {
 127		return target, warning, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", errNginxModuleBuilderMissing, err)
 128	}
 129	builderSum := sha256.Sum256(builderContent)
 130	target.BuilderDigest = hex.EncodeToString(builderSum[:])
 131	setNginxModuleTargetKey(&target)
 132	return target, warning, nil
 133}
 134
 135func resolveNginxRuntimeTarget(install model.AppInstall) (dto.NginxModuleTarget, string, error) {
 136	target := dto.NginxModuleTarget{
 137		OpenRestyVersion: install.Version,
 138		Architecture:     runtime.GOARCH,
 139	}
 140	envContent, _ := os.ReadFile(install.GetEnvPath())
 141	images, imageErr := dockerUtils.GetImagesFromDockerCompose(envContent, []byte(install.DockerCompose))
 142	if imageErr != nil || len(images) == 0 {
 143		images, imageErr = compose.GetComposeImages(install.GetComposePath())
 144	}
 145	var warning string
 146	if imageErr == nil && len(images) > 0 {
 147		target.Image = images[0]
 148		inspectMgr := cmd.NewCommandMgr(cmd.WithTimeout(2 * time.Minute))
 149		inspectOut, inspectErr := inspectMgr.RunWithStdout("docker", "image", "inspect", "--format={{.Id}}\t{{.Architecture}}", target.Image)
 150		if inspectErr != nil {
 151			warning = fmt.Sprintf("inspect OpenResty image %s failed, module rebuilds will fall back to host architecture %s: %v", target.Image, target.Architecture, inspectErr)
 152		} else if fields := strings.Fields(inspectOut); len(fields) >= 2 {
 153			target.ImageDigest = fields[0]
 154			target.Architecture = fields[1]
 155		}
 156	}
 157	setNginxModuleTargetKey(&target)
 158	return target, warning, nil
 159}
 160
 161func setNginxModuleTargetKey(target *dto.NginxModuleTarget) {
 162	keyInput := strings.Join([]string{target.OpenRestyVersion, target.Architecture, target.ImageDigest, target.BuilderDigest}, "\x00")
 163	keySum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(keyInput))
 164	target.Key = fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s-%s", sanitizeModulePathPart(target.OpenRestyVersion), target.Architecture, hex.EncodeToString(keySum[:6]))
 165}

 169func nginxModuleDynamicSupported(install model.AppInstall) bool {
 170	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
 171	buildPath := path.Join(install.GetPath(), nginxModuleBuildDir)
 172	return fileOp.Stat(path.Join(buildPath, nginxModuleBuilderFile)) &&
 173		fileOp.Stat(path.Join(buildPath, nginxModuleCatalogFile))
 174}

 176func syncNginxModuleBuilder(detailBuildDir, installBuildDir string) error {
 177	sourcePath := path.Join(detailBuildDir, nginxModuleBuilderFile)
 178	targetPath := path.Join(installBuildDir, nginxModuleBuilderFile)
 179	if _, err := os.Stat(sourcePath); err != nil {
 180		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
 181			if removeErr := os.Remove(targetPath); removeErr != nil && !os.IsNotExist(removeErr) {
 182				return removeErr
 183			}
 184			return nil
 185		}
 186		return err
 187	}
 188	return files.NewFileOp().CopyFile(sourcePath, installBuildDir)
 189}

 191"cmt">// resolveNginxModuleBuildMirror picks the apt mirror for module builds: the
 192"cmt">// explicit request value wins, otherwise the install's saved
 193"cmt">// CONTAINER_PACKAGE_URL.
 194func resolveNginxModuleBuildMirror(install model.AppInstall, mirror string) string {
 195	if mirror != "" {
 196		return mirror
 197	}
 198	envs, err := gotenv.Read(install.GetEnvPath())
 199	if err != nil {
 200		return ""
 201	}
 202	return strings.TrimSpace(envs["CONTAINER_PACKAGE_URL"])
 203}

 205func buildDynamicNginxModules(install model.AppInstall, modules []dto.NginxModule, selected []string, force bool, mirror string, catalogPath string, parentTask *task.Task) ([]dto.NginxModule, error) {
 206	"cmt">// Skip target resolution entirely when nothing needs a dynamic build, so
 207	"cmt">// installs without dynamic modules do not require Dockerfile.modules.
 208	if !hasDynamicNginxModuleBuildTask(modules, selected) {
 209		return modules, nil
 210	}
 211	target, targetWarning, err := resolveNginxModuleTarget(install)
 212	if err != nil {
 213		return modules, err
 214	}
 215	if targetWarning != "" {
 216		parentTask.Logf("WARNING: %s", targetWarning)
 217	}
 218	originalModules := cloneNginxModules(modules)
 219	selectedNames := make(map[string]struct{}, len(selected))
 220	for _, name := range selected {
 221		selectedNames[name] = struct{}{}
 222	}
 223	buildPath := path.Join(install.GetPath(), nginxModuleBuildDir)
 224	buildMirror := resolveNginxModuleBuildMirror(install, mirror)
 225	for i := range modules {
 226		module := &modules[i]
 227		normalizeNginxModule(module)
 228		if !nginxModuleNeedsDynamicBuild(*module, selectedNames) {
 229			continue
 230		}
 231		provider, providerErr := getNginxModuleProvider(module.Provider)
 232		if providerErr != nil {
 233			return modules, providerErr
 234		}
 235		previousBuild := findCurrentNginxModuleBuild(*module, target)
 236		build, buildErr := provider.Resolve(nginxModuleBuildSpec{
 237			Install: install, Module: *module, Target: target, BuildPath: buildPath, Force: force, Mirror: buildMirror, Task: parentTask,
 238		})
 239		if buildErr != nil {
 240			build.Provider = provider.Name()
 241			build.Status = nginxModuleStatusFailed
 242			build.Target = target
 243			build.Error = buildErr.Error()
 244			build.BuiltAt = time.Now()
 245			failedModules := recordNginxModuleBuildFailure(originalModules, module.Name, build, previousBuild)
 246			removeNginxModuleOutputsNotReferenced(install, modules, failedModules)
 247			_ = saveNginxModulesWithCatalog(install, failedModules, catalogPath)
 248			return failedModules, fmt.Errorf("build dynamic module %s: %w%s", module.Name, buildErr, nginxModuleStaticBuildErrorHint(*module))
 249		}
 250		err = validateNginxModuleArtifacts(install, build.Artifacts)
 251		if err != nil {
 252			for outputDir := range nginxModuleOutputDirectories(install, []dto.NginxModule{{Builds: []dto.NginxModuleBuild{build}}}) {
 253				_ = os.RemoveAll(outputDir)
 254			}
 255			build.Status = nginxModuleStatusFailed
 256			build.Error = err.Error()
 257			build.Artifacts = nil
 258			build.BuiltAt = time.Now()
 259			failedModules := recordNginxModuleBuildFailure(originalModules, module.Name, build, previousBuild)
 260			removeNginxModuleOutputsNotReferenced(install, modules, failedModules)
 261			_ = saveNginxModulesWithCatalog(install, failedModules, catalogPath)
 262			return failedModules, fmt.Errorf("validate dynamic module %s: %w%s", module.Name, err, nginxModuleStaticBuildErrorHint(*module))
 263		}
 264		module.LastError = ""
 265		upsertNginxModuleBuild(module, build)
 266	}
 267	return modules, nil
 268}

 270func (localNginxModuleProvider) Resolve(spec nginxModuleBuildSpec) (dto.NginxModuleBuild, error) {
 271	params, err := normalizeDynamicModuleParams(spec.Module.Params)
 272	if err != nil {
 273		return dto.NginxModuleBuild{}, err
 274	}
 275	configureArgs, err := parseDynamicModuleParams(params)
 276	if err != nil {
 277		return dto.NginxModuleBuild{}, err
 278	}
 279	if err = validateNginxModulePackages(spec.Module.Packages); err != nil {
 280		return dto.NginxModuleBuild{}, err
 281	}
 282	buildHash, err := nginxModuleBuildHash(spec.Module, spec.Target, params)
 283	if err != nil {
 284		return dto.NginxModuleBuild{}, err
 285	}
 286	result := dto.NginxModuleBuild{
 287		Provider:  nginxModuleProviderLocal,
 288		BuildMode: nginxModuleBuildDynamic,
 289		Status:    nginxModuleStatusPending,
 290		Hash:      buildHash,
 291		Target:    spec.Target,
 292	}
 293	modulesRoot := path.Join(spec.Install.GetPath(), nginxModuleModulesDir)
 294	if !spec.Force {
 295		if current := findCurrentNginxModuleBuild(spec.Module, spec.Target); current != nil && current.Status == nginxModuleStatusReady {
 296			if validateNginxModuleArtifacts(spec.Install, current.Artifacts) == nil {
 297				return *current, nil
 298			}
 299		}
 300	}
 301	outputRevision := buildHash
 302	if spec.Force {
 303		outputRevision = fmt.Sprintf("%s-r%d", buildHash, time.Now().UnixNano())
 304	}
 305	modulePathName := nginxModulePathName(spec.Module.Name)
 306	finalPath := path.Join(modulesRoot, spec.Target.Key, modulePathName, outputRevision)
 307	buildComplete := false
 308	defer func() {
 309		if !buildComplete {
 310			_ = os.RemoveAll(finalPath)
 311		}
 312	}()
 313
 314	preScriptPath := path.Join(spec.BuildPath, nginxModuleTmpDir, nginxModulePreScriptFile)
 315	if err = os.WriteFile(preScriptPath, []byte("#!/bin/bash\nset -e\n"+spec.Module.Script+"\n"), constant.FilePerm); err != nil {
 316		return result, err
 317	}
 318	defer os.Remove(preScriptPath)
 319	configureArgsPath := path.Join(spec.BuildPath, nginxModuleTmpDir, nginxModuleConfigArgsFile)
 320	if err = os.WriteFile(configureArgsPath, []byte(strings.Join(configureArgs, "\n")+"\n"), constant.FilePerm); err != nil {
 321		return result, err
 322	}
 323	defer os.Remove(configureArgsPath)
 324
 325	shortHash := buildHash
 326	if len(shortHash) > 12 {
 327		shortHash = shortHash[:12]
 328	}
 329	taskSuffix := sanitizeModulePathPart(spec.Task.TaskID)
 330	if len(taskSuffix) > 8 {
 331		taskSuffix = taskSuffix[:8]
 332	}
 333	tempImage := fmt.Sprintf("1panel/openresty-module-builder:%s-%s-%s", modulePathName, shortHash, taskSuffix)
 334	tempContainer := fmt.Sprintf("1panel-module-%s-%s-%s", modulePathName, shortHash, taskSuffix)
 335	commandMgr := cmd.NewCommandMgr(cmd.WithTask(*spec.Task), cmd.WithTimeout(120*time.Minute))
 336	buildArgs := []string{
 337		"build", "--target", "module-output",
 338		"-f", path.Join(spec.BuildPath, nginxModuleBuilderFile),
 339		"-t", tempImage,
 340		"--build-arg", "PANEL_OPENRESTY_VERSION=" + spec.Install.Version,
 341		"--build-arg", "RESTY_ADD_PACKAGE_BUILDDEPS=" + strings.Join(spec.Module.Packages, " "),
 342	}
 343	if spec.Mirror != "" {
 344		buildArgs = append(buildArgs, "--build-arg", "CONTAINER_PACKAGE_URL="+spec.Mirror)
 345	}
 346	buildArgs = append(buildArgs, spec.BuildPath)
 347	if err = commandMgr.Run("docker", buildArgs...); err != nil {
 348		return result, err
 349	}
 350	cleanupMgr := cmd.NewCommandMgr(cmd.WithTimeout(5 * time.Minute))
 351	defer func() {
 352		_ = cleanupMgr.Run("docker", "rm", "-f", tempContainer)
 353		_ = cleanupMgr.Run("docker", "image", "rm", "-f", tempImage)
 354	}()
 355	if err = commandMgr.Run("docker", "create", "--name", tempContainer, tempImage, "/bin/true"); err != nil {
 356		return result, err
 357	}
 358
 359	stagingPath := path.Join(spec.Install.GetPath(), nginxModuleModulesDir, nginxModuleStagingDir, modulePathName+"-"+shortHash)
 360	_ = os.RemoveAll(stagingPath)
 361	if err = os.MkdirAll(stagingPath, constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 362		return result, err
 363	}
 364	defer os.RemoveAll(stagingPath)
 365	if err = commandMgr.Run("docker", "cp", tempContainer+":/out/.", stagingPath); err != nil {
 366		return result, err
 367	}
 368	if artifacts, artifactErr := collectNginxModuleArtifacts(stagingPath, stagingPath); artifactErr != nil || len(artifacts) == 0 {
 369		if artifactErr != nil {
 370			return result, artifactErr
 371		}
 372		return result, errors.New("dynamic module build produced no loadable .so files")
 373	}
 374	if err = os.MkdirAll(path.Dir(finalPath), constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 375		return result, err
 376	}
 377	_ = os.RemoveAll(finalPath)
 378	if err = os.Rename(stagingPath, finalPath); err != nil {
 379		return result, err
 380	}
 381	artifacts, err := collectNginxModuleArtifacts(finalPath, modulesRoot)
 382	if err != nil {
 383		return result, err
 384	}
 385	result.Status = nginxModuleStatusReady
 386	result.Artifacts = artifacts
 387	result.BuiltAt = time.Now()
 388	manifest, _ := json.MarshalIndent(result, "", "  ")
 389	_ = os.WriteFile(path.Join(finalPath, nginxModuleManifestFile), manifest, constant.FilePerm)
 390	buildComplete = true
 391	return result, nil
 392}

 394func commitNginxModuleBuilds(install model.AppInstall, previousModules, modules []dto.NginxModule, reload bool, catalogPath string) error {
 395	if err := saveNginxModulesWithCatalog(install, modules, catalogPath); err != nil {
 396		removeNginxModuleOutputsNotReferenced(install, modules, previousModules)
 397		return err
 398	}
 399	if err := reconcileDynamicNginxModuleConfig(install, modules, reload); err != nil {
 400		rollbackModules := recordNginxModuleActivationFailure(previousModules, modules, err)
 401		_ = saveNginxModulesWithCatalog(install, rollbackModules, catalogPath)
 402		removeNginxModuleOutputsNotReferenced(install, modules, previousModules)
 403		return err
 404	}
 405	removeNginxModuleOutputsNotReferenced(install, previousModules, modules)
 406	return nil
 407}
 408
 409func validateNginxModuleArtifacts(install model.AppInstall, artifacts []dto.NginxModuleArtifact) error {
 410	if len(artifacts) == 0 {
 411		return errors.New("module build produced no loadable artifacts")
 412	}
 413	modulesRoot := filepath.Clean(path.Join(install.GetPath(), nginxModuleModulesDir))
 414	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(artifacts))
 415	for _, artifact := range artifacts {
 416		if _, ok := seen[artifact.Path]; ok {
 417			return fmt.Errorf("duplicate module artifact path %q", artifact.Path)
 418		}
 419		seen[artifact.Path] = struct{}{}
 420		if artifact.Name != path.Base(artifact.Path) {
 421			return fmt.Errorf("module artifact name %q does not match path %q", artifact.Name, artifact.Path)
 422		}
 423		if !re.IsValidNginxModuleChecksum(artifact.Checksum) {
 424			return fmt.Errorf("invalid checksum for module artifact %q", artifact.Path)
 425		}
 426		if !re.IsValidNginxModuleArtifact(artifact.Path) {
 427			return fmt.Errorf("invalid module artifact path %q", artifact.Path)
 428		}
 429		artifactFullPath := filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(modulesRoot, filepath.FromSlash(artifact.Path)))
 430		if !strings.HasPrefix(artifactFullPath, modulesRoot+string(os.PathSeparator)) {
 431			return fmt.Errorf("module artifact path %q escapes the module directory", artifact.Path)
 432		}
 433		info, err := os.Lstat(artifactFullPath)
 434		if err != nil {
 435			return err
 436		}
 437		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
 438			return fmt.Errorf("module artifact %q is not a regular file", artifact.Path)
 439		}
 440		file, err := os.Open(artifactFullPath)
 441		if err != nil {
 442			return err
 443		}
 444		hash := sha256.New()
 445		_, copyErr := io.Copy(hash, file)
 446		closeErr := file.Close()
 447		if copyErr != nil {
 448			return copyErr
 449		}
 450		if closeErr != nil {
 451			return closeErr
 452		}
 453		actualChecksum := hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil))
 454		if !strings.EqualFold(actualChecksum, artifact.Checksum) {
 455			return fmt.Errorf("checksum mismatch for module artifact %q", artifact.Path)
 456		}
 457	}
 458	return nil
 459}
 460
 461func collectNginxModuleArtifacts(root, relativeRoot string) ([]dto.NginxModuleArtifact, error) {
 462	var artifacts []dto.NginxModuleArtifact
 463	err := filepath.Walk(root, func(filePath string, info os.FileInfo, walkErr error) error {
 464		if walkErr != nil {
 465			return walkErr
 466		}
 467		if info.IsDir() || filepath.Ext(info.Name()) != ".so" || filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(filePath)) == nginxModuleLibDir {
 468			return nil
 469		}
 470		file, err := os.Open(filePath)
 471		if err != nil {
 472			return err
 473		}
 474		hash := sha256.New()
 475		_, copyErr := io.Copy(hash, file)
 476		_ = file.Close()
 477		if copyErr != nil {
 478			return copyErr
 479		}
 480		relativePath, err := filepath.Rel(relativeRoot, filePath)
 481		if err != nil {
 482			return err
 483		}
 484		artifacts = append(artifacts, dto.NginxModuleArtifact{
 485			Name: info.Name(), Path: filepath.ToSlash(relativePath), Checksum: hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)),
 486		})
 487		return nil
 488	})
 489	sort.Slice(artifacts, func(i, j int) bool { return artifacts[i].Name < artifacts[j].Name })
 490	return artifacts, err
 491}

 493func validateNginxModuleLoadConfig(install model.AppInstall, target dto.NginxModuleTarget, validationName, loadDirectives string) error {
 494	if target.Image == "" {
 495		return errors.New("target OpenResty image is not resolved")
 496	}
 497	var config strings.Builder
 498	config.WriteString(loadDirectives)
 499	config.WriteString("events {}\nhttp {}\n")
 500	configSum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(config.String()))
 501	testConfig := path.Join(install.GetPath(), nginxModuleModulesDir, ".test-"+nginxModulePathName(validationName)+"-"+hex.EncodeToString(configSum[:6])+".conf")
 502	if err := os.WriteFile(testConfig, []byte(config.String()), constant.FilePerm); err != nil {
 503		return err
 504	}
 505	defer os.Remove(testConfig)
 506	modulesRoot := path.Join(install.GetPath(), nginxModuleModulesDir)
 507	args := []string{
 508		"run", "--rm", "--network", "none",
 509		"-v", modulesRoot + ":" + nginxModuleContainerRoot + ":ro",
 510		"-v", testConfig + ":/tmp/1panel-module-test.conf:ro",
 511		"--entrypoint", "/usr/local/openresty/nginx/sbin/nginx",
 512		target.Image, "-t", "-c", "/tmp/1panel-module-test.conf",
 513	}
 514	return cmd.NewCommandMgr(cmd.WithTimeout(5*time.Minute)).Run("docker", args...)
 515}

 517"cmt">// nginxModuleConfigSnapshot (map)
 518type nginxModuleConfigSnapshot map[string][]byte
 519
 520"cmt">// openrestyUpgradeSnapshot (struct)
 521type openrestyUpgradeSnapshot struct {
 522	installPath string
 523	backupPath  string
 524	existing    map[string]bool
 525}
 526
 527var openrestyUpgradeSnapshotPaths = []string{
 528	nginxModuleBuildDir,
 529	nginxModuleModulesDir,
 530	"scripts",
 531	path.Join(nginxModuleConfDir, nginxModuleEnabledConfDir),
 532	path.Join(nginxModuleConfDir, "nginx.conf"),
 533	"docker-compose.yml",
 534	".env",
 535}
 536
 537func createOpenrestyUpgradeSnapshot(installPath string) (*openrestyUpgradeSnapshot, error) {
 538	backupPath, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "1panel-openresty-upgrade-*")
 539	if err != nil {
 540		return nil, err
 541	}
 542	snapshot := &openrestyUpgradeSnapshot{
 543		installPath: installPath,
 544		backupPath:  backupPath,
 545		existing:    make(map[string]bool, len(openrestyUpgradeSnapshotPaths)),
 546	}
 547	for _, relativePath := range openrestyUpgradeSnapshotPaths {
 548		sourcePath := path.Join(installPath, relativePath)
 549		if _, err = os.Stat(sourcePath); err != nil {
 550			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
 551				continue
 552			}
 553			snapshot.Cleanup()
 554			return nil, err
 555		}
 556		snapshot.existing[relativePath] = true
 557		if err = copyOpenrestyUpgradeSnapshotEntry(sourcePath, path.Join(backupPath, relativePath)); err != nil {
 558			snapshot.Cleanup()
 559			return nil, err
 560		}
 561	}
 562	return snapshot, nil
 563}
 564
 565func copyOpenrestyUpgradeSnapshotEntry(sourcePath, targetPath string) error {
 566	if err := os.MkdirAll(path.Dir(targetPath), constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 567		return err
 568	}
 569	info, err := os.Stat(sourcePath)
 570	if err != nil {
 571		return err
 572	}
 573	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
 574	if info.IsDir() {
 575		return fileOp.CopyDir(sourcePath, path.Dir(targetPath))
 576	}
 577	return fileOp.CopyFile(sourcePath, path.Dir(targetPath))
 578}
 579
 580func (s *openrestyUpgradeSnapshot) Restore() error {
 581	for _, relativePath := range openrestyUpgradeSnapshotPaths {
 582		targetPath := path.Join(s.installPath, relativePath)
 583		if err := os.RemoveAll(targetPath); err != nil {
 584			return err
 585		}
 586		if !s.existing[relativePath] {
 587			continue
 588		}
 589		if err := copyOpenrestyUpgradeSnapshotEntry(path.Join(s.backupPath, relativePath), targetPath); err != nil {
 590			return err
 591		}
 592	}
 593	return nil
 594}
 595
 596func (s *openrestyUpgradeSnapshot) Cleanup() {
 597	if s != nil && s.backupPath != "" {
 598		_ = os.RemoveAll(s.backupPath)
 599	}
 600}

 602func reconcileDynamicNginxModuleConfig(install model.AppInstall, modules []dto.NginxModule, reload bool) error {
 603	var target dto.NginxModuleTarget
 604	if hasDynamicNginxModuleBuildTask(modules, nil) {
 605		var targetWarning string
 606		var err error
 607		target, targetWarning, err = resolveNginxModuleTarget(install)
 608		if err != nil {
 609			return err
 610		}
 611		if targetWarning != "" {
 612			global.LOG.Warn(targetWarning)
 613		}
 614	}
 615	configDir := path.Join(install.GetPath(), nginxModuleConfDir, nginxModuleEnabledConfDir)
 616	if err := os.MkdirAll(configDir, constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 617		return err
 618	}
 619	snapshot, err := snapshotManagedNginxModuleConfigs(configDir)
 620	if err != nil {
 621		return err
 622	}
 623	desired := make(map[string][]byte)
 624	var combinedLoadDirectives strings.Builder
 625	sortedModules := append([]dto.NginxModule(nil), modules...)
 626	sort.SliceStable(sortedModules, func(i, j int) bool {
 627		if sortedModules[i].LoadOrder == sortedModules[j].LoadOrder {
 628			return sortedModules[i].Name < sortedModules[j].Name
 629		}
 630		return sortedModules[i].LoadOrder < sortedModules[j].LoadOrder
 631	})
 632	for _, module := range sortedModules {
 633		normalizeNginxModule(&module)
 634		if !module.Enable || module.BuildMode == nginxModuleBuildStatic {
 635			continue
 636		}
 637		build := findCurrentNginxModuleBuild(module, target)
 638		if build == nil || build.Status != nginxModuleStatusReady {
 639			build = findLatestNginxModuleBuild(module, target)
 640		}
 641		if build == nil || build.Status != nginxModuleStatusReady {
 642			continue
 643		}
 644		"cmt">// Artifacts were already validated after the build; re-validating here
 645		"cmt">// is a deliberate guard against on-disk tampering before writing
 646		"cmt">// load_module directives.
 647		if err = validateNginxModuleArtifacts(install, build.Artifacts); err != nil {
 648			return fmt.Errorf("validate artifacts for dynamic module %s: %w", module.Name, err)
 649		}
 650		var content strings.Builder
 651		content.WriteString("# Managed by 1Panel. Manual changes will be overwritten.\n")
 652		for _, artifact := range build.Artifacts {
 653			content.WriteString("load_module ")
 654			content.WriteString(path.Join(nginxModuleContainerRoot, artifact.Path))
 655			content.WriteString(";\n")
 656			combinedLoadDirectives.WriteString("load_module ")
 657			combinedLoadDirectives.WriteString(path.Join(nginxModuleContainerRoot, artifact.Path))
 658			combinedLoadDirectives.WriteString(";\n")
 659		}
 660		fileName := fmt.Sprintf("%s%04d-%s.conf", nginxModuleConfigPrefix, module.LoadOrder, nginxModulePathName(module.Name))
 661		desired[fileName] = []byte(content.String())
 662	}
 663	if combinedLoadDirectives.Len() > 0 {
 664		if err = validateNginxModuleLoadConfig(install, target, "combined", combinedLoadDirectives.String()); err != nil {
 665			return fmt.Errorf("validate combined dynamic module configuration: %w", err)
 666		}
 667	}
 668	if err = applyManagedNginxModuleConfigs(configDir, desired); err != nil {
 669		_ = applyManagedNginxModuleConfigs(configDir, snapshot)
 670		return err
 671	}
 672	if !reload {
 673		return nil
 674	}
 675	status, statusErr := checkContainerStatus(install.ContainerName)
 676	if statusErr != nil || status != "running" {
 677		return nil
 678	}
 679	if err = opNginx(install.ContainerName, constant.NginxCheck); err != nil {
 680		_ = applyManagedNginxModuleConfigs(configDir, snapshot)
 681		return err
 682	}
 683	if err = opNginx(install.ContainerName, constant.NginxReload); err != nil {
 684		_ = applyManagedNginxModuleConfigs(configDir, snapshot)
 685		return err
 686	}
 687	return nil
 688}
 689
 690func snapshotManagedNginxModuleConfigs(configDir string) (nginxModuleConfigSnapshot, error) {
 691	snapshot := make(nginxModuleConfigSnapshot)
 692	entries, err := os.ReadDir(configDir)
 693	if err != nil {
 694		return nil, err
 695	}
 696	for _, entry := range entries {
 697		if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasPrefix(entry.Name(), nginxModuleConfigPrefix) {
 698			continue
 699		}
 700		content, readErr := os.ReadFile(path.Join(configDir, entry.Name()))
 701		if readErr != nil {
 702			return nil, readErr
 703		}
 704		snapshot[entry.Name()] = content
 705	}
 706	return snapshot, nil
 707}
 708
 709func applyManagedNginxModuleConfigs(configDir string, desired map[string][]byte) error {
 710	entries, err := os.ReadDir(configDir)
 711	if err != nil {
 712		return err
 713	}
 714	for fileName, content := range desired {
 715		tmpPath := path.Join(configDir, "."+fileName+".tmp")
 716		if err = os.WriteFile(tmpPath, content, constant.FilePerm); err != nil {
 717			return err
 718		}
 719		if err = os.Rename(tmpPath, path.Join(configDir, fileName)); err != nil {
 720			return err
 721		}
 722	}
 723	for _, entry := range entries {
 724		if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasPrefix(entry.Name(), nginxModuleConfigPrefix) {
 725			continue
 726		}
 727		if _, ok := desired[entry.Name()]; !ok {
 728			if err = os.Remove(path.Join(configDir, entry.Name())); err != nil && !os.IsNotExist(err) {
 729				return err
 730			}
 731		}
 732	}
 733	return nil
 734}

 736func hasEnabledStaticNginxModules(modules []dto.NginxModule) bool {
 737	for _, module := range modules {
 738		normalizeNginxModule(&module)
 739		if module.Enable && module.BuildMode == nginxModuleBuildStatic {
 740			return true
 741		}
 742	}
 743	return false
 744}
 745
 746func staticNginxBuildRequired(install model.AppInstall, modules []dto.NginxModule) bool {
 747	if hasEnabledStaticNginxModules(modules) {
 748		return true
 749	}
 750	envs, err := gotenv.Read(install.GetEnvPath())
 751	if err != nil {
 752		return false
 753	}
 754	return strings.TrimSpace(envs["RESTY_CONFIG_OPTIONS_MORE"]) != ""
 755}
 756
 757func configureStaticNginxModules(install model.AppInstall, modules []dto.NginxModule, mirror string) error {
 758	buildPath := path.Join(install.GetPath(), nginxModuleBuildDir)
 759	var params, packages []string
 760	preScriptPath := path.Join(buildPath, nginxModuleTmpDir, nginxModuleStaticPreScript)
 761	preScript, err := os.OpenFile(preScriptPath, os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_TRUNC, constant.FilePerm)
 762	if err != nil {
 763		return err
 764	}
 765	for _, module := range modules {
 766		normalizeNginxModule(&module)
 767		if !module.Enable || module.BuildMode != nginxModuleBuildStatic {
 768			continue
 769		}
 770		if _, err = preScript.WriteString(module.Script + "\n"); err != nil {
 771			_ = preScript.Close()
 772			return err
 773		}
 774		params = append(params, module.Params)
 775		packages = append(packages, module.Packages...)
 776	}
 777	if err = preScript.Close(); err != nil {
 778		return err
 779	}
 780	envs, err := gotenv.Read(install.GetEnvPath())
 781	if err != nil {
 782		return err
 783	}
 784	if mirror != "" {
 785		envs["CONTAINER_PACKAGE_URL"] = mirror
 786	}
 787	envs["RESTY_CONFIG_OPTIONS_MORE"] = strings.Join(compactStrings(params), " ")
 788	envs["RESTY_ADD_PACKAGE_BUILDDEPS"] = strings.Join(compactStrings(packages), " ")
 789	return gotenv.Write(envs, install.GetEnvPath())
 790}
 791
 792func executeStaticNginxModuleBuild(install model.AppInstall, modules []dto.NginxModule, mirror string, force bool, parentTask *task.Task) error {
 793	if err := configureStaticNginxModules(install, modules, mirror); err != nil {
 794		return err
 795	}
 796	commandMgr := cmd.NewCommandMgr(cmd.WithTask(*parentTask), cmd.WithTimeout(120*time.Minute))
 797	if err := commandMgr.Run("docker", "compose", "-f", install.GetComposePath(), "build"); err != nil {
 798		return err
 799	}
 800	previousModules := cloneNginxModules(modules)
 801	"cmt">// A rebuilt runtime changes the target ABI, so every enabled dynamic module
 802	"cmt">// must be rebuilt even when the user selected only one module.
 803	modules, err := buildDynamicNginxModules(install, modules, nil, force, mirror, "", parentTask)
 804	if err != nil {
 805		return err
 806	}
 807	if err = commitNginxModuleBuilds(install, previousModules, modules, false, ""); err != nil {
 808		return err
 809	}
 810	if _, err = compose.DownAndUp(install.GetComposePath()); err != nil {
 811		return err
 812	}
 813	return commitStaticNginxModuleBuilds(install, "", parentTask)
 814}
 815
 816func executeNginxModuleBuild(install model.AppInstall, reqModules []string, force bool, mirror string, parentTask *task.Task, reload bool) error {
 817	modules, err := loadNginxModules(install)
 818	if err != nil {
 819		return err
 820	}
 821	staticBuild := staticNginxBuildRequired(install, modules)
 822	if !staticBuild && hasDynamicNginxModuleBuildTask(modules, reqModules) {
 823		if !nginxModuleDynamicSupported(install) {
 824			return errors.New("the installed OpenResty version does not support dynamic module builds")
 825		}
 826	}
 827	if staticBuild {
 828		return executeStaticNginxModuleBuild(install, modules, mirror, force, parentTask)
 829	}
 830	previousModules := cloneNginxModules(modules)
 831	modules, err = buildDynamicNginxModules(install, modules, reqModules, force, mirror, "", parentTask)
 832	if err != nil {
 833		return err
 834	}
 835	return commitNginxModuleBuilds(install, previousModules, modules, reload, "")
 836}

 838func removeNginxModuleArtifacts(install model.AppInstall, module dto.NginxModule) error {

 841		if err := files.NewFileOp().DeleteDir(moduleDir); err != nil && !os.IsNotExist(err) {
 842			return err
 843		}
 844	}
 845	return nil

 848func loadNginxModules(install model.AppInstall) ([]dto.NginxModule, error) {
 849	return loadNginxModulesWithCatalog(install, "")
 850}
 851
 852func loadNginxModulesWithCatalog(install model.AppInstall, catalogPath string) ([]dto.NginxModule, error) {
 853	modulePath := path.Join(install.GetPath(), nginxModuleBuildDir, nginxModuleStoreFile)
 854	states, err := readNginxModuleStateFile(modulePath)
 855	if err != nil {
 856		return nil, err
 857	}
 858	if catalogPath == "" {
 859		catalogPath = path.Join(install.GetPath(), nginxModuleBuildDir, nginxModuleCatalogFile)
 860	}
 861	modules, err := readNginxModuleFile(catalogPath)
 862	if err != nil {
 863		return nil, err
 864	}
 865	moduleIndexes := make(map[string]int, len(modules))
 866	for i := range modules {
 867		modules[i].Custom = false
 868		modules[i].Enable = false
 869		modules[i].Builds = nil
 870		modules[i].LastError = ""
 871		if _, exists := moduleIndexes[modules[i].Name]; exists {
 872			return nil, fmt.Errorf("duplicate OpenResty module catalog name %q", modules[i].Name)
 873		}
 874		moduleIndexes[modules[i].Name] = i
 875	}
 876	stateNames := make(map[string]struct{}, len(states))
 877	for _, state := range states {
 878		if _, exists := stateNames[state.Name]; exists {
 879			return nil, fmt.Errorf("duplicate OpenResty module state name %q", state.Name)
 880		}
 881		stateNames[state.Name] = struct{}{}
 882		if index, ok := moduleIndexes[state.Name]; ok {
 883			if state.Custom {
 884				return nil, fmt.Errorf("custom OpenResty module %s conflicts with the module catalog", state.Name)
 885			}
 886			modules[index].Enable = state.Enable
 887			modules[index].Builds = state.Builds
 888			modules[index].LastError = state.LastError
 889			continue
 890		}
 891		if !state.Custom {
 892			return nil, fmt.Errorf("OpenResty module state %s is missing from the module catalog", state.Name)
 893		}
 894		modules = append(modules, dto.NginxModule{
 895			Name: state.Name, Custom: true, Script: state.Script, Packages: state.Packages, Params: state.Params,
 896			Enable: state.Enable, BuildMode: state.BuildMode, Provider: state.Provider, LoadOrder: state.LoadOrder,
 897			Builds: state.Builds, LastError: state.LastError,
 898		})
 899	}
 900	for i := range modules {
 901		if err = validateNginxModuleBuildMode(modules[i]); err != nil {
 902			return nil, err
 903		}
 904		normalizeNginxModule(&modules[i])
 905	}
 906	return modules, nil
 907}
 908
 909func readNginxModuleStateFile(filePath string) ([]nginxModuleState, error) {
 910	content, err := os.ReadFile(filePath)
 911	if err != nil {
 912		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
 913			return []nginxModuleState{}, nil
 914		}
