 949func saveNginxModulesWithCatalog(install model.AppInstall, modules []dto.NginxModule, catalogPath string) error {
 950	if catalogPath == "" {
 951		catalogPath = path.Join(install.GetPath(), nginxModuleBuildDir, nginxModuleCatalogFile)
 952	}
 953	catalog, err := readNginxModuleFile(catalogPath)
 954	if err != nil {
 955		return err
 956	}
 957	catalogNames := make(map[string]struct{}, len(catalog))
 958	for _, module := range catalog {
 959		if _, exists := catalogNames[module.Name]; exists {
 960			return fmt.Errorf("duplicate OpenResty module catalog name %q", module.Name)
 961		}
 962		catalogNames[module.Name] = struct{}{}
 963	}
 964	states := make([]nginxModuleState, 0, len(modules))
 965	for i := range modules {
 966		module := &modules[i]
 967		if err = validateNginxModuleBuildMode(*module); err != nil {
 968			return err
 969		}
 970		normalizeNginxModule(module)
 971		if _, builtin := catalogNames[module.Name]; builtin {
 972			if module.Custom {
 973				return fmt.Errorf("custom OpenResty module %s conflicts with the module catalog", module.Name)
 974			}
 975			if !module.Enable && len(module.Builds) == 0 && module.LastError == "" {
 976				continue
 977			}
 978			states = append(states, nginxModuleState{
 979				Name: module.Name, Enable: module.Enable, Builds: module.Builds, LastError: module.LastError,
 980			})
 981			continue
 982		}
 983		if !module.Custom {
 984			return fmt.Errorf("OpenResty module %s is missing from the module catalog", module.Name)
 985		}
 986		states = append(states, nginxModuleState{
 987			Name: module.Name, Custom: true, Script: module.Script, Packages: module.Packages, Params: module.Params,
 988			Enable: module.Enable, BuildMode: module.BuildMode, Provider: module.Provider, LoadOrder: module.LoadOrder,
 989			Builds: module.Builds, LastError: module.LastError,
 990		})
 991	}
 992	content, err := json.MarshalIndent(states, "", "  ")
 993	if err != nil {
 994		return err
 995	}
 996	modulePath := path.Join(install.GetPath(), nginxModuleBuildDir, nginxModuleStoreFile)
 997	if err = os.MkdirAll(path.Dir(modulePath), constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 998		return err
 999	}
1000	tmpPath := modulePath + ".tmp"
1001	if err := os.WriteFile(tmpPath, content, constant.FilePerm); err != nil {
1002		return err
1003	}
1004	return os.Rename(tmpPath, modulePath)
1005}

1156func recordStaticNginxModuleBuilds(modules []dto.NginxModule, target dto.NginxModuleTarget) ([]dto.NginxModule, error) {

1174			Status:    nginxModuleStatusReady,
1175			Hash:      buildHash,
1176			Target:    target,
1177			BuiltAt:   time.Now(),

1181	return modules, nil

1184func commitStaticNginxModuleBuilds(install model.AppInstall, catalogPath string, parentTask *task.Task) error {
1185	modules, err := loadNginxModulesWithCatalog(install, catalogPath)
1186	if err != nil || !hasEnabledStaticNginxModules(modules) {
1187		return err
1188	}
1189	status, err := checkContainerStatus(install.ContainerName)
1190	if err != nil {
1191		return err
1192	}
1193	if status != "running" {
1194		return fmt.Errorf("OpenResty container %s is not running after static module build", install.ContainerName)
1195	}
1196	if err = opNginx(install.ContainerName, constant.NginxCheck); err != nil {
1197		return err
1198	}
1199	target, targetWarning, err := resolveNginxRuntimeTarget(install)
1200	if err != nil {
1201		return err
1202	}
1203	if targetWarning != "" && parentTask != nil {
1204		parentTask.Logf("WARNING: %s", targetWarning)
1205	}
1206	modules, err = recordStaticNginxModuleBuilds(modules, target)
1207	if err != nil {
1208		return err
1209	}
1210	return saveNginxModulesWithCatalog(install, modules, catalogPath)
1211}

1213func upsertNginxModuleBuild(module *dto.NginxModule, build dto.NginxModuleBuild) {

1223func cloneNginxModules(modules []dto.NginxModule) []dto.NginxModule {
1224	cloned := make([]dto.NginxModule, len(modules))
1225	copy(cloned, modules)
1226	for i := range cloned {

1228		cloned[i].Builds = make([]dto.NginxModuleBuild, len(modules[i].Builds))
1229		copy(cloned[i].Builds, modules[i].Builds)
1230		for j := range cloned[i].Builds {

1232		}
1233	}

1235}

1237func recordNginxModuleBuildFailure(originalModules []dto.NginxModule, moduleName string, build dto.NginxModuleBuild, previousBuild *dto.NginxModuleBuild) []dto.NginxModule {
1238	failedModules := cloneNginxModules(originalModules)
1239	for i := range failedModules {
1240		if failedModules[i].Name != moduleName {
1241			continue
1242		}
1243		failedModules[i].LastError = build.Error
1244		if previousBuild == nil || previousBuild.Status != nginxModuleStatusReady {
1245			upsertNginxModuleBuild(&failedModules[i], build)
1246		}
1247		break
1248	}
1249	return failedModules
1250}

1252func recordNginxModuleActivationFailure(previousModules, candidateModules []dto.NginxModule, activationErr error) []dto.NginxModule {
1253	rollbackModules := cloneNginxModules(previousModules)
1254	candidates := make(map[string]dto.NginxModule, len(candidateModules))
1255	for _, module := range candidateModules {
1256		candidates[module.Name] = module
1257	}
1258	for i := range rollbackModules {
1259		candidate, ok := candidates[rollbackModules[i].Name]
1260		if !ok || !candidate.Enable || candidate.BuildMode == nginxModuleBuildStatic {
1261			continue
1262		}
1263		rollbackModules[i].LastError = activationErr.Error()
1264	}
1265	return rollbackModules
1266}

1268func normalizeDynamicModuleParams(params string) (string, error) {
1269	params = strings.TrimSpace(params)
1270	params = strings.ReplaceAll(params, "--add-module=", "--add-dynamic-module=")
1271	if !strings.Contains(params, "--add-dynamic-module=") && !strings.Contains(params, "=dynamic") {
1272		return "", errors.New("module does not declare a dynamic configure option")
1273	}
1274	if _, err := parseDynamicModuleParams(params); err != nil {
1275		return "", err
1276	}

1280func parseDynamicModuleParams(params string) ([]string, error) {
1281	"cmt">// shellwords silently stops at unquoted shell metacharacters instead of
1282	"cmt">// reporting them, so reject them on the raw input before parsing.
1283	if strings.ContainsAny(params, "\x00\r\n;&|<>") {
1284		return nil, errors.New("dynamic module parameters contain unsupported characters")
1285	}
1286	parser := shellwords.NewParser()
1287	parser.ParseBacktick = false
1288	parser.ParseEnv = false
1289	args, err := parser.Parse(params)
1290	if err != nil {
1291		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse dynamic module parameters: %w", err)
1292	}
1293	if len(args) == 0 {
1294		return nil, errors.New("dynamic module parameters are empty")
1295	}
1296	for _, arg := range args {
1297		if !strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--") {
1298			return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported configure argument %q", arg)
1299		}
1300		if strings.ContainsAny(arg, "\x00\r\n;&|<>") {
1301			return nil, fmt.Errorf("configure argument %q contains unsupported characters", arg)
1302		}
1303	}
1304	return args, nil
1305}

1316func nginxModuleBuildHash(module dto.NginxModule, target dto.NginxModuleTarget, params string) (string, error) {
1317	payload := struct {
1318		Name      string
1319		Script    string
1320		Packages  []string
1321		Params    string
1322		BuildMode string
1323		TargetKey string
1324		Provider  string
1325	}{module.Name, module.Script, module.Packages, params, module.BuildMode, target.Key, module.Provider}
1326	content, err := json.Marshal(payload)

1328		return "", err
1329	}
1330	sum := sha256.Sum256(content)

1332}

1345func nginxModuleOutputDirectories(install model.AppInstall, modules []dto.NginxModule) map[string]struct{} {
1346	result := make(map[string]struct{})
1347	modulesRoot := filepath.Clean(path.Join(install.GetPath(), nginxModuleModulesDir))
1348	for _, module := range modules {
1349		for _, build := range module.Builds {
1350			for _, artifact := range build.Artifacts {
1351				if !re.IsValidNginxModuleArtifact(artifact.Path) {
1352					continue
1353				}
1354				artifactFullPath := filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(modulesRoot, filepath.FromSlash(artifact.Path)))
1355				if !strings.HasPrefix(artifactFullPath, modulesRoot+string(os.PathSeparator)) {
1356					continue
1357				}
1358				outputDir := filepath.Dir(artifactFullPath)
1359				if outputDir != modulesRoot {
1360					result[outputDir] = struct{}{}
1361				}
1362			}
1363		}
1364	}
1365	return result
1366}

1368func removeNginxModuleOutputsNotReferenced(install model.AppInstall, fromModules, referencedModules []dto.NginxModule) {
1369	referenced := nginxModuleOutputDirectories(install, referencedModules)

1371		if _, ok := referenced[outputDir]; !ok {
1372			_ = os.RemoveAll(outputDir)
1373		}
1374	}
1375}

1377func sanitizeModulePathPart(value string) string {
1378	var result strings.Builder
1379	for _, char := range value {
1380		if char >= 'a' && char <= 'z' || char >= 'A' && char <= 'Z' || char >= '0' && char <= '9' || char == '.' || char == '-' || char == '_' {
1381			result.WriteRune(char)
1382		} else {
1383			result.WriteByte('-')
1384		}
1385	}
1386	return strings.Trim(result.String(), "-")
1387}
1388
1389func nginxModulePathName(value string) string {
1390	base := sanitizeModulePathPart(value)
1391	if base == "" {
1392		base = "module"
1393	}
1394	if len(base) > 48 {
1395		base = base[:48]
1396	}
1397	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(value))
1398	return fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s", base, hex.EncodeToString(sum[:4]))
1399}

  30func getNginxFull(website *model.Website) (dto.NginxFull, error) {
  31	var nginxFull dto.NginxFull
  32	nginxInstall, err := getAppInstallByKey("openresty")
  33	if err != nil {
  34		return nginxFull, err
  35	}
  36	nginxFull.Install = nginxInstall
  37	nginxFull.Dir = path.Join(global.Dir.AppInstallDir, constant.AppOpenresty, nginxInstall.Name)
  38	nginxFull.ConfigDir = path.Join(nginxFull.Dir, "conf")
  39	nginxFull.ConfigFile = "nginx.conf"
  40	nginxFull.SiteDir = path.Join(nginxFull.Dir, "www")
  41
  42	var nginxConfig dto.NginxConfig
  43	nginxConfig.FilePath = path.Join(nginxFull.Dir, "conf", "nginx.conf")
  44	content, err := os.ReadFile(path.Join(nginxFull.ConfigDir, nginxFull.ConfigFile))
  45	if err != nil {
  46		return nginxFull, err
  47	}
  48	config, err := parser.NewStringParser(string(content)).Parse()
  49	if err != nil {
  50		return dto.NginxFull{}, err
  51	}
  52	config.FilePath = nginxConfig.FilePath
  53	nginxConfig.OldContent = string(content)
  54	nginxConfig.Config = config
  55
  56	nginxFull.RootConfig = nginxConfig
  57
  58	if website != nil {
  59		nginxFull.Website = *website
  60		var siteNginxConfig dto.NginxConfig
  61		siteConfigPath := GetWebsiteConfigPath(*website)
  62		siteNginxConfig.FilePath = siteConfigPath
  63		siteNginxContent, err := os.ReadFile(siteConfigPath)
  64		if err != nil {
  65			return nginxFull, err
  66		}
  67		siteConfig, err := parser.NewStringParser(string(siteNginxContent)).Parse()
  68		if err != nil {
  69			return dto.NginxFull{}, err
  70		}
  71		siteConfig.FilePath = siteConfigPath
  72		siteNginxConfig.Config = siteConfig
  73		siteNginxConfig.OldContent = string(siteNginxContent)
  74		nginxFull.SiteConfig = siteNginxConfig
  75	}
  76
  77	return nginxFull, nil
  78}

  80func getNginxParamsByKeys(scope string, keys []string, website *model.Website) ([]response.NginxParam, error) {
  81	nginxFull, err := getNginxFull(website)
  82	if err != nil {
  83		return nil, err

  95			nginxParam := response.NginxParam{
  96				Name:   dir.GetName(),
  97				Params: dir.GetParameters(),

 100		}
 101		if len(dirs) == 0 {
 102			nginxParam := response.NginxParam{

 104				Params: []string{},
 105			}
 106			res = append(res, nginxParam)
 107		}
 108	}
 109	return res, nil
 110}

 112func updateDefaultServerConfig(enable bool) error {
 113	nginxInstall, err := getAppInstallByKey("openresty")
 114	if err != nil {
 115		return err
 116	}
 117	defaultConfigPath := path.Join(nginxInstall.GetPath(), "conf", "default", "00.default.conf")
 118	content, err := os.ReadFile(defaultConfigPath)
 119	if err != nil {
 120		return err
 121	}
 122	defaultConfig, err := parser.NewStringParser(string(content)).Parse()
 123	if err != nil {
 124		return err
 125	}
 126	defaultConfig.FilePath = defaultConfigPath
 127	defaultServer := defaultConfig.FindServers()[0]
 128
 129	includeSSL := false
 130	for _, dir := range defaultServer.GetDirectives() {
 131		if dir.GetName() == "ssl_reject_handshake" && dir.GetParameters()[0] == "on" {
 132			defaultServer.RemoveDirective("ssl_reject_handshake", []string{"on"})
 133		}
 134		if dir.GetName() == "include" && dir.GetParameters()[0] == "/usr/local/openresty/nginx/conf/ssl/root_ssl.conf" {
 135			includeSSL = true
 136		}
 137	}
 138	updateDefaultServer(defaultServer, nginxInstall.HttpPort, nginxInstall.HttpsPort, enable, includeSSL)
 139
 140	if err = nginx.WriteConfig(defaultConfig, nginx.IndentedStyle); err != nil {
 141		return err
 142	}
 143	return nginxCheckAndReload(string(content), defaultConfigPath, nginxInstall.ContainerName)
 144}

 146func updateNginxConfig(scope string, params []dto.NginxParam, website *model.Website) error {
 147	nginxFull, err := getNginxFull(website)
 148	if err != nil {
 149		return err
 150	}
 151	var block components.IBlock
 152	var config dto.NginxConfig
 153	if scope == constant.NginxScopeHttp {
 154		config = nginxFull.RootConfig
 155		block = nginxFull.RootConfig.Config.FindHttp()
 156	} else if scope == constant.NginxScopeServer {
 157		config = nginxFull.SiteConfig
 158		block = nginxFull.SiteConfig.Config.FindServers()[0]
 159	} else {
 160		config = nginxFull.SiteConfig
 161		block = config.Config.Block
 162	}
 163
 164	for _, p := range params {
 165		if p.UpdateScope == constant.NginxScopeOut {
 166			config.Config.UpdateDirective(p.Name, p.Params)
 167		} else {
 168			block.UpdateDirective(p.Name, p.Params)
 169		}
 170	}
 171	if err := nginx.WriteConfig(config.Config, nginx.IndentedStyle); err != nil {
 172		return err
 173	}
 174	return nginxCheckAndReload(config.OldContent, config.FilePath, nginxFull.Install.ContainerName)
 175}

 205func getNginxParamsFromStaticFile(scope dto.NginxKey, newParams []dto.NginxParam) []dto.NginxParam {
 206	var (
 207		newConfig = &components.Config{}
 208		err       error
 209	)
 210
 211	updateScope := "in"
 212	switch scope {
 213	case dto.SSL:
 214		newConfig, err = parser.NewStringParser(string(nginx_conf.SSL)).Parse()
 215	case dto.CACHE:
 216		newConfig, err = parser.NewStringParser(string(nginx_conf.Cache)).Parse()
 217	case dto.ProxyCache:
 218		newConfig, err = parser.NewStringParser(string(nginx_conf.ProxyCache)).Parse()
 219	}
 220	if err != nil {
 221		return nil
 222	}
 223	for _, dir := range newConfig.GetDirectives() {
 224		addParam := dto.NginxParam{
 225			Name:        dir.GetName(),
 226			Params:      dir.GetParameters(),
 227			UpdateScope: updateScope,
 228		}
 229		isExist := false
 230		for _, newParam := range newParams {
 231			if newParam.Name == dir.GetName() {
 232				if components.IsRepeatKey(newParam.Name) {
 233					if len(newParam.Params) > 0 && newParam.Params[0] == dir.GetParameters()[0] {
 234						isExist = true
 235					}
 236				} else {
 237					isExist = true
 238				}
 239			}
 240		}
 241		if !isExist {
 242			newParams = append(newParams, addParam)
 243		}
 244	}
 245	return newParams
 246}

 248func opNginx(containerName, operate string) error {
 249	cmdMgr := cmd.NewCommandMgr(cmd.WithTimeout(20 * time.Second))
 250	if operate == constant.NginxCheck {
 251		return cmdMgr.Run("docker", "exec", "-i", containerName, "nginx", "-t")
 252	}
 253	return cmdMgr.Run("docker", "exec", "-i", containerName, "nginx", "-s", "reload")
 254}
 255
 256func nginxCheckAndReload(oldContent string, filePath string, containerName string) error {
 257	if err := opNginx(containerName, constant.NginxCheck); err != nil {
 258		_ = files.NewFileOp().WriteFile(filePath, strings.NewReader(oldContent), constant.DirPerm)
 259		return err
 260	}
 261	if err := opNginx(containerName, constant.NginxReload); err != nil {
 262		_ = files.NewFileOp().WriteFile(filePath, strings.NewReader(oldContent), constant.DirPerm)
 263		return err
 264	}
 265	return nil
 266}

 268func updateDefaultServer(server *components.Server, httpPort int, httpsPort int, defaultServer bool, ssl bool) {
 269	server.UpdateListen(fmt.Sprintf("%d", httpPort), defaultServer)
 270	server.UpdateListen(fmt.Sprintf("[::]:%d", httpPort), defaultServer)
 271	if ssl {
 272		server.UpdateListen(fmt.Sprintf("%d", httpsPort), defaultServer, "ssl")
 273		server.UpdateListen(fmt.Sprintf("[::]:%d", httpsPort), defaultServer, "ssl")
 274		server.UpdateListen(fmt.Sprintf("%d", httpsPort), defaultServer, "quic", "reuseport")
 275		server.UpdateListen(fmt.Sprintf("[::]:%d", httpsPort), defaultServer, "quic", "reuseport")
 276	}
 277}

  58func buildRedirectHostPattern(domain string) string {
  59	labels := strings.Split(domain, ".")
  60	patternLabels := make([]string, 0, len(labels))
  61	for _, label := range labels {
  62		if label == "*" {
  63			patternLabels = append(patternLabels, `[^.]+`)
  64			continue
  65		}
  66		patternLabels = append(patternLabels, regexp.QuoteMeta(label))
  67	}
  68	return fmt.Sprintf("^%s$", strings.Join(patternLabels, `\.`))
  69}
  70
  71func parseRedirectHostPattern(pattern string) string {
  72	pattern = strings.Trim(pattern, "'")
  73	pattern = strings.TrimPrefix(pattern, "^")
  74	pattern = strings.TrimSuffix(pattern, "$")
  75	pattern = strings.ReplaceAll(pattern, `[^.]+`, "*")
  76	pattern = strings.ReplaceAll(pattern, `\.`, ".")
  77	return pattern
  78}

 171func (w WebsiteService) PageWebsite(req request.WebsiteSearch) (int64, []response.WebsiteRes, error) {
 172	var (
 173		websiteDTOs []response.WebsiteRes
 174		opts        []repo.DBOption
 175	)
 176	opts = append(
 177		opts,
 178		repo.WithOrderRuleBy(req.OrderBy, req.Order),
 179		repo.WithOrderRuleBy("created_at", "descending"),
 180		repo.WithOrderRuleBy("id", "descending"),
 181	)
 182	if req.Name != "" {
 183		domains, _ := websiteDomainRepo.GetBy(websiteDomainRepo.WithDomainLike(req.Name))
 184		var websiteIds []uint
 185		if len(domains) > 0 {
 186			for _, domain := range domains {
 187				websiteIds = append(websiteIds, domain.WebsiteID)
 188			}
 189		}
 190		opts = append(opts, websiteRepo.WithSearchKeyword(req.Name, websiteIds))
 191	}
 192	if req.WebsiteGroupID != 0 {
 193		opts = append(opts, websiteRepo.WithGroupID(req.WebsiteGroupID))
 194	}
 195	if req.Type != "" {
 196		opts = append(opts, websiteRepo.WithType(req.Type))
 197	}
 198	total, websites, err := websiteRepo.Page(req.Page, req.PageSize, opts...)
 199	if err != nil {
 200		return 0, nil, err
 201	}
 202	for _, web := range websites {
 203		var (
 204			appName      string
 205			runtimeName  string
 206			runtimeType  string
 207			appInstallID uint
 208		)
 209		switch web.Type {
 210		case constant.Deployment:
 211			appInstall, err := appInstallRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(web.AppInstallID))
 212			if err == nil {
 213				appName = appInstall.Name
 214				appInstallID = appInstall.ID
 215			}
 216		case constant.Runtime:
 217			runtime, _ := runtimeRepo.GetFirst(context.Background(), repo.WithByID(web.RuntimeID))
 218			if runtime != nil {
 219				runtimeName = runtime.Name
 220				runtimeType = runtime.Type
 221			}
 222		}
 223		sitePath := GetSitePath(web, SiteDir)
 224
 225		siteDTO := response.WebsiteRes{
 226			ID:            web.ID,
 227			CreatedAt:     web.CreatedAt,
 228			Protocol:      web.Protocol,
 229			PrimaryDomain: web.PrimaryDomain,
 230			Type:          web.Type,
 231			Remark:        web.Remark,
 232			Status:        web.Status,
 233			Alias:         web.Alias,
 234			AppName:       appName,
 235			ExpireDate:    web.ExpireDate,
 236			SSLExpireDate: web.WebsiteSSL.ExpireDate,
 237			SSLStatus:     checkSSLStatus(web.WebsiteSSL.ExpireDate),
 238			RuntimeName:   runtimeName,
 239			SitePath:      sitePath,
 240			AppInstallID:  appInstallID,
 241			RuntimeType:   runtimeType,
 242			Favorite:      web.Favorite,
 243			IPV6:          web.IPV6,
 244		}
 245
 246		if siteDTO.Type == constant.Subsite {
 247			parentWeb, _ := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(web.ParentWebsiteID))
 248			if parentWeb.ID != 0 {
 249				siteDTO.ParentSite = parentWeb.PrimaryDomain
 250			}
 251		}
 252
 253		sites, _ := websiteRepo.List(websiteRepo.WithParentID(web.ID))
 254		if len(sites) > 0 {
 255			for _, site := range sites {
 256				siteDTO.ChildSites = append(siteDTO.ChildSites, site.PrimaryDomain)
 257			}
 258		}
 259		websiteDTOs = append(websiteDTOs, siteDTO)
 260	}
 261	return total, websiteDTOs, nil
 262}

 276func (w WebsiteService) CreateWebsite(create request.WebsiteCreate) (err error) {
 277	alias := create.Alias
 278	if alias == "default" {
 279		return buserr.New("ErrDefaultAlias")
 280	}
 281	if common.ContainsChinese(alias) {
 282		alias, err = common.PunycodeEncode(alias)
 283		if err != nil {
 284			return
 285		}
 286	}
 287	if exist, _ := websiteRepo.GetBy(websiteRepo.WithAlias(alias)); len(exist) > 0 {
 288		return buserr.New("ErrAliasIsExist")
 289	}
 290	if len(create.FtpPassword) != 0 {
 291		pass, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(create.FtpPassword)
 292		if err != nil {
 293			return err
 294		}
 295		create.FtpPassword = string(pass)
 296	}
 297
 298	nginxInstall, err := getAppInstallByKey(constant.AppOpenresty)
 299	if err != nil {
 300		return err
 301	}
 302	defaultHttpPort := nginxInstall.HttpPort
 303	defaultDate, _ := time.Parse(constant.DateLayout, constant.WebsiteDefaultExpireDate)
 304
 305	website := &model.Website{
 306		Type:           create.Type,
 307		Alias:          alias,
 308		Remark:         create.Remark,
 309		Status:         constant.WebRunning,
 310		ExpireDate:     defaultDate,
 311		WebsiteGroupID: create.WebsiteGroupID,
 312		Proxy:          create.Proxy,
 313		SiteDir:        "/",
 314		AccessLog:      true,
 315		ErrorLog:       true,
 316		IPV6:           create.IPV6,
 317	}
 318
 319	var (
 320		domains       []model.WebsiteDomain
 321		appInstall    *model.AppInstall
 322		runtime       *model.Runtime
 323		primaryDomain string
 324	)
 325	if website.Type == constant.Stream {
 326		if create.StreamConfig.StreamPorts == "" {
 327			return buserr.New("ErrTypePortRange")
 328		}
 329		website.PrimaryDomain = create.Name
 330		website.Protocol = constant.ProtocolStream
 331		website.StreamPorts = create.StreamConfig.StreamPorts
 332		ports := strings.Split(create.StreamConfig.StreamPorts, ",")
 333		for _, port := range ports {
 334			portNum, _ := strconv.Atoi(port)
 335			if err = checkWebsitePort(nginxInstall.HttpsPort, portNum, website.Type); err != nil {
 336				return err
 337			}
 338		}
 339	} else {
 340		domains, _, _, err = getWebsiteDomains(create.Domains, defaultHttpPort, nginxInstall.HttpsPort, 0)
 341		if err != nil {
 342			return err
 343		}
 344		primaryDomain = domains[0].Domain
 345		if domains[0].Port != defaultHttpPort {
 346			primaryDomain = fmt.Sprintf("%s:%v", domains[0].Domain, domains[0].Port)
 347		}
 348		website.PrimaryDomain = primaryDomain
 349		website.Protocol = constant.ProtocolHTTP
 350	}
 351
 352	createTask, err := task.NewTaskWithOps(website.PrimaryDomain, task.TaskCreate, task.TaskScopeWebsite, create.TaskID, 0)
 353	if err != nil {
 354		return err
 355	}
 356
 357	if create.CreateDb {
 358		createDataBase := func(t *task.Task) error {
 359			database, _ := databaseRepo.Get(repo.WithByName(create.DbHost))
 360			if database.ID == 0 {
 361				return nil
 362			}
 363			dbConfig := create.DataBaseConfig
 364			switch database.Type {
 365			case constant.AppPostgresql, constant.AppPostgres:
 366				oldPostgresqlDb, _ := postgresqlRepo.Get(repo.WithByName(create.DbName), repo.WithByFrom(constant.ResourceLocal))
 367				if oldPostgresqlDb.ID > 0 {
 368					return buserr.New("ErrDbUserNotValid")
 369				}
 370				var createPostgresql dto.PostgresqlDBCreate
 371				createPostgresql.Name = dbConfig.DbName
 372				createPostgresql.Username = dbConfig.DbUser
 373				createPostgresql.Database = database.Name
 374				createPostgresql.Format = dbConfig.DBFormat
 375				createPostgresql.Password = dbConfig.DbPassword
 376				createPostgresql.From = database.From
 377				createPostgresql.SuperUser = true
 378				pgDB, err := NewIPostgresqlService().Create(context.Background(), createPostgresql)
 379				if err != nil {
 380					return err
 381				}
 382				website.DbID = pgDB.ID
 383				website.DbType = database.Type
 384			case constant.AppMysql, constant.AppMariaDB:
 385				oldMysqlDb, _ := mysqlRepo.Get(repo.WithByName(dbConfig.DbName), repo.WithByFrom(constant.ResourceLocal))
 386				if oldMysqlDb.ID > 0 {
 387					return buserr.New("ErrDbUserNotValid")
 388				}
 389				var createMysql dto.MysqlDBCreate
 390				createMysql.Name = dbConfig.DbName
 391				createMysql.Username = dbConfig.DbUser
 392				createMysql.Database = database.Name
 393				createMysql.Format = dbConfig.DBFormat
 394				createMysql.Permission = "%"
 395				createMysql.Password = dbConfig.DbPassword
 396				createMysql.From = database.From
 397				mysqlDB, err := NewIMysqlService().Create(context.Background(), createMysql)
 398				if err != nil {
 399					return err
 400				}
 401				website.DbID = mysqlDB.ID
 402				website.DbType = database.Type
 403			}
 404			return nil
 405		}
 406		createTask.AddSubTask(task.GetTaskName(create.DbName, task.TaskCreate, task.TaskScopeDatabase), createDataBase, nil)
 407	}
 408
 409	var proxy string
 410	switch create.Type {
 411	case constant.Deployment:
 412		if create.AppType == constant.NewApp {
 413			var (
 414				req     request.AppInstallCreate
 415				install *model.AppInstall
 416			)
 417			appDetail, err := appDetailRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(create.AppInstall.AppDetailId))
 418			if err != nil {
 419				return err
 420			}
 421			app, err := appRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(appDetail.AppId))
 422			if err != nil {
 423				return err
 424			}
 425			if isAgentAppKey(app.Key) {
 426				return fmt.Errorf("%s does not support website deployment", app.Key)
 427			}
 428			req.Name = create.AppInstall.Name
 429			req.AppDetailId = create.AppInstall.AppDetailId
 430			req.Params = create.AppInstall.Params
 431			req.AppContainerConfig = create.AppInstall.AppContainerConfig
 432			install, err = NewIAppService().Install(req, true)
 433			if err != nil {
 434				return err
 435			}
 436			appInstall = install
 437			website.AppInstallID = install.ID
 438			website.Proxy, err = getAppInstallProxyPass(appInstall)
 439			if err != nil {
 440				return err
 441			}
 442		} else {
 443			var install model.AppInstall
 444			install, err = appInstallRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(create.AppInstallID))
 445			if err != nil {
 446				return err
 447			}
 448			configApp := func(t *task.Task) error {
 449				appInstall = &install
 450				website.AppInstallID = appInstall.ID
 451				website.Proxy, err = getAppInstallProxyPass(appInstall)
 452				if err != nil {
 453					return err
 454				}
 455				return nil
 456			}
 457			createTask.AddSubTask(i18n.GetMsgByKey("ConfigApp"), configApp, nil)
 458		}
 459	case constant.Runtime:
 460		runtime, err = runtimeRepo.GetFirst(context.Background(), repo.WithByID(create.RuntimeID))
 461		if err != nil {
 462			return err
 463		}
 464		website.RuntimeID = runtime.ID
 465
 466		switch runtime.Type {
 467		case constant.RuntimePHP:
 468			if runtime.Resource == constant.ResourceAppstore {
 469				if !checkImageLike(nil, runtime.Image) {
 470					return buserr.WithName("ErrImageNotExist", runtime.Name)
 471				}
 472				website.Proxy = fmt.Sprintf("127.0.0.1:%s", runtime.Port)
 473			} else {
 474				website.ProxyType = create.ProxyType
 475				if website.ProxyType == constant.RuntimeProxyUnix {
 476					proxy = fmt.Sprintf("unix:%s", path.Join("/www/sites", website.Alias, "php-pool", "php-fpm.sock"))
 477				}
 478				if website.ProxyType == constant.RuntimeProxyTcp {
 479					proxy = fmt.Sprintf("127.0.0.1:%d", create.Port)
 480				}
 481				website.Proxy = proxy
 482			}
 483		case constant.RuntimeNode, constant.RuntimeJava, constant.RuntimeGo, constant.RuntimePython, constant.RuntimeDotNet:
 484			proxyPort := runtime.Port
 485			if proxyPort == "" {
 486				return buserr.New("ErrRuntimeNoPort")
 487			}
 488			proxyPort = strconv.Itoa(create.Port)
 489			website.Proxy = fmt.Sprintf("127.0.0.1:%s", proxyPort)
 490		}
 491	case constant.Subsite:
 492		parentWebsite, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(create.ParentWebsiteID))
 493		if err != nil {
 494			return err
 495		}
 496		website.ParentWebsiteID = parentWebsite.ID
 497		website.SiteDir = create.SiteDir
 498	}
 499
 500	configNginx := func(t *task.Task) error {
 501		if err = configDefaultNginx(website, domains, appInstall, runtime, create.StreamConfig); err != nil {
 502			return err
 503		}
 504		if create.Type == constant.Static && create.TemplateOutputID > 0 {
 505			templateOutput, err := websiteTemplateOutputRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(create.TemplateOutputID))
 506			if err != nil {
 507				return err
 508			}
 509			if templateOutput.OutputPath == "" {
 510				return buserr.New("ErrFileNotFound")
 511			}
 512			if _, err := os.Stat(templateOutput.OutputPath); err != nil {
 513				return buserr.New("ErrFileNotFound")
 514			}
 515			if err := copyDir(templateOutput.OutputPath, GetSitePath(*website, SiteIndexDir)); err != nil {
 516				return err
 517			}
 518		}
 519		if website.Type != constant.Stream {
 520			if err = createWafConfig(website, domains); err != nil {
 521				return err
 522			}
 523			if create.Type == constant.Runtime {
 524				runtime, err = runtimeRepo.GetFirst(context.Background(), repo.WithByID(create.RuntimeID))
 525				if err != nil {
 526					return err
 527				}
 528				if runtime.Type == constant.RuntimePHP && runtime.Resource == constant.ResourceAppstore {
 529					createOpenBasedirConfig(website)
 530				}
 531			}
 532		}
 533
 534		tx, ctx := helper.GetTxAndContext()
 535		defer tx.Rollback()
 536		if err = websiteRepo.Create(ctx, website); err != nil {
 537			return err
 538		}
 539		t.Task.ResourceID = website.ID
 540		if len(domains) > 0 {
 541			for i := range domains {
 542				domains[i].WebsiteID = website.ID
 543			}
 544			if err = websiteDomainRepo.BatchCreate(ctx, domains); err != nil {
 545				return err
 546			}
 547		}
 548
 549		tx.Commit()
 550		return nil
 551	}
 552
 553	deleteWebsite := func(t *task.Task) {
 554		_ = deleteWebsiteFolder(website)
 555	}
 556
 557	createTask.AddSubTask(i18n.GetMsgByKey("ConfigOpenresty"), configNginx, deleteWebsite)
 558
 559	if create.EnableSSL {
 560		enableSSL := func(t *task.Task) error {
 561			websiteModel, err := websiteSSLRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(create.WebsiteSSLID))
 562			if err != nil {
 563				return err
 564			}
 565			website.Protocol = constant.ProtocolHTTPS
 566			website.WebsiteSSLID = create.WebsiteSSLID
 567			appSSLReq := request.WebsiteHTTPSOp{
 568				WebsiteID:             website.ID,
 569				Enable:                true,
 570				WebsiteSSLID:          websiteModel.ID,
 571				Type:                  "existed",
 572				HttpConfig:            "HTTPToHTTPS",
 573				SSLProtocol:           []string{"TLSv1.3", "TLSv1.2"},
 574				Algorithm:             "ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-ECDSA-CHACHA20-POLY1305:ECDHE-RSA-CHACHA20-POLY1305:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:DHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:DHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256:!aNULL:!eNULL:!EXPORT:!DSS:!DES:!RC4:!3DES:!MD5:!PSK:!KRB5:!SRP:!CAMELLIA:!SEED",
 575				Hsts:                  true,
 576				HstsIncludeSubDomains: true,
 577			}
 578			if err = applySSL(website, *websiteModel, appSSLReq); err != nil {
 579				return err
 580			}
 581			if err = websiteRepo.Save(context.Background(), website); err != nil {
 582				return err
 583			}
 584			return nil
 585		}
 586		createTask.AddSubTaskWithIgnoreErr(i18n.GetMsgByKey("EnableSSL"), enableSSL)
 587	}
 588
 589	if len(create.FtpUser) != 0 && len(create.FtpPassword) != 0 {
 590		createFtpUser := func(t *task.Task) error {
 591			indexDir := GetSitePath(*website, SiteIndexDir)
 592			itemID, err := NewIFtpService().CreateWebsite(dto.FtpCreate{User: create.FtpUser, Password: create.FtpPassword, Path: indexDir})
 593			if err != nil {
 594				return err
 595			}
 596			website.FtpID = itemID
 597			return nil
 598		}
 599		createTask.AddSubTaskWithIgnoreErr(i18n.GetWithName("ConfigFTP", create.FtpUser), createFtpUser)
 600	}
 601
 602	if err := createTask.Execute(); err != nil {
 603		return err
 604	}
 605	if err := bindDeploymentWebsiteToAgentByAppInstall(website); err != nil {
 606		global.LOG.Errorf("bind deployment website to agent failed: %v", err)
 607	}
 608	return nil
 609}

 668func (w WebsiteService) GetWebsite(id uint) (response.WebsiteDTO, error) {
 669	var res response.WebsiteDTO
 670	website, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(id))
 671	if err != nil {
 672		return res, err
 673	}
 674	res.Website = website
 675	res.ErrorLogPath = GetSitePath(website, SiteErrorLog)
 676	res.AccessLogPath = GetSitePath(website, SiteAccessLog)
 677	res.SitePath = GetSitePath(website, SiteDir)
 678	res.SiteDir = website.SiteDir
 679	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
 680	switch website.Type {
 681	case constant.Runtime:
 682		runtime, err := runtimeRepo.GetFirst(context.Background(), repo.WithByID(website.RuntimeID))
 683		if err != nil {
 684			return res, err
 685		}
 686		res.RuntimeType = runtime.Type
 687		res.RuntimeName = runtime.Name
 688		if runtime.Type == constant.RuntimePHP {
 689			res.OpenBaseDir = fileOp.Stat(path.Join(GetSitePath(website, SiteIndexDir), ".user.ini"))
 690		}
 691	case constant.Stream:
 692		nginxParser, err := parser.NewParser(GetSitePath(website, StreamConf))
 693		if err != nil {
 694			return res, err
 695		}
 696		config, err := nginxParser.Parse()
 697		if err != nil {
 698			return res, err
 699		}
 700		listens := config.FindDirectives("listen")
 701		for _, listen := range listens {
 702			params := listen.GetParameters()
 703			if len(params) > 1 && params[1] == "udp" {
 704				res.UDP = true
 705			}
 706		}
 707		upstreams := config.FindUpstreams()
 708		for _, up := range upstreams {
 709			directives := up.GetDirectives()
 710			for _, d := range directives {
 711				dName := d.GetName()
 712				if _, ok := dto.LBAlgorithms[dName]; ok {
 713					res.Algorithm = dName
 714					break
 715				}
 716			}
 717			res.Servers = getNginxUpstreamServers(up.UpstreamServers)
 718		}
 719	}
 720	return res, nil
 721}

 723func (w WebsiteService) DeleteWebsite(req request.WebsiteDelete) error {
 724	website, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.ID))
 725	if err != nil {
 726		return err
 727	}
 728	if website.Type != constant.Subsite {
 729		parentWebsites, _ := websiteRepo.List(websiteRepo.WithParentID(website.ID))
 730		if len(parentWebsites) > 0 {
 731			var names []string
 732			for _, site := range parentWebsites {
 733				names = append(names, site.PrimaryDomain)
 734			}
 735			return buserr.WithName("ErrParentWebsite", strings.Join(names, ","))
 736		}
 737	}
 738
 739	if website.Type == constant.Runtime && req.DeleteDB && website.DbID != 0 {
 740		switch website.DbType {
 741		case constant.AppMysql, constant.AppMariaDB:
 742			mysqlDB, _ := mysqlRepo.Get(repo.WithByID(website.DbID))
 743			if mysqlDB.ID > 0 {
 744				deleteReq := dto.MysqlDBDelete{
 745					ID:          mysqlDB.ID,
 746					Type:        website.DbType,
 747					Database:    mysqlDB.MysqlName,
 748					ForceDelete: req.ForceDelete,
 749				}
 750				if err = deleteMysqlDatabaseForResourceOwner(
 751					context.TODO(),
 752					deleteReq,
 753					dto.DBResource{Type: constant.TypeWebsite, Name: website.PrimaryDomain},
 754				); err != nil {
 755					if isMysqlDatabaseResourceInUseError(err) || !req.ForceDelete {
 756						return err
 757					}
 758				}
 759			}
 760		case constant.AppPostgresql, constant.AppPostgres:
 761			pgDB, _ := postgresqlRepo.Get(repo.WithByID(website.DbID))
 762			if pgDB.ID > 0 {
 763				deleteReq := dto.PostgresqlDBDelete{
 764					ID:          pgDB.ID,
 765					ForceDelete: req.ForceDelete,
 766					Database:    pgDB.PostgresqlName,
 767				}
 768				if err = NewIPostgresqlService().Delete(context.TODO(), deleteReq); err != nil && !req.ForceDelete {
 769					return err
 770				}
 771			}
 772		}
 773	}
 774
 775	if err = delNginxConfig(website, req.ForceDelete); err != nil {
 776		return err
 777	}
 778
 779	if website.Type != constant.Stream {
 780		if err = delWafConfig(website, req.ForceDelete); err != nil {
 781			return err
 782		}
 783	}
 784
 785	if checkIsLinkApp(website) && req.DeleteApp {
 786		appInstall, _ := appInstallRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(website.AppInstallID))
 787		if appInstall.ID > 0 {
 788			deleteReq := request.AppInstallDelete{
 789				Install:      appInstall,
 790				ForceDelete:  req.ForceDelete,
 791				DeleteBackup: true,
 792				DeleteDB:     true,
 793			}
 794			if err = deleteAppInstall(deleteReq); err != nil && !req.ForceDelete {
 795				return err
 796			}
 797		}
 798	}
 799
 800	tx, ctx := helper.GetTxAndContext()
 801	defer tx.Rollback()
 802
 803	go func() {
 804		_ = NewIBackupRecordService().DeleteRecordByName("website", website.PrimaryDomain, website.Alias, req.DeleteBackup)
 805	}()
 806
 807	if err := websiteRepo.DeleteBy(ctx, repo.WithByID(req.ID)); err != nil {
 808		return err
 809	}
 810	if err := agentRepo.ClearWebsiteIDByWebsiteIDWithCtx(ctx, req.ID); err != nil {
 811		return err
 812	}
 813	if err := websiteDomainRepo.DeleteBy(ctx, websiteDomainRepo.WithWebsiteId(req.ID)); err != nil {
 814		return err
 815	}
 816	tx.Commit()
 817
 818	uploadDir := path.Join(global.Dir.DataDir, "uploads/website", website.Alias)
 819	if _, err := os.Stat(uploadDir); err == nil {
 820		_ = os.RemoveAll(uploadDir)
 821	}
 822	return nil
 823}

 825func (w WebsiteService) UpdateWebsiteDomain(req request.WebsiteDomainUpdate) error {
 826	domain, err := websiteDomainRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.ID))
 827	if err != nil {
 828		return err
 829	}
 830	domain.SSL = req.SSL
 831	website, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(domain.WebsiteID))
 832	if err != nil {
 833		return err
 834	}
 835	nginxFull, err := getNginxFull(&website)
 836	if err != nil {
 837		return nil
 838	}
 839	nginxConfig := nginxFull.SiteConfig
 840	config := nginxFull.SiteConfig.Config
 841	server := config.FindServers()[0]
 842	server.DeleteListen(strconv.Itoa(domain.Port))
 843	if website.IPV6 {
 844		server.DeleteListen("[::]:" + strconv.Itoa(domain.Port))
 845	}
 846	http3 := isHttp3(server)
 847	setListen(server, strconv.Itoa(domain.Port), website.IPV6, http3, website.DefaultServer, domain.SSL && website.Protocol == constant.ProtocolHTTPS)
 848	if err = nginx.WriteConfig(config, nginx.IndentedStyle); err != nil {
 849		return err
 850	}
 851	if err = nginxCheckAndReload(nginxConfig.OldContent, nginxConfig.FilePath, nginxFull.Install.ContainerName); err != nil {
 852		return err
 853	}
 854	return websiteDomainRepo.Save(context.TODO(), &domain)
 855}

 878func (w WebsiteService) UpdateNginxConfigByScope(req request.NginxConfigUpdate) error {

 925func (w WebsiteService) GetWebsiteHTTPS(websiteId uint) (response.WebsiteHTTPS, error) {
 926	website, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(websiteId))
 927	if err != nil {
 928		return response.WebsiteHTTPS{}, err
 929	}
 930	var (
 931		res        response.WebsiteHTTPS
 932		httpsPorts []string
 933	)
 934
 935	httpsPortsMap := getHttpsPort(websiteId)
 936	for port := range httpsPortsMap {
 937		httpsPorts = append(httpsPorts, strconv.Itoa(port))
 938	}
 939	res.HttpsPort = strings.Join(httpsPorts, ",")
 940	if website.WebsiteSSLID == 0 {
 941		res.Enable = false
 942		return res, nil
 943	}
 944	websiteSSL, err := websiteSSLRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(website.WebsiteSSLID))
 945	if err != nil {
 946		return response.WebsiteHTTPS{}, err
 947	}
 948	res.SSL = *websiteSSL
 949	res.Enable = true
 950	if website.HttpConfig != "" {
 951		res.HttpConfig = website.HttpConfig
 952	} else {
 953		res.HttpConfig = constant.HTTPToHTTPS
 954	}
 955	params, err := getNginxParamsByKeys(constant.NginxScopeServer, []string{"ssl_protocols", "ssl_ciphers", "add_header", "listen"}, &website)
 956	if err != nil {
 957		return res, err
 958	}
 959	for _, p := range params {
 960		if p.Name == "ssl_protocols" {
 961			res.SSLProtocol = p.Params
 962		}
 963		if p.Name == "ssl_ciphers" {
 964			res.Algorithm = p.Params[0]
 965		}
 966		if p.Name == "add_header" && len(p.Params) > 0 {
 967			if p.Params[0] == "Strict-Transport-Security" {
 968				res.Hsts = true
 969				if len(p.Params) > 1 {
 970					hstsValue := p.Params[1]
 971					if strings.Contains(hstsValue, "includeSubDomains") {
 972						res.HstsIncludeSubDomains = true
 973					}
 974				}
 975			}
 976			if p.Params[0] == "Alt-Svc" {
 977				res.Http3 = true
 978			}
 979		}
 980	}
 981	return res, nil
 982}
 983
 984func (w WebsiteService) OpWebsiteHTTPS(ctx context.Context, req request.WebsiteHTTPSOp) (*response.WebsiteHTTPS, error) {
 985	website, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.WebsiteID))
 986	if err != nil {
 987		return nil, err
 988	}
 989	var (
 990		res        response.WebsiteHTTPS
 991		websiteSSL model.WebsiteSSL
 992	)
 993	if err = ChangeHSTSConfig(req.Hsts, req.HstsIncludeSubDomains, req.Http3, website); err != nil {
 994		return nil, err
 995	}
 996	res.Enable = req.Enable
 997	res.SSLProtocol = req.SSLProtocol
 998	res.Algorithm = req.Algorithm
 999	res.HstsIncludeSubDomains = req.HstsIncludeSubDomains
1000	if !req.Enable {
1001		website.Protocol = constant.ProtocolHTTP
1002		website.WebsiteSSLID = 0
1003
1004		websiteDomains, _ := websiteDomainRepo.GetBy(websiteDomainRepo.WithWebsiteId(website.ID))
1005
1006		ports := make(map[int]struct{})
1007		for _, domain := range websiteDomains {
1008			ports[domain.Port] = struct{}{}
1009		}
1010		for port := range ports {
1011			if err = removeSSLListen(website, []string{strconv.Itoa(port)}); err != nil {
1012				return nil, err
1013			}
1014		}
1015		nginxInstall, err := getAppInstallByKey(constant.AppOpenresty)
1016		if err != nil {
1017			return nil, err
1018		}
1019		if _, ok := ports[nginxInstall.HttpsPort]; !ok {
1020			httpsPortStr := strconv.Itoa(nginxInstall.HttpsPort)
1021			if err = deleteListenAndServerName(website, []string{httpsPortStr, "[::]:" + httpsPortStr}, []string{}); err != nil {
1022				return nil, err
1023			}
1024		}
1025		nginxParams := getNginxParamsFromStaticFile(dto.SSL, nil)
1026		nginxParams = append(nginxParams,
1027			dto.NginxParam{
1028				Name:   "if",
1029				Params: []string{"($scheme", "=", "http)"},
1030			},
1031			dto.NginxParam{
1032				Name: "ssl_certificate",
1033			},
1034			dto.NginxParam{
1035				Name: "ssl_certificate_key",
1036			},
1037			dto.NginxParam{
1038				Name: "ssl_protocols",
1039			},
1040			dto.NginxParam{
1041				Name: "ssl_ciphers",
1042			},
1043			dto.NginxParam{
1044				Name: "http2",
1045			},
1046			dto.NginxParam{
1047				Name:   "add_header",
1048				Params: []string{"Strict-Transport-Security"},
1049			},
1050		)
1051		if err = deleteNginxConfig(constant.NginxScopeServer, nginxParams, &website); err != nil {
1052			return nil, err
1053		}
1054		if err = websiteRepo.Save(ctx, &website); err != nil {
1055			return nil, err
1056		}
1057		return nil, nil
1058	}
1059
1060	if req.Type == constant.SSLExisted {
1061		websiteModel, err := websiteSSLRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.WebsiteSSLID))
1062		if err != nil {
1063			return nil, err
1064		}
1065		if websiteModel.Pem == "" {
1066			return nil, buserr.New("ErrSSLValid")
1067		}
1068		website.WebsiteSSLID = websiteModel.ID
1069		res.SSL = *websiteModel
1070		websiteSSL = *websiteModel
1071	}
1072	if req.Type == constant.SSLManual {
1073		websiteSSL, err = getManualWebsiteSSL(req)
1074		if err != nil {
1075			return nil, err
1076		}
1077		res.SSL = websiteSSL
1078	}
1079
1080	website.Protocol = constant.ProtocolHTTPS
1081	if err = applySSL(&website, websiteSSL, req); err != nil {
1082		return nil, err
1083	}
1084	website.HttpConfig = req.HttpConfig
1085
1086	if websiteSSL.ID == 0 {
1087		if err = websiteSSLRepo.Create(ctx, &websiteSSL); err != nil {
1088			return nil, err
1089		}
1090		website.WebsiteSSLID = websiteSSL.ID
1091	}
1092	if err = websiteRepo.Save(ctx, &website); err != nil {
1093		return nil, err
1094	}
1095	return &res, nil
1096}

1098func (w WebsiteService) PreInstallCheck(req request.WebsiteInstallCheckReq) ([]response.WebsitePreInstallCheck, error) {
1099	var (
1100		res      []response.WebsitePreInstallCheck
1101		checkIds []uint
1102		showErr  = false
1103	)
1104
1105	app, err := appRepo.GetFirst(appRepo.WithKey(constant.AppOpenresty))
1106	if err != nil {
1107		return nil, err
1108	}
1109	appInstall, _ := appInstallRepo.GetFirst(appInstallRepo.WithAppId(app.ID))
1110	if reflect.DeepEqual(appInstall, model.AppInstall{}) {
1111		res = append(res, response.WebsitePreInstallCheck{
1112			Name:    appInstall.Name,
1113			AppName: app.Name,
1114			Status:  buserr.WithDetail("ErrNotInstall", app.Name, nil).Error(),
1115			Version: appInstall.Version,
1116		})
1117		showErr = true
1118	} else {
1119		checkIds = append(req.InstallIds, appInstall.ID)
1120	}
1121	if len(checkIds) > 0 {
1122		installList, _ := appInstallRepo.ListBy(context.Background(), repo.WithByIDs(checkIds))
1123		for _, install := range installList {
1124			if err = syncAppInstallStatus(&install, false); err != nil {
1125				return nil, err
1126			}
1127			res = append(res, response.WebsitePreInstallCheck{
1128				Name:    install.Name,
1129				Status:  install.Status,
1130				Version: install.Version,
1131				AppName: install.App.Name,
1132			})
1133			if install.Status != constant.StatusRunning {
1134				showErr = true
1135			}
1136		}
1137	}
1138	if showErr {
1139		return res, nil
1140	}
1141	return nil, nil
1142}

1193func (w WebsiteService) OpWebsiteLog(req request.WebsiteLogReq) error {
1194	website, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.ID))
1195	if err != nil {
1196		return err
1197	}
1198	sitePath := GetSitePath(website, SiteDir)
1199	switch req.Operate {
1200	case constant.DisableLog:
1201		params := dto.NginxParam{}
1202		switch req.LogType {
1203		case constant.AccessLog:
1204			params.Name = "access_log"
1205			params.Params = []string{"off"}
1206			website.AccessLog = false
1207		case constant.ErrorLog:
1208			params.Name = "error_log"
1209			params.Params = []string{"/dev/null", "crit"}
1210			website.ErrorLog = false
1211		}
1212		var nginxParams []dto.NginxParam
1213		nginxParams = append(nginxParams, params)
1214
1215		if err := updateNginxConfig(constant.NginxScopeServer, nginxParams, &website); err != nil {
1216			return err
1217		}
1218		if err := websiteRepo.Save(context.Background(), &website); err != nil {
1219			return err
1220		}
1221	case constant.EnableLog:
1222		key := "access_log"
1223		logPath := path.Join("/www", "sites", website.Alias, "log", req.LogType)
1224		params := []string{logPath}
1225		switch req.LogType {
1226		case constant.AccessLog:
1227			if website.Type != constant.Stream {
1228				params = append(params, "main")
1229			} else {
1230				params = append(params, "streamlog")
1231			}
1232			website.AccessLog = true
1233		case constant.ErrorLog:
1234			key = "error_log"
1235			website.ErrorLog = true
1236		}
1237		if err := updateNginxConfig(constant.NginxScopeServer, []dto.NginxParam{{Name: key, Params: params}}, &website); err != nil {
1238			return err
1239		}
1240		if err := websiteRepo.Save(context.Background(), &website); err != nil {
1241			return err
1242		}
1243	case constant.DeleteLog:
1244		logPath := path.Join(sitePath, "log", req.LogType)
1245		if err := files.NewFileOp().WriteFile(logPath, strings.NewReader(""), constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
1246			return err
1247		}
1248	}
1249	return nil
1250}

1252func (w WebsiteService) ChangeDefaultServer(id uint) error {
1253	defaultWebsite, _ := websiteRepo.GetFirst(websiteRepo.WithDefaultServer())
1254	if defaultWebsite.ID > 0 {
1255		params, err := getNginxParamsByKeys(constant.NginxScopeServer, []string{"listen"}, &defaultWebsite)
1256		if err != nil {
1257			return err
1258		}
1259		var changeParams []dto.NginxParam
1260		for _, param := range params {
1261			paramLen := len(param.Params)
1262			var newParam []string
1263			if paramLen > 1 && param.Params[paramLen-1] == components.DefaultServer {
1264				newParam = param.Params[:paramLen-1]
1265			}
1266			changeParams = append(changeParams, dto.NginxParam{
1267				Name:   param.Name,
1268				Params: newParam,
1269			})
1270		}
1271		if err := updateNginxConfig(constant.NginxScopeServer, changeParams, &defaultWebsite); err != nil {
1272			return err
1273		}
1274		defaultWebsite.DefaultServer = false
1275		if err := websiteRepo.Save(context.Background(), &defaultWebsite); err != nil {
1276			return err
1277		}
1278	}
1279	if err := updateDefaultServerConfig(!(id > 0)); err != nil {
1280		return err
1281	}
1282	if id == 0 {
1283		return nil
1284	}
1285	website, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(id))
1286	if err != nil {
1287		return err
1288	}
1289	params, err := getNginxParamsByKeys(constant.NginxScopeServer, []string{"listen"}, &website)
1290	if err != nil {
1291		return err
1292	}
1293	var changeParams []dto.NginxParam
1294	for _, param := range params {
1295		if hasHttp3(param.Params) || hasDefaultServer(param.Params) {
1296			continue
1297		}
1298		newParam := append(param.Params, components.DefaultServer)
1299		changeParams = append(changeParams, dto.NginxParam{
1300			Name:   param.Name,
1301			Params: newParam,
1302		})
1303	}
1304	if err := updateNginxConfig(constant.NginxScopeServer, changeParams, &website); err != nil {
1305		return err
1306	}
1307	website.DefaultServer = true
1308	return websiteRepo.Save(context.Background(), &website)
1309}

1311func (w WebsiteService) ChangePHPVersion(req request.WebsitePHPVersionReq) error {
1312	website, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.WebsiteID))
1313	if err != nil {
1314		return err
1315	}
1316	if website.Type == constant.Runtime {
1317		oldRuntime, err := runtimeRepo.GetFirst(context.Background(), repo.WithByID(website.RuntimeID))
1318		if err != nil {
1319			return err
1320		}
1321		if oldRuntime.Resource == constant.ResourceLocal {
1322			return buserr.New("ErrPHPResource")
1323		}
1324		client, err := docker.NewDockerClient()
1325		if err != nil {
1326			return err
1327		}
1328		defer client.Close()
1329		if !checkImageLike(client, oldRuntime.Image) {
1330			return buserr.WithName("ErrImageNotExist", oldRuntime.Name)
1331		}
1332	}
1333	configPath := GetSitePath(website, SiteConf)
1334	nginxContent, err := files.NewFileOp().GetContent(configPath)
1335	if err != nil {
1336		return err
1337	}
1338	config, err := parser.NewStringParser(string(nginxContent)).Parse()
1339	if err != nil {
1340		return err
1341	}
1342	servers := config.FindServers()
1343	if len(servers) == 0 {
1344		return errors.New("nginx config is not valid")
1345	}
1346	server := servers[0]
1347	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
1348	indexPHPPath := path.Join(GetSitePath(website, SiteIndexDir), "index.php")
1349	indexHtmlPath := path.Join(GetSitePath(website, SiteIndexDir), "index.html")
1350	if req.RuntimeID > 0 {
1351		server.UpdateDirective("index", []string{"index.php index.html index.htm default.php default.htm default.html"})
1352		server.RemoveDirective("location", []string{"~", "[^/]\\.php(/|$)"})
1353		runtime, err := runtimeRepo.GetFirst(context.Background(), repo.WithByID(req.RuntimeID))
1354		if err != nil {
1355			return err
1356		}
1357		if runtime.Resource == constant.ResourceLocal {
1358			return buserr.New("ErrPHPResource")
1359		}
1360		website.RuntimeID = req.RuntimeID
1361		website.AppInstallID = 0
1362		phpProxy := fmt.Sprintf("127.0.0.1:%s", runtime.Port)
1363		website.Proxy = phpProxy
1364		server.UpdatePHPProxy([]string{website.Proxy}, "")
1365		website.Type = constant.Runtime
1366		if !fileOp.Stat(indexPHPPath) {
1367			_ = fileOp.WriteFile(indexPHPPath, strings.NewReader(string(nginx_conf.IndexPHP)), constant.FilePerm)
1368		}
1369	} else {
1370		server.UpdateDirective("index", []string{"index.html index.php index.htm default.php default.htm default.html"})
1371		website.RuntimeID = 0
1372		website.Type = constant.Static
1373		website.Proxy = ""
1374		server.RemoveDirective("location", []string{"~", "[^/]\\.php(/|$)"})
1375		if !fileOp.Stat(indexHtmlPath) {
1376			_ = fileOp.WriteFile(indexHtmlPath, strings.NewReader(string(nginx_conf.Index)), constant.FilePerm)
1377		}
1378	}
1379
1380	config.FilePath = configPath
1381	if err = nginx.WriteConfig(config, nginx.IndentedStyle); err != nil {
1382		return err
1383	}
1384	nginxInstall, err := getAppInstallByKey(constant.AppOpenresty)
1385	if err != nil {
1386		return err
1387	}
1388	if err = nginxCheckAndReload(string(nginxContent), configPath, nginxInstall.ContainerName); err != nil {
1389		return err
1390	}
1391	return websiteRepo.Save(context.Background(), &website)
1392}

1433		{Name: "add_header", Params: []string{"Access-Control-Allow-Methods"}},
1434		{Name: "add_header", Params: []string{"Access-Control-Allow-Headers"}},
1435		{Name: "add_header", Params: []string{"Access-Control-Allow-Credentials"}},
1436		{Name: "if", Params: []string{"(", "$request_method", "=", "'OPTIONS'", ")"}},

1443			server.UpdateDirective("add_header", []string{"Access-Control-Allow-Origin", req.AllowOrigins, "always"})

1446			}
1447			if req.AllowHeaders != "" {
1448				server.UpdateDirective("add_header", []string{"Access-Control-Allow-Headers", req.AllowHeaders, "always"})
1449			}
1450			if req.AllowCredentials {
1451				server.UpdateDirective("add_header", []string{"Access-Control-Allow-Credentials", "true", "always"})
1452			}
1453			if req.Preflight {
1454				server.AddCorsOption()
1455			}
1456			return nil
1457		})
1458	}
1459	return nil
1460}

1485func (w WebsiteService) UpdateAntiLeech(req request.NginxAntiLeechUpdate) (err error) {
1486	website, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.WebsiteID))
1487	if err != nil {
1488		return
1489	}
1490	nginxFull, err := getNginxFull(&website)
1491	if err != nil {
1492		return
1493	}
1494	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
1495	backupContent, err := fileOp.GetContent(nginxFull.SiteConfig.Config.FilePath)
1496	if err != nil {
1497		return
1498	}
1499	block := nginxFull.SiteConfig.Config.FindServers()[0]
1500	locations := block.FindDirectives("location")
1501	for _, location := range locations {
1502		loParams := location.GetParameters()
1503		if len(loParams) > 1 || loParams[0] == "~" {
1504			extendStr := loParams[1]
1505			if strings.HasPrefix(extendStr, `.*\.(`) && strings.HasSuffix(extendStr, `)$`) {
1506				block.RemoveDirective("location", loParams)
1507			}
1508		}
1509	}
1510	if req.Enable || req.Cache {
1511		exts := strings.Split(req.Extends, ",")
1512		newDirective := components.Directive{
1513			Name:       "location",
1514			Parameters: []string{"~", fmt.Sprintf(`.*\.(%s)$`, strings.Join(exts, "|"))},
1515		}
1516
1517		newBlock := &components.Block{}
1518		newBlock.Directives = make([]components.IDirective, 0)
1519		if req.Cache {
1520			newBlock.AppendDirectives(&components.Directive{
1521				Name:       "expires",
1522				Parameters: []string{strconv.Itoa(req.CacheTime) + req.CacheUint},
1523			})
1524		}
1525		if !req.LogEnable {
1526			newBlock.AppendDirectives(&components.Directive{
1527				Name:       "access_log",
1528				Parameters: []string{"off"},
1529			})
1530		}
1531		newBlock.AppendDirectives(&components.Directive{
1532			Name:       "log_not_found",
1533			Parameters: []string{"off"},
1534		})
1535		if req.Enable {
1536			validDir := &components.Directive{
1537				Name:       "valid_referers",
1538				Parameters: []string{},
1539			}
1540			if req.NoneRef {
1541				validDir.Parameters = append(validDir.Parameters, "none")
1542			}
1543			if req.Blocked {
1544				validDir.Parameters = append(validDir.Parameters, "blocked")
1545			}
1546			if len(req.ServerNames) > 0 {
1547				validDir.Parameters = append(validDir.Parameters, strings.Join(req.ServerNames, " "))
1548			}
1549			newBlock.AppendDirectives(validDir)
1550
1551			ifDir := &components.Directive{
1552				Name:       "if",
1553				Parameters: []string{"($invalid_referer)"},
1554			}
1555			if !req.LogEnable {
1556				ifDir.Block = &components.Block{
1557					Directives: []components.IDirective{
1558						&components.Directive{
1559							Name:       "access_log",
1560							Parameters: []string{"off"},
1561						},
1562						&components.Directive{
1563							Name:       "return",
1564							Parameters: []string{req.Return},
1565						},
1566					},
1567				}
1568			} else {
1569				ifDir.Block = &components.Block{
1570					Directives: []components.IDirective{
1571						&components.Directive{
1572							Name:       "return",
1573							Parameters: []string{req.Return},
1574						},
1575					},
1576				}
1577			}
1578			newBlock.AppendDirectives(ifDir)
1579		}
1580		if website.Type == constant.Deployment {
1581			proxyDirectives := getRootProxyDirectives(website.Proxy)
1582			if len(proxyDirectives) == 0 {
1583				return errors.New("failed to build deployment proxy directives")
1584			}
1585			newBlock.AppendDirectives(proxyDirectives...)
1586		}
1587		newDirective.Block = newBlock
1588		index := -1
1589		for i, directive := range block.Directives {
1590			if directive.GetName() == "include" {
1591				index = i
1592				break
1593			}
1594		}
1595		if index != -1 {
1596			block.Directives = append(block.Directives[:index], append([]components.IDirective{&newDirective}, block.Directives[index:]...)...)
1597		} else {
1598			block.Directives = append(block.Directives, &newDirective)
1599		}
1600	}
1601
1602	if err = nginx.WriteConfig(nginxFull.SiteConfig.Config, nginx.IndentedStyle); err != nil {
1603		return
1604	}
1605	if err = updateNginxConfig(constant.NginxScopeServer, nil, &website); err != nil {
1606		_ = fileOp.WriteFile(nginxFull.SiteConfig.Config.FilePath, bytes.NewReader(backupContent), constant.DirPerm)
1607		return
1608	}
1609	return
1610}

1612func (w WebsiteService) GetAntiLeech(id uint) (*response.NginxAntiLeechRes, error) {
1613	website, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(id))
1614	if err != nil {
1615		return nil, err
1616	}
1617	nginxFull, err := getNginxFull(&website)
1618	if err != nil {
1619		return nil, err
1620	}
1621	res := &response.NginxAntiLeechRes{
1622		LogEnable:   true,
1623		ServerNames: []string{},
1624	}
1625	block := nginxFull.SiteConfig.Config.FindServers()[0]
1626	locations := block.FindDirectives("location")
1627	for _, location := range locations {
1628		loParams := location.GetParameters()
1629		if len(loParams) > 1 || loParams[0] == "~" {
1630			extendStr := loParams[1]
1631			if strings.HasPrefix(extendStr, `.*\.(`) && strings.HasSuffix(extendStr, `)$`) {
1632				str1 := strings.TrimPrefix(extendStr, `.*\.(`)
1633				str2 := strings.TrimSuffix(str1, ")$")
1634				res.Extends = strings.Join(strings.Split(str2, "|"), ",")
1635			}
1636		}
1637		lDirectives := location.GetBlock().GetDirectives()
1638		for _, lDir := range lDirectives {
1639			if lDir.GetName() == "access_log" {
1640				if strings.Join(lDir.GetParameters(), "") == "off" {
1641					res.LogEnable = false
1642				}
1643			}
1644			if lDir.GetName() == "valid_referers" {
1645				res.Enable = true
1646				params := lDir.GetParameters()
1647				for _, param := range params {
1648					if param == "none" {
1649						res.NoneRef = true
1650						continue
1651					}
1652					if param == "blocked" {
1653						res.Blocked = true
1654						continue
1655					}
1656					if param == "server_names" {
1657						continue
1658					}
1659					res.ServerNames = append(res.ServerNames, param)
1660				}
1661			}
1662			if lDir.GetName() == "if" && lDir.GetParameters()[0] == "($invalid_referer)" {
1663				directives := lDir.GetBlock().GetDirectives()
1664				for _, dir := range directives {
1665					if dir.GetName() == "return" {
1666						res.Return = strings.Join(dir.GetParameters(), " ")
1667					}
1668				}
1669			}
1670			if lDir.GetName() == "expires" {
1671				res.Cache = true
1672				matches := re.GetRegex(re.NumberWordPattern).FindStringSubmatch(lDir.GetParameters()[0])
1673				if matches == nil {
1674					continue
1675				}
1676				cacheTime, err := strconv.Atoi(matches[1])
1677				if err != nil {
1678					continue
1679				}
1680				unit := matches[2]
1681				res.CacheUint = unit
1682				res.CacheTime = cacheTime
1683			}
1684		}
1685	}
1686	return res, nil
1687}

1689func (w WebsiteService) OperateRedirect(req request.NginxRedirectReq) (err error) {
1690	var (
1691		website    model.Website
1692		oldContent []byte
1693	)
1694
1695	website, err = websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.WebsiteID))
1696	if err != nil {
1697		return err
1698	}
1699	includeDir := GetSitePath(website, SiteRedirectDir)
1700	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
1701	if !fileOp.Stat(includeDir) {
1702		_ = fileOp.CreateDir(includeDir, constant.DirPerm)
1703	}
1704	fileName := fmt.Sprintf("%s.conf", req.Name)
1705	includePath := path.Join(includeDir, fileName)
1706	backName := fmt.Sprintf("%s.bak", req.Name)
1707	backPath := path.Join(includeDir, backName)
1708
1709	if req.Operate == "create" && (fileOp.Stat(includePath) || fileOp.Stat(backPath)) {
1710		err = buserr.New("ErrNameIsExist")
1711		return
1712	}
1713
1714	defer func() {
1715		if err != nil {
1716			switch req.Operate {
1717			case "create":
1718				_ = fileOp.DeleteFile(includePath)
1719			case "edit":
1720				_ = fileOp.WriteFile(includePath, bytes.NewReader(oldContent), constant.DirPerm)
1721			}
1722		}
1723	}()
1724
1725	var (
1726		config *components.Config
1727		oldPar *parser.Parser
1728	)
1729
1730	switch req.Operate {
1731	case "create":
1732		config = &components.Config{}
1733	case "edit":
1734		oldPar, err = parser.NewParser(includePath)
1735		if err != nil {
1736			return
1737		}
1738		config, err = oldPar.Parse()
1739		if err != nil {
1740			return
1741		}
1742		oldContent, err = fileOp.GetContent(includePath)
1743		if err != nil {
1744			return
1745		}
1746	case "delete":
1747		_ = fileOp.DeleteFile(includePath)
1748		_ = fileOp.DeleteFile(backPath)
1749		return updateNginxConfig(constant.NginxScopeServer, nil, &website)
1750	case "disable":
1751		_ = fileOp.Rename(includePath, backPath)
1752		return updateNginxConfig(constant.NginxScopeServer, nil, &website)
1753	case "enable":
1754		_ = fileOp.Rename(backPath, includePath)
1755		return updateNginxConfig(constant.NginxScopeServer, nil, &website)
1756	}
1757
1758	target := req.Target
1759	block := &components.Block{}
1760
1761	switch req.Type {
1762	case "path":
1763		if req.KeepPath {
1764			target = req.Target + "$1"
1765		} else {
1766			target = req.Target + "?"
1767		}
1768		redirectKey := "permanent"
1769		if req.Redirect == "302" {
1770			redirectKey = "redirect"
1771		}
1772		block = &components.Block{
1773			Directives: []components.IDirective{
1774				&components.Directive{
1775					Name:       "rewrite",
1776					Parameters: []string{fmt.Sprintf("^%s(.*)", req.Path), target, redirectKey},
1777				},
1778			},
1779		}
1780	case "domain":
1781		if req.KeepPath {
1782			target = req.Target + "$request_uri"
1783		}
1784		returnBlock := &components.Block{
1785			Directives: []components.IDirective{
1786				&components.Directive{
1787					Name:       "return",
1788					Parameters: []string{req.Redirect, target},
1789				},
1790			},
1791		}
1792		for _, domain := range req.Domains {
1793			block.Directives = append(block.Directives, &components.Directive{
1794				Name:       "if",
1795				Parameters: []string{"($host", "~", fmt.Sprintf("'%s')", buildRedirectHostPattern(domain))},
1796				Block:      returnBlock,
1797			})
1798		}
1799	case "404":
1800		if req.RedirectRoot {
1801			target = "/"
1802		}
1803		block = &components.Block{
1804			Directives: []components.IDirective{
1805				&components.Directive{
1806					Name:       "error_page",
1807					Parameters: []string{"404", "=", "@notfound"},
1808				},
1809				&components.Directive{
1810					Name:       "location",
1811					Parameters: []string{"@notfound"},
1812					Block: &components.Block{
1813						Directives: []components.IDirective{
1814							&components.Directive{
1815								Name:       "return",
1816								Parameters: []string{req.Redirect, target},
1817							},
1818						},
1819					},
1820				},
1821			},
1822		}
1823	}
1824	config.FilePath = includePath
1825	config.Block = block
1826
1827	if err = nginx.WriteConfig(config, nginx.IndentedStyle); err != nil {
1828		return buserr.WithErr("ErrUpdateBuWebsite", err)
1829	}
1830
1831	nginxInclude := getWebsiteRedirectInclude(website)
1832	if err = updateNginxConfig(constant.NginxScopeServer, []dto.NginxParam{{Name: "include", Params: []string{nginxInclude}}}, &website); err != nil {
1833		return
1834	}
1835	return
1836}

1838func (w WebsiteService) GetRedirect(id uint) (res []response.NginxRedirectConfig, err error) {
1839	var (
1840		website model.Website
1841	)
1842	website, err = websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(id))
1843	if err != nil {
1844		return
1845	}
1846	includeDir := GetSitePath(website, SiteRedirectDir)
1847	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
1848	if !fileOp.Stat(includeDir) {
1849		return
1850	}
1851	entries, err := os.ReadDir(includeDir)
1852	if err != nil {
1853		return
1854	}
1855	if len(entries) == 0 {
1856		return
1857	}
1858
1859	var (
1860		content []byte
1861		config  *components.Config
1862	)
1863	for _, entry := range entries {
1864		if entry.IsDir() {
1865			continue
1866		}
1867		fileName := entry.Name()
1868		if !strings.HasSuffix(fileName, ".conf") && !strings.HasSuffix(fileName, ".bak") {
1869			continue
1870		}
1871		redirectConfig := response.NginxRedirectConfig{
1872			WebsiteID: website.ID,
1873		}
1874		parts := strings.Split(fileName, ".")
1875		redirectConfig.Name = parts[0]
1876		if parts[1] == "conf" {
1877			redirectConfig.Enable = true
1878		} else {
1879			redirectConfig.Enable = false
1880		}
1881		filePath := path.Join(includeDir, fileName)
1882		redirectConfig.FilePath = filePath
1883		content, err = fileOp.GetContent(filePath)
1884		if err != nil {
1885			return
1886		}
1887		redirectConfig.Content = string(content)
1888		config, err = parser.NewStringParser(string(content)).Parse()
1889		if err != nil {
1890			return
1891		}
1892
1893		dirs := config.GetDirectives()
1894		if len(dirs) > 0 {
1895			firstName := dirs[0].GetName()
1896			switch firstName {
1897			case "if":
1898				for _, ifDir := range dirs {
1899					params := ifDir.GetParameters()
1900					if len(params) > 2 && params[0] == "($host" {
1901						domain := parseRedirectHostPattern(params[2])
1902						redirectConfig.Domains = append(redirectConfig.Domains, domain)
1903						if len(redirectConfig.Domains) > 1 {
1904							continue
1905						}
1906						redirectConfig.Type = "domain"
1907					}
1908					childDirs := ifDir.GetBlock().GetDirectives()
1909					for _, dir := range childDirs {
1910						if dir.GetName() == "return" {
1911							dirParams := dir.GetParameters()
1912							if len(dirParams) > 1 {
1913								redirectConfig.Redirect = dirParams[0]
1914								if strings.HasSuffix(dirParams[1], "$request_uri") {
1915									redirectConfig.KeepPath = true
1916									redirectConfig.Target = strings.TrimSuffix(dirParams[1], "$request_uri")
1917								} else {
1918									redirectConfig.KeepPath = false
1919									redirectConfig.Target = dirParams[1]
1920								}
1921							}
1922						}
1923					}
1924				}
1925			case "rewrite":
1926				redirectConfig.Type = "path"
1927				for _, pathDir := range dirs {
1928					if pathDir.GetName() == "rewrite" {
1929						params := pathDir.GetParameters()
1930						if len(params) > 2 {
1931							redirectConfig.Path = strings.Trim(strings.Trim(params[0], "^"), "(.*)")
1932							if strings.HasSuffix(params[1], "$1") {
1933								redirectConfig.KeepPath = true
1934								redirectConfig.Target = strings.TrimSuffix(params[1], "$1")
1935							} else {
1936								redirectConfig.KeepPath = false
1937								redirectConfig.Target = strings.TrimSuffix(params[1], "?")
1938							}
1939							if params[2] == "permanent" {
1940								redirectConfig.Redirect = "301"
1941							} else {
1942								redirectConfig.Redirect = "302"
1943							}
1944						}
1945					}
1946				}
1947			case "error_page":
1948				redirectConfig.Type = "404"
1949				for _, errDir := range dirs {
1950					if errDir.GetName() == "location" {
1951						childDirs := errDir.GetBlock().GetDirectives()
1952						for _, dir := range childDirs {
1953							if dir.GetName() == "return" {
1954								dirParams := dir.GetParameters()
1955								if len(dirParams) > 1 {
1956									redirectConfig.Redirect = dirParams[0]
1957									if strings.HasSuffix(dirParams[1], "$request_uri") {
1958										redirectConfig.KeepPath = true
1959										redirectConfig.Target = strings.TrimSuffix(dirParams[1], "$request_uri")
1960										redirectConfig.RedirectRoot = false
1961									} else {
1962										redirectConfig.KeepPath = false
1963										redirectConfig.Target = dirParams[1]
1964										redirectConfig.RedirectRoot = redirectConfig.Target == "/"
1965									}
1966								}
1967							}
1968						}
1969					}
1970				}
1971			}
1972		}
1973		res = append(res, redirectConfig)
1974	}
1975	return
1976}

1978func (w WebsiteService) UpdateRedirectFile(req request.NginxRedirectUpdate) (err error) {
1979	var (
1980		website           model.Website
1981		oldRewriteContent []byte
1982	)
1983	website, err = websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.WebsiteID))
1984	if err != nil {
1985		return err
1986	}
1987	safeName := path.Base(req.Name)
1988	if safeName != req.Name || strings.Contains(safeName, "..") {
1989		return buserr.New("ErrInvalidParams")
1990	}
1991	absolutePath := path.Join(GetSitePath(website, SiteRedirectDir), req.Name+".conf")
1992	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
1993	oldRewriteContent, err = fileOp.GetContent(absolutePath)
1994	if err != nil {
1995		return err
1996	}
1997	if err = fileOp.WriteFile(absolutePath, strings.NewReader(req.Content), constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
1998		return err
1999	}
2000	defer func() {
2001		if err != nil {
2002			_ = fileOp.WriteFile(absolutePath, bytes.NewReader(oldRewriteContent), constant.DirPerm)
2003		}
2004	}()
2005	return updateNginxConfig(constant.NginxScopeServer, nil, &website)
2006}

2008func (w WebsiteService) LoadWebsiteDirConfig(req request.WebsiteCommonReq) (*response.WebsiteDirConfig, error) {
2009	website, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.ID))
2010	if err != nil {
2011		return nil, err
2012	}
2013	res := &response.WebsiteDirConfig{}
2014	absoluteIndexPath := GetSitePath(website, SiteIndexDir)
2015	var appFs = afero.NewOsFs()
2016	info, err := appFs.Stat(absoluteIndexPath)
2017	if err != nil {
2018		return nil, err
2019	}
2020	res.User = strconv.FormatUint(uint64(info.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t).Uid), 10)
2021	res.UserGroup = strconv.FormatUint(uint64(info.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t).Gid), 10)
2022
2023	indexFiles, err := os.ReadDir(absoluteIndexPath)
2024	if err != nil {
2025		return nil, err
2026	}
2027	res.Dirs = []string{"/"}
2028	checkAndAppendDirs := func(relPath string, entries []os.DirEntry) {
2029		for _, entry := range entries {
2030			if !entry.IsDir() || entry.Name() == "node_modules" || entry.Name() == "vendor" {
2031				continue
2032			}
2033			nextRelPath := path.Join(relPath, entry.Name())
2034			res.Dirs = append(res.Dirs, "/"+strings.TrimPrefix(nextRelPath, "/"))
2035			entryInfo, _ := entry.Info()
2036			if entryInfo != nil {
2037				if stat, ok := entryInfo.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t); ok {
2038					if stat.Uid != 1000 || stat.Gid != 1000 {
2039						res.Msg = i18n.GetMsgByKey("ErrPathPermission")
2040					}
2041				}
2042			}
2043		}
2044	}
2045
2046	checkAndAppendDirs("", indexFiles)
2047	for _, firstDir := range indexFiles {
2048		if !firstDir.IsDir() || firstDir.Name() == "node_modules" || firstDir.Name() == "vendor" {
2049			continue
2050		}
2051		secondLevelPath := path.Join(absoluteIndexPath, firstDir.Name())
2052		secondLevelDirs, _ := os.ReadDir(secondLevelPath)
2053		checkAndAppendDirs(firstDir.Name(), secondLevelDirs)
2054
2055		for _, secondDir := range secondLevelDirs {
2056			if !secondDir.IsDir() || secondDir.Name() == "node_modules" || secondDir.Name() == "vendor" {
2057				continue
2058			}
2059			thirdLevelPath := path.Join(secondLevelPath, secondDir.Name())
2060			thirdLevelDirs, _ := os.ReadDir(thirdLevelPath)
2061			checkAndAppendDirs(path.Join(firstDir.Name(), secondDir.Name()), thirdLevelDirs)
2062		}
2063	}
2064
2065	return res, nil
2066}

2068func (w WebsiteService) GetDefaultHtml(resourceType string) (*response.WebsiteHtmlRes, error) {
2069	nginxInstall, err := getAppInstallByKey(constant.AppOpenresty)
2070	if err != nil {
2071		return nil, err
2072	}
2073	rootPath := path.Join(nginxInstall.GetPath(), "root")
2074	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
2075	defaultPath := path.Join(rootPath, "default")
2076	if !fileOp.Stat(defaultPath) {
2077		_ = fileOp.CreateDir(defaultPath, constant.DirPerm)
2078	}
2079
2080	res := &response.WebsiteHtmlRes{}
2081
2082	switch resourceType {
2083	case "404":
2084		resourcePath := path.Join(defaultPath, "404.html")
2085		if content, _ := getResourceContent(fileOp, resourcePath); content != "" {
2086			res.Content = content
2087			return res, nil
2088		}
2089		res.Content = string(nginx_conf.NotFoundHTML)
2090		return res, nil
2091	case "php":
2092		resourcePath := path.Join(defaultPath, "index.php")
2093		if content, _ := getResourceContent(fileOp, resourcePath); content != "" {
2094			res.Content = content
2095			return res, nil
2096		}
2097		res.Content = string(nginx_conf.IndexPHP)
2098		return res, nil
2099	case "index":
2100		resourcePath := path.Join(defaultPath, "index.html")
2101		if content, _ := getResourceContent(fileOp, resourcePath); content != "" {
2102			res.Content = content
2103			return res, nil
2104		}
2105		res.Content = string(nginx_conf.Index)
2106		return res, nil
2107	case "domain404":
2108		resourcePath := path.Join(rootPath, "404.html")
2109		if content, _ := getResourceContent(fileOp, resourcePath); content != "" {
2110			res.Content = content
2111			return res, nil
2112		}
2113		res.Content = string(nginx_conf.DomainNotFoundHTML)
2114		return res, nil
2115	case "stop":
2116		resourcePath := path.Join(rootPath, "stop", "index.html")
2117		if content, _ := getResourceContent(fileOp, resourcePath); content != "" {
2118			res.Content = content
2119			return res, nil
2120		}
2121		res.Content = string(nginx_conf.StopHTML)
2122		return res, nil
2123	}
2124	return res, nil
2125}

2127func (w WebsiteService) UpdateDefaultHtml(req request.WebsiteHtmlUpdate) error {
2128	nginxInstall, err := getAppInstallByKey(constant.AppOpenresty)
2129	if err != nil {
2130		return err
2131	}
2132	rootPath := path.Join(nginxInstall.GetPath(), "root")
2133	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
2134	defaultPath := path.Join(rootPath, "default")
2135	if !fileOp.Stat(defaultPath) {
2136		_ = fileOp.CreateDir(defaultPath, constant.DirPerm)
2137	}
2138	var resourcePath string
2139	switch req.Type {
2140	case "404":
2141		resourcePath = path.Join(defaultPath, "404.html")
2142		if req.Sync {
2143			websites, _ := websiteRepo.GetBy(repo.WithTypes([]string{constant.Static, constant.Runtime}))
2144			for _, website := range websites {
2145				filePath := path.Join(GetSitePath(website, SiteIndexDir), "404.html")
2146				if fileOp.Stat(filePath) {
2147					_ = fileOp.SaveFile(filePath, req.Content, constant.DirPerm)
2148				}
2149			}
2150		}
2151	case "php":
2152		resourcePath = path.Join(defaultPath, "index.php")
2153	case "index":
2154		resourcePath = path.Join(defaultPath, "index.html")
2155	case "domain404":
2156		resourcePath = path.Join(rootPath, "404.html")
2157	case "stop":
2158		resourcePath = path.Join(rootPath, "stop", "index.html")
2159	default:
2160		return nil
2161	}
2162	return fileOp.SaveFile(resourcePath, req.Content, constant.DirPerm)
2163}

2169func (w WebsiteService) SetRealIPConfig(req request.WebsiteRealIP) error {
2170	website, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.WebsiteID))
2171	if err != nil {
2172		return err
2173	}
2174	params := []dto.NginxParam{
2175		{Name: "real_ip_recursive", Params: []string{"on"}},
2176		{Name: "set_real_ip_from", Params: []string{}},
2177		{Name: "real_ip_header", Params: []string{}},
2178	}
2179	if req.Open {
2180		if err := deleteNginxConfig(constant.NginxScopeServer, params, &website); err != nil {
2181			return err
2182		}
2183		params = []dto.NginxParam{
2184			{Name: "real_ip_recursive", Params: []string{"on"}},
2185		}
2186		var ips []string
2187		ipArray := strings.Split(req.IPFrom, "\n")
2188		for _, ip := range ipArray {
2189			if ip == "" {
2190				continue
2191			}
2192			if parsedIP := net.ParseIP(ip); parsedIP == nil {
2193				if _, _, err := net.ParseCIDR(ip); err != nil {
2194					return buserr.New("ErrParseIP")
2195				}
2196			}
2197			ips = append(ips, strings.TrimSpace(ip))
2198		}
2199		for _, ip := range ips {
2200			params = append(params, dto.NginxParam{Name: "set_real_ip_from", Params: []string{ip}})
2201		}
2202		if req.IPHeader == "other" {
2203			params = append(params, dto.NginxParam{Name: "real_ip_header", Params: []string{req.IPOther}})
2204		} else {
2205			params = append(params, dto.NginxParam{Name: "real_ip_header", Params: []string{req.IPHeader}})
2206		}
2207		return updateNginxConfig(constant.NginxScopeServer, params, &website)
2208	}
2209	return deleteNginxConfig(constant.NginxScopeServer, params, &website)
2210}

2212func (w WebsiteService) GetRealIPConfig(websiteID uint) (*response.WebsiteRealIP, error) {
2213	website, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(websiteID))
2214	if err != nil {
2215		return nil, err
2216	}
2217	params, err := getNginxParamsByKeys(constant.NginxScopeServer, []string{"real_ip_recursive"}, &website)
2218	if err != nil {
2219		return nil, err
2220	}
2221	if len(params) == 0 || len(params[0].Params) == 0 {
2222		return &response.WebsiteRealIP{Open: false}, nil
2223	}
2224	params, err = getNginxParamsByKeys(constant.NginxScopeServer, []string{"set_real_ip_from", "real_ip_header"}, &website)
2225	if err != nil {
2226		return nil, err
2227	}
2228	res := &response.WebsiteRealIP{
2229		Open: true,
2230	}
2231	var ips []string
2232	for _, param := range params {
2233		if param.Name == "set_real_ip_from" {
2234			ips = append(ips, param.Params...)
2235		}
2236		if param.Name == "real_ip_header" {
2237			if _, ok := dto.RealIPKeys[param.Params[0]]; ok {
2238				res.IPHeader = param.Params[0]
2239			} else {
2240				res.IPHeader = "other"
2241				res.IPOther = param.Params[0]
2242			}
2243		}
2244	}
2245	res.IPFrom = strings.Join(ips, "\n")
2246	return res, err
2247}

2279			ResourceID: install.ID,
2280			Detail:     install,
2281		})
2282		installResources, _ := appInstallResourceRepo.GetBy(appInstallResourceRepo.WithAppInstallId(install.ID))
2283		for _, resource := range installResources {
2284			if resource.Key == constant.AppMysql || resource.Key == constant.AppMariaDB || resource.Key == constant.AppPostgres || resource.Key == constant.AppPostgresql {
2285				databaseType = resource.Key
2286				databaseID = resource.ResourceId
2287			}
2288		}
2289	}
