2291		databaseType = website.DbType
2292		databaseID = website.DbID
2293	}
2294	if databaseID > 0 {
2295		switch databaseType {
2296		case constant.AppMysql, constant.AppMariaDB:
2297			db, _ := mysqlRepo.Get(repo.WithByID(databaseID))
2298			if db.ID > 0 {
2299				res = append(res, response.Resource{
2300					Name:       db.Name,
2301					Type:       "database",
2302					ResourceID: db.ID,
2303					Detail:     db,
2304				})
2305			}
2306		case constant.AppPostgresql, constant.AppPostgres:
2307			db, _ := postgresqlRepo.Get(repo.WithByID(databaseID))
2308			if db.ID > 0 {
2309				res = append(res, response.Resource{
2310					Name:       db.Name,
2311					Type:       "database",
2312					ResourceID: db.ID,
2313					Detail:     db,
2314				})
2315			}
2316		}
2317	}
2318
2319	return res, nil

2381func (w WebsiteService) ExecComposer(req request.ExecComposerReq) error {
2382	if cmd.CheckIllegal(req.User, req.Mirror, req.Command, req.ExtCommand) {
2383		return buserr.New("ErrCmdIllegal")
2384	}
2385	website, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.WebsiteID))
2386	if err != nil {
2387		return err
2388	}
2389	sitePath := GetSitePath(website, SiteDir)
2390	if !strings.Contains(req.Dir, sitePath) {
2391		return buserr.New("ErrWebsiteDir")
2392	}
2393	if !files.NewFileOp().Stat(path.Join(req.Dir, "composer.json")) {
2394		return buserr.New("ErrComposerFileNotFound")
2395	}
2396	if task.CheckResourceTaskIsExecuting(task.TaskExec, req.Command, website.ID) {
2397		return buserr.New("ErrInstallExtension")
2398	}
2399	runtime, err := runtimeRepo.GetFirst(context.Background(), repo.WithByID(website.RuntimeID))
2400	if err != nil {
2401		return err
2402	}
2403	var composerArgs []string
2404	if req.Command != "custom" {
2405		composerArgs = append(composerArgs, req.Command)
2406		composerArgs = append(composerArgs, strings.Fields(req.ExtCommand)...)
2407	} else {
2408		composerArgs = strings.Fields(req.ExtCommand)
2409	}
2410	command := strings.Join(composerArgs, " ")
2411	resourceName := fmt.Sprintf("composer %s", command)
2412	composerTask, err := task.NewTaskWithOps(resourceName, task.TaskExec, req.Command, req.TaskID, website.ID)
2413	if err != nil {
2414		return err
2415	}
2416	cmdMgr := cmd.NewCommandMgr(cmd.WithTask(*composerTask), cmd.WithTimeout(20*time.Minute))
2417	siteDir, _ := settingRepo.Get(settingRepo.WithByKey("WEBSITE_DIR"))
2418	execDir := strings.ReplaceAll(req.Dir, siteDir.Value, "/www")
2419	composerTask.AddSubTask("", func(t *task.Task) error {
2420		if err := cmdMgr.Run("docker", "exec",
2421			"-u", req.User,
2422			runtime.ContainerName,
2423			"composer",
2424			"config", "-g",
2425			"repo.packagist",
2426			"composer",
2427			req.Mirror,
2428		); err != nil {
2429			return err
2430		}
2431
2432		execArgs := []string{
2433			"exec",
2434			"-u", req.User,
2435			runtime.ContainerName,
2436			"composer",
2437		}
2438		execArgs = append(execArgs, composerArgs...)
2439		execArgs = append(execArgs, "--working-dir="+execDir)
2440		if err := cmdMgr.Run("docker", execArgs...); err != nil {
2441			return err
2442		}
2443		return nil
2444	}, nil)
2445	go func() {
2446		_ = composerTask.Execute()
2447	}()
2448	return nil
2449}

2451func (w WebsiteService) UpdateStream(req request.StreamUpdate) error {
2452	if req.StreamConfig.StreamPorts == "" {
2453		return buserr.New("ErrTypePortRange")
2454	}
2455	website, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.WebsiteID))
2456	if err != nil {
2457		return err
2458	}
2459	nginxFull, err := getNginxFull(&website)
2460	if err != nil {
2461		return nil
2462	}
2463	website.StreamPorts = req.StreamConfig.StreamPorts
2464	ports := strings.Split(req.StreamConfig.StreamPorts, ",")
2465	for _, port := range ports {
2466		portNum, _ := strconv.Atoi(port)
2467		if err = checkWebsitePort(nginxFull.Install.HttpsPort, portNum, website.Type); err != nil {
2468			return err
2469		}
2470	}
2471
2472	config := nginxFull.SiteConfig.Config
2473	servers := config.FindServers()
2474	if len(servers) == 0 {
2475		return errors.New("nginx config is not valid")
2476	}
2477	server := servers[0]
2478	server.Listens = []*components.ServerListen{}
2479	var params []string
2480	if req.UDP {
2481		params = []string{"udp"}
2482	}
2483	for _, port := range ports {
2484		server.UpdateListen(port, false, params...)
2485		if website.IPV6 {
2486			server.UpdateListen("[::]:"+port, false, params...)
2487		}
2488	}
2489	upstream := components.Upstream{
2490		UpstreamName: website.Alias,
2491	}
2492	if req.Algorithm != "default" {
2493		upstream.UpdateDirective(req.Algorithm, []string{})
2494	}
2495	upstream.UpstreamServers = parseUpstreamServers(req.Servers)
2496	for i, dir := range config.Block.Directives {
2497		if dir.GetName() == "upstream" && dir.GetParameters()[0] == website.Alias {
2498			config.Block.Directives[i] = &upstream
2499		}
2500	}
2501
2502	if err := nginx.WriteConfig(config, nginx.IndentedStyle); err != nil {
2503		return err
2504	}
2505	if err = nginxCheckAndReload(nginxFull.SiteConfig.OldContent, config.FilePath, nginxFull.Install.ContainerName); err != nil {
2506		return err
2507	}
2508	website.StreamPorts = req.StreamConfig.StreamPorts
2509	return websiteRepo.Save(context.Background(), &website)
2510}

  36func (w WebsiteAcmeAccountService) Page(search dto.PageInfo) (int64, []response.WebsiteAcmeAccountDTO, error) {

  47func (w WebsiteAcmeAccountService) Create(create request.WebsiteAcmeAccountCreate) (*response.WebsiteAcmeAccountDTO, error) {
  48	exist, _ := websiteAcmeRepo.GetFirst(websiteAcmeRepo.WithEmail(create.Email), websiteAcmeRepo.WithType(create.Type))
  49	if exist != nil {
  50		return nil, buserr.New("ErrEmailIsExist")
  51	}
  52	acmeAccount := &model.WebsiteAcmeAccount{
  53		Email:    create.Email,
  54		Type:     create.Type,
  55		KeyType:  create.KeyType,
  56		UseProxy: create.UseProxy,
  57		UseEAB:   create.UseEAB,
  58	}
  59
  60	if create.Type == "google" || create.Type == "freessl" || (create.Type == "custom" && create.UseEAB) {
  61		if create.EabKid == "" || create.EabHmacKey == "" {
  62			return nil, buserr.New("ErrEabKidOrEabHmacKeyCannotBlank")
  63		}
  64		acmeAccount.EabKid = create.EabKid
  65		acmeAccount.EabHmacKey = create.EabHmacKey
  66	}
  67	if create.Type == "custom" && create.CaDirURL != "" {
  68		acmeAccount.CaDirURL = create.CaDirURL
  69	}
  70
  71	var client *ssl.AcmeClient
  72	if err := withLegoLogger(nil, func() error {
  73		var err error
  74		client, err = ssl.NewRegisterClient(acmeAccount, getSystemProxy(acmeAccount.UseProxy))
  75		return err
  76	}); err != nil {
  77		return nil, err
  78	}
  79	privateKey, err := ssl.GetPrivateKey(client.User.GetPrivateKey(), ssl.KeyType(create.KeyType))
  80	if err != nil {
  81		return nil, err
  82	}
  83	acmeAccount.PrivateKey = string(privateKey)
  84	acmeAccount.URL = client.User.Registration.Location
  85
  86	if err := websiteAcmeRepo.Create(*acmeAccount); err != nil {
  87		return nil, err
  88	}
  89	return &response.WebsiteAcmeAccountDTO{WebsiteAcmeAccount: *acmeAccount}, nil
  90}

  32func (w WebsiteService) GetAuthBasics(req request.NginxAuthReq) (res response.NginxAuthRes, err error) {
  33	var (
  34		website     model.Website
  35		authContent []byte
  36		nginxParams []response.NginxParam
  37	)
  38	website, err = websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.WebsiteID))
  39	if err != nil {
  40		return
  41	}
  42	absoluteAuthPath := GetSitePath(website, SiteRootAuthBasicPath)
  43	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
  44	if !fileOp.Stat(absoluteAuthPath) {
  45		return
  46	}
  47	nginxParams, err = getNginxParamsByKeys(constant.NginxScopeServer, []string{"auth_basic"}, &website)
  48	if err != nil {
  49		return
  50	}
  51	res.Enable = len(nginxParams[0].Params) > 0
  52	authContent, err = fileOp.GetContent(absoluteAuthPath)
  53	authArray := strings.Split(string(authContent), "\n")
  54	for _, line := range authArray {
  55		if line == "" {
  56			continue
  57		}
  58		params := strings.Split(line, ":")
  59		auth := dto.NginxAuth{
  60			Username: params[0],
  61		}
  62		if len(params) == 3 {
  63			auth.Remark = params[2]
  64		}
  65		res.Items = append(res.Items, auth)
  66	}
  67	return
  68}
  69
  70func (w WebsiteService) UpdateAuthBasic(req request.NginxAuthUpdate) (err error) {
  71	var (
  72		website     model.Website
  73		params      []dto.NginxParam
  74		authContent []byte
  75		authArray   []string
  76	)
  77	website, err = websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.WebsiteID))
  78	if err != nil {
  79		return err
  80	}
  81	authPath := fmt.Sprintf("/www/sites/%s/auth_basic/auth.pass", website.Alias)
  82	absoluteAuthPath := GetSitePath(website, SiteRootAuthBasicPath)
  83	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
  84	if !fileOp.Stat(path.Dir(absoluteAuthPath)) {
  85		_ = fileOp.CreateDir(path.Dir(absoluteAuthPath), constant.DirPerm)
  86	}
  87	if !fileOp.Stat(absoluteAuthPath) {
  88		_ = fileOp.CreateFile(absoluteAuthPath)
  89	}
  90
  91	params = append(params, dto.NginxParam{Name: "auth_basic", Params: []string{`"Authentication"`}})
  92	params = append(params, dto.NginxParam{Name: "auth_basic_user_file", Params: []string{authPath}})
  93	authContent, err = fileOp.GetContent(absoluteAuthPath)
  94	if err != nil {
  95		return
  96	}
  97	if len(authContent) > 0 {
  98		authArray = strings.Split(string(authContent), "\n")
  99	}
 100	switch req.Operate {
 101	case "disable":
 102		return deleteNginxConfig(constant.NginxScopeServer, params, &website)
 103	case "enable":
 104		return updateNginxConfig(constant.NginxScopeServer, params, &website)
 105	case "create":
 106		for _, line := range authArray {
 107			authParams := strings.Split(line, ":")
 108			username := authParams[0]
 109			if username == req.Username {
 110				err = buserr.New("ErrUsernameIsExist")
 111				return
 112			}
 113		}
 114		var passwdHash []byte
 115		passwdHash, err = bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword([]byte(req.Password), bcrypt.DefaultCost)
 116		if err != nil {
 117			return
 118		}
 119		line := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s\n", req.Username, passwdHash)
 120		if req.Remark != "" {
 121			line = fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s:%s\n", req.Username, passwdHash, req.Remark)
 122		}
 123		authArray = append(authArray, line)
 124	case "edit":
 125		userExist := false
 126		for index, line := range authArray {
 127			authParams := strings.Split(line, ":")
 128			username := authParams[0]
 129			if username == req.Username {
 130				userExist = true
 131				var passwdHash []byte
 132				passwdHash, err = bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword([]byte(req.Password), bcrypt.DefaultCost)
 133				if err != nil {
 134					return
 135				}
 136				userPasswd := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s\n", req.Username, passwdHash)
 137				if req.Remark != "" {
 138					userPasswd = fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s:%s\n", req.Username, passwdHash, req.Remark)
 139				}
 140				authArray[index] = userPasswd
 141			}
 142		}
 143		if !userExist {
 144			err = buserr.New("ErrUsernameIsNotExist")
 145			return
 146		}
 147	case "delete":
 148		deleteIndex := -1
 149		for index, line := range authArray {
 150			authParams := strings.Split(line, ":")
 151			username := authParams[0]
 152			if username == req.Username {
 153				deleteIndex = index
 154			}
 155		}
 156		if deleteIndex < 0 {
 157			return
 158		}
 159		authArray = append(authArray[:deleteIndex], authArray[deleteIndex+1:]...)
 160	}
 161
 162	var passFile *os.File
 163	passFile, err = os.Create(absoluteAuthPath)
 164	if err != nil {
 165		return
 166	}
 167	defer passFile.Close()
 168	writer := bufio.NewWriter(passFile)
 169	for _, line := range authArray {
 170		if line == "" {
 171			continue
 172		}
 173		_, err = writer.WriteString(line + "\n")
 174		if err != nil {
 175			return
 176		}
 177	}
 178	err = writer.Flush()
 179	if err != nil {
 180		return
 181	}
 182	authContent, err = fileOp.GetContent(absoluteAuthPath)
 183	if err != nil {
 184		return
 185	}
 186	if len(authContent) == 0 {
 187		if err = deleteNginxConfig(constant.NginxScopeServer, params, &website); err != nil {
 188			return
 189		}
 190	}
 191	return
 192}

 194func (w WebsiteService) GetPathAuthBasics(req request.NginxAuthReq) (res []response.NginxPathAuthRes, err error) {
 195	var (

 197		authContent []byte
 198	)
 199	website, err = websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.WebsiteID))
 200	if err != nil {
 201		return
 202	}
 203	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
 204	absoluteAuthDir := GetSitePath(website, SitePathAuthBasicDir)
 205	passDir := path.Join(absoluteAuthDir, "pass")
 206	if !fileOp.Stat(absoluteAuthDir) || !fileOp.Stat(passDir) {
 207		return
 208	}
 209
 210	entries, err := os.ReadDir(absoluteAuthDir)
 211	if err != nil {
 212		return nil, err
 213	}
 214
 215	for _, entry := range entries {
 216		if !entry.IsDir() {
 217			name := strings.TrimSuffix(entry.Name(), ".conf")
 218			pathAuth := dto.NginxPathAuth{
 219				Name: name,
 220			}
 221			configPath := path.Join(absoluteAuthDir, entry.Name())
 222			content, err := fileOp.GetContent(configPath)
 223			if err != nil {
 224				return nil, err
 225			}
 226			config, err := parser.NewStringParser(string(content)).Parse()
 227			if err != nil {
 228				return nil, err
 229			}
 230			directives := config.Directives
 231			location, _ := directives[0].(*components.Location)
 232			pathAuth.Path = strings.TrimPrefix(location.Match, "^")
 233			passPath := path.Join(passDir, fmt.Sprintf("%s.pass", name))
 234			authContent, err = fileOp.GetContent(passPath)
 235			if err != nil {
 236				return nil, err
 237			}
 238			authArray := strings.Split(string(authContent), "\n")
 239			for _, line := range authArray {
 240				if line == "" {
 241					continue
 242				}
 243				params := strings.Split(line, ":")
 244				pathAuth.Username = params[0]
 245				if len(params) == 3 {
 246					pathAuth.Remark = params[2]
 247				}
 248			}
 249			res = append(res, response.NginxPathAuthRes{
 250				NginxPathAuth: pathAuth,
 251			})
 252		}
 253	}
 254	return
 255}

 257func (w WebsiteService) UpdatePathAuthBasic(req request.NginxPathAuthUpdate) error {
 258	website, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.WebsiteID))
 259	if err != nil {
 260		return err
 261	}
 262	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
 263	authDir := GetSitePath(website, SitePathAuthBasicDir)
 264	if !fileOp.Stat(authDir) {
 265		_ = fileOp.CreateDir(authDir, constant.DirPerm)
 266	}
 267	passDir := path.Join(authDir, "pass")
 268	if !fileOp.Stat(passDir) {
 269		_ = fileOp.CreateDir(passDir, constant.DirPerm)
 270	}
 271	safeName := path.Base(req.Name)
 272	if safeName != req.Name || strings.Contains(safeName, "..") {
 273		return buserr.New("ErrInvalidParams")
 274	}
 275	confPath := path.Join(authDir, fmt.Sprintf("%s.conf", req.Name))
 276	passPath := path.Join(passDir, fmt.Sprintf("%s.pass", req.Name))
 277	var config *components.Config
 278	switch req.Operate {
 279	case "delete":
 280		_ = fileOp.DeleteFile(confPath)
 281		_ = fileOp.DeleteFile(passPath)
 282		return updateNginxConfig(constant.NginxScopeServer, nil, &website)
 283	case "create":
 284		config, err = parser.NewStringParser(string(nginx_conf.PathAuth)).Parse()
 285		if err != nil {
 286			return err
 287		}
 288		if fileOp.Stat(confPath) || fileOp.Stat(passPath) {
 289			return buserr.New("ErrNameIsExist")
 290		}
 291	case "edit":
 292		par, err := parser.NewParser(confPath)
 293		if err != nil {
 294			return err
 295		}
 296		config, err = par.Parse()
 297		if err != nil {
 298			return err
 299		}
 300	}
 301	config.FilePath = confPath
 302	directives := config.Directives
 303	location, _ := directives[0].(*components.Location)
 304	location.UpdateDirective("auth_basic_user_file", []string{fmt.Sprintf("/www/sites/%s/path_auth/pass/%s", website.Alias, fmt.Sprintf("%s.pass", req.Name))})
 305	location.ChangePath("~*", fmt.Sprintf("^%s", req.Path))
 306	var passwdHash []byte
 307	passwdHash, err = bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword([]byte(req.Password), bcrypt.DefaultCost)
 308	if err != nil {
 309		return err
 310	}
 311	line := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s\n", req.Username, passwdHash)
 312	if req.Remark != "" {
 313		line = fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s:%s\n", req.Username, passwdHash, req.Remark)
 314	}
 315	_ = fileOp.SaveFile(passPath, line, constant.DirPerm)
 316	if err = nginx.WriteConfig(config, nginx.IndentedStyle); err != nil {
 317		return buserr.WithErr("ErrUpdateBuWebsite", err)
 318	}
 319	nginxInclude := fmt.Sprintf("/www/sites/%s/path_auth/*.conf", website.Alias)
 320	if err = updateNginxConfig(constant.NginxScopeServer, []dto.NginxParam{{Name: "include", Params: []string{nginxInclude}}}, &website); err != nil {
 321		return err
 322	}
 323	return nil
 324}

  61func (w WebsiteCAService) Page(search request.WebsiteCASearch) (int64, []response.WebsiteCADTO, error) {
  62	total, cas, err := websiteCARepo.Page(search.Page, search.PageSize, repo.WithOrderDesc("created_at"))
  63	if err != nil {
  64		return 0, nil, err
  65	}
  66	var caDTOs []response.WebsiteCADTO

  75func (w WebsiteCAService) Create(create request.WebsiteCACreate) (*request.WebsiteCACreate, error) {
  76	if exist, _ := websiteCARepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByName(create.Name)); exist.ID > 0 {
  77		return nil, buserr.New("ErrNameIsExist")
  78	}
  79
  80	ca := &model.WebsiteCA{
  81		Name:    create.Name,
  82		KeyType: create.KeyType,
  83	}
  84
  85	pkixName := pkix.Name{
  86		CommonName:         create.CommonName,
  87		Country:            []string{create.Country},
  88		Organization:       []string{create.Organization},
  89		OrganizationalUnit: []string{create.OrganizationUint},
  90	}
  91	if create.Province != "" {
  92		pkixName.Province = []string{create.Province}
  93	}
  94	if create.City != "" {
  95		pkixName.Locality = []string{create.City}
  96	}
  97
  98	rootCA := &x509.Certificate{
  99		SerialNumber:          big.NewInt(time.Now().Unix() + 1),
 100		Subject:               pkixName,
 101		NotBefore:             time.Now(),
 102		NotAfter:              time.Now().AddDate(10, 0, 0),
 103		BasicConstraintsValid: true,
 104		IsCA:                  true,
 105		MaxPathLen:            1,
 106		MaxPathLenZero:        false,
 107		KeyUsage:              x509.KeyUsageCertSign | x509.KeyUsageCRLSign,
 108	}
 109
 110	interPrivateKey, interPublicKey, privateBytes, err := createPrivateKey(create.KeyType)
 111	if err != nil {
 112		return nil, err
 113	}
 114	ca.PrivateKey = string(privateBytes)
 115
 116	rootDer, err := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, rootCA, rootCA, interPublicKey, interPrivateKey)
 117	if err != nil {
 118		return nil, err
 119	}
 120	rootCert, err := x509.ParseCertificate(rootDer)
 121	if err != nil {
 122		return nil, err
 123	}
 124	certBlock := &pem.Block{
 125		Type:  "CERTIFICATE",
 126		Bytes: rootCert.Raw,
 127	}
 128	pemData := pem.EncodeToMemory(certBlock)
 129	ca.CSR = string(pemData)
 130
 131	if err := websiteCARepo.Create(context.Background(), ca); err != nil {
 132		return nil, err
 133	}
 134	return &create, nil
 135}

 137func (w WebsiteCAService) GetCA(id uint) (*response.WebsiteCADTO, error) {
 138	res := &response.WebsiteCADTO{}
 139	ca, err := websiteCARepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(id))
 140	if err != nil {
 141		return nil, err
 142	}
 143	res.WebsiteCA = ca
 144	certBlock, _ := pem.Decode([]byte(ca.CSR))
 145	if certBlock == nil {
 146		return nil, buserr.New("ErrSSLCertificateFormat")
 147	}
 148	cert, err := x509.ParseCertificate(certBlock.Bytes)
 149	if err != nil {
 150		return nil, err
 151	}
 152	res.CommonName = cert.Issuer.CommonName
 153	res.Organization = strings.Join(cert.Issuer.Organization, ",")
 154	res.Country = strings.Join(cert.Issuer.Country, ",")
 155	res.Province = strings.Join(cert.Issuer.Province, ",")
 156	res.City = strings.Join(cert.Issuer.Locality, ",")
 157	res.OrganizationUint = strings.Join(cert.Issuer.OrganizationalUnit, ",")
 158
 159	return res, nil
 160}

 177func (w WebsiteCAService) ObtainSSL(req request.WebsiteCAObtain) (*model.WebsiteSSL, error) {
 178	var (
 179		domains    []string
 180		ips        []net.IP
 181		websiteSSL = &model.WebsiteSSL{}
 182		err        error
 183		ca         model.WebsiteCA
 184	)
 185	if req.Renew {
 186		websiteSSL, err = websiteSSLRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.SSLID))
 187		if err != nil {
 188			return nil, err
 189		}
 190		ca, err = websiteCARepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(websiteSSL.CaID))
 191		if err != nil {
 192			return nil, err
 193		}
 194		existDomains := []string{websiteSSL.PrimaryDomain}
 195		if websiteSSL.Domains != "" {
 196			existDomains = append(existDomains, strings.Split(websiteSSL.Domains, ",")...)
 197		}
 198		for _, domain := range existDomains {
 199			if ipAddress := common.ParseIPLoose(domain); ipAddress == nil {
 200				domains = append(domains, domain)
 201			} else {
 202				ips = append(ips, ipAddress)
 203			}
 204		}
 205	} else {
 206		ca, err = websiteCARepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.ID))
 207		if err != nil {
 208			return nil, err
 209		}
 210		websiteSSL = &model.WebsiteSSL{
 211			Provider:    constant.SelfSigned,
 212			KeyType:     req.KeyType,
 213			PushDir:     req.PushDir,
 214			CaID:        ca.ID,
 215			AutoRenew:   req.AutoRenew,
 216			Description: req.Description,
 217			ExecShell:   req.ExecShell,
 218		}
 219		setSSLPushConfig(websiteSSL, req.PushNode, req.Nodes)
 220		if req.ExecShell {
 221			websiteSSL.Shell = req.Shell
 222		}
 223		if req.PushDir {
 224			if !files.NewFileOp().Stat(req.Dir) {
 225				return nil, buserr.New("ErrLinkPathNotFound")
 226			}
 227			websiteSSL.Dir = req.Dir
 228		}
 229		if req.Domains != "" {
 230			domainArray := strings.Split(req.Domains, "\n")
 231			for _, domain := range domainArray {
 232				if ipAddress := common.ParseIPLoose(domain); ipAddress == nil {
 233					if domain != "localhost" && !common.IsValidDomain(domain) {
 234						err = buserr.WithName("ErrDomainFormat", domain)
 235						return nil, err
 236					}
 237					domains = append(domains, domain)
 238				} else {
 239					ips = append(ips, ipAddress)
 240				}
 241			}
 242			if len(domains) > 0 {
 243				websiteSSL.PrimaryDomain = domains[0]
 244				websiteSSL.Domains = strings.Join(domains[1:], ",")
 245			}
 246			ipStrings := make([]string, len(ips))
 247			for i, ip := range ips {
 248				ipStrings[i] = ip.String()
 249			}
 250			if websiteSSL.PrimaryDomain == "" && len(ips) > 0 {
 251				websiteSSL.PrimaryDomain = ipStrings[0]
 252				ipStrings = ipStrings[1:]
 253			}
 254			if len(ipStrings) > 0 {
 255				if websiteSSL.Domains != "" {
 256					websiteSSL.Domains += ","
 257				}
 258				websiteSSL.Domains += strings.Join(ipStrings, ",")
 259			}
 260
 261		}
 262	}
 263
 264	rootCertBlock, _ := pem.Decode([]byte(ca.CSR))
 265	if rootCertBlock == nil {
 266		return nil, buserr.New("ErrSSLCertificateFormat")
 267	}
 268	rootCsr, err := x509.ParseCertificate(rootCertBlock.Bytes)
 269	if err != nil {
 270		return nil, err
 271	}
 272	rootPrivateKeyBlock, _ := pem.Decode([]byte(ca.PrivateKey))
 273	if rootPrivateKeyBlock == nil {
 274		return nil, buserr.New("ErrSSLCertificateFormat")
 275	}
 276
 277	var rootPrivateKey any
 278	if ssl.KeyType(ca.KeyType) == certcrypto.EC256 || ssl.KeyType(ca.KeyType) == certcrypto.EC384 {
 279		rootPrivateKey, err = x509.ParseECPrivateKey(rootPrivateKeyBlock.Bytes)
 280		if err != nil {
 281			return nil, err
 282		}
 283	} else {
 284		rootPrivateKey, err = x509.ParsePKCS1PrivateKey(rootPrivateKeyBlock.Bytes)
 285		if err != nil {
 286			return nil, err
 287		}
 288	}
 289	interPrivateKey, interPublicKey, _, err := createPrivateKey(websiteSSL.KeyType)
 290	if err != nil {
 291		return nil, err
 292	}
 293	notAfter := time.Now()
 294	if req.Unit == "year" {
 295		notAfter = notAfter.AddDate(req.Time, 0, 0)
 296	} else {
 297		notAfter = notAfter.AddDate(0, 0, req.Time)
 298	}
 299	interCsr := &x509.Certificate{
 300		SerialNumber:          big.NewInt(time.Now().Unix() + 2),
 301		Subject:               rootCsr.Subject,
 302		NotBefore:             time.Now(),
 303		NotAfter:              notAfter,
 304		BasicConstraintsValid: true,
 305		IsCA:                  true,
 306		MaxPathLen:            0,
 307		MaxPathLenZero:        true,
 308		KeyUsage:              x509.KeyUsageCertSign | x509.KeyUsageCRLSign,
 309	}
 310	interDer, err := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, interCsr, rootCsr, interPublicKey, rootPrivateKey)
 311	if err != nil {
 312		return nil, err
 313	}
 314	interCert, err := x509.ParseCertificate(interDer)
 315	if err != nil {
 316		return nil, err
 317	}
 318	interCertBlock := &pem.Block{
 319		Type:  "CERTIFICATE",
 320		Bytes: interCert.Raw,
 321	}
 322	_, publicKey, privateKeyBytes, err := createPrivateKey(websiteSSL.KeyType)
 323	if err != nil {
 324		return nil, err
 325	}
 326	commonName := ""
 327	if len(domains) > 0 {
 328		commonName = domains[0]
 329	}
 330	if len(ips) > 0 {
 331		commonName = ips[0].String()
 332	}
 333	subject := rootCsr.Subject
 334	subject.CommonName = commonName
 335	csr := &x509.Certificate{
 336		SerialNumber:          big.NewInt(time.Now().Unix() + 3),
 337		Subject:               subject,
 338		NotBefore:             time.Now(),
 339		NotAfter:              notAfter,
 340		BasicConstraintsValid: true,
 341		IsCA:                  false,
 342		KeyUsage:              x509.KeyUsageDigitalSignature | x509.KeyUsageKeyEncipherment,
 343		ExtKeyUsage:           []x509.ExtKeyUsage{x509.ExtKeyUsageServerAuth},
 344		DNSNames:              domains,
 345		IPAddresses:           ips,
 346	}
 347
 348	der, err := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, csr, interCert, publicKey, interPrivateKey)
 349	if err != nil {
 350		return nil, err
 351	}
 352	cert, err := x509.ParseCertificate(der)
 353	if err != nil {
 354		return nil, err
 355	}
 356
 357	certBlock := &pem.Block{
 358		Type:  "CERTIFICATE",
 359		Bytes: cert.Raw,
 360	}
 361	websiteSSL.Pem = string(pem.EncodeToMemory(certBlock)) + string(pem.EncodeToMemory(rootCertBlock)) + string(pem.EncodeToMemory(interCertBlock))
 362	websiteSSL.PrivateKey = string(privateKeyBytes)
 363	websiteSSL.ExpireDate = cert.NotAfter
 364	websiteSSL.StartDate = cert.NotBefore
 365	websiteSSL.Type = cert.Issuer.CommonName
 366	websiteSSL.Organization = rootCsr.Subject.Organization[0]
 367	websiteSSL.Status = constant.SSLReady
 368
 369	if req.Renew {
 370		if err := websiteSSLRepo.Save(websiteSSL); err != nil {
 371			return nil, err
 372		}
 373	} else {
 374		if err := websiteSSLRepo.Create(context.Background(), websiteSSL); err != nil {
 375			return nil, err
 376		}
 377	}
 378
 379	logFile, _ := os.OpenFile(path.Join(global.Dir.SSLLogDir, fmt.Sprintf("%s-ssl-%d.log", websiteSSL.PrimaryDomain, websiteSSL.ID)), os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_TRUNC, constant.FilePerm)
 380	defer logFile.Close()
 381	logger := log.New(logFile, "", log.LstdFlags)
 382	logger.Println(i18n.GetMsgWithMap("ApplySSLSuccess", map[string]interface{}{"domain": strings.Join(domains, ",")}))
 383	saveCertificateFile(websiteSSL, logger)
 384	if websiteSSL.ExecShell {
 385		workDir := global.Dir.DataDir
 386		if websiteSSL.PushDir {
 387			workDir = websiteSSL.Dir
 388		}
 389		logger.Println(i18n.GetMsgByKey("ExecShellStart"))
 390		if err = runShellScriptFile(workDir, websiteSSL.Shell, logger); err != nil {
 391			logger.Println(i18n.GetMsgWithMap("ErrExecShell", map[string]interface{}{"err": err.Error()}))
 392		} else {
 393			logger.Println(i18n.GetMsgByKey("ExecShellSuccess"))
 394		}
 395	}
 396	reloadSystemSSL(websiteSSL, logger)
 397	if websiteSSL.PushNode {
 398		if err = pushSSLToNode(websiteSSL, logger); err != nil {
 399			return nil, err
 400		}
 401	}
 402	return websiteSSL, nil
 403}

 405func createPrivateKey(keyType string) (privateKey any, publicKey any, privateKeyBytes []byte, err error) {
 406	privateKey, err = certcrypto.GeneratePrivateKey(ssl.KeyType(keyType))
 407	if err != nil {
 408		return
 409	}
 410	var (
 411		caPrivateKeyPEM = new(bytes.Buffer)
 412	)
 413	if ssl.KeyType(keyType) == certcrypto.EC256 || ssl.KeyType(keyType) == certcrypto.EC384 {
 414		publicKey = &privateKey.(*ecdsa.PrivateKey).PublicKey
 415		publicKey = publicKey.(*ecdsa.PublicKey)
 416		block := &pem.Block{
 417			Type: "EC PRIVATE KEY",
 418		}
 419		privateBytes, sErr := x509.MarshalECPrivateKey(privateKey.(*ecdsa.PrivateKey))
 420		if sErr != nil {
 421			err = sErr
 422			return
 423		}
 424		block.Bytes = privateBytes
 425		_ = pem.Encode(caPrivateKeyPEM, block)
 426	} else {
 427		publicKey = &privateKey.(*rsa.PrivateKey).PublicKey
 428		_ = pem.Encode(caPrivateKeyPEM, &pem.Block{
 429			Type:  "RSA PRIVATE KEY",
 430			Bytes: x509.MarshalPKCS1PrivateKey(privateKey.(*rsa.PrivateKey)),
 431		})
 432	}
 433	privateKeyBytes = caPrivateKeyPEM.Bytes()
 434	return
 435}
 436
 437func (w WebsiteCAService) DownloadFile(id uint) (*os.File, error) {
 438	ca, err := websiteCARepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(id))
 439	if err != nil {
 440		return nil, err
 441	}
 442	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
 443	dir := path.Join(global.Dir.DataDir, "tmp/ssl", ca.Name)
 444	if fileOp.Stat(dir) {
 445		if err = fileOp.DeleteDir(dir); err != nil {
 446			return nil, err
 447		}
 448	}
 449	if err = fileOp.CreateDir(dir, constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 450		return nil, err
 451	}
 452	if err = fileOp.WriteFile(path.Join(dir, "ca.crt"), strings.NewReader(ca.CSR), constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 453		return nil, err
 454	}
 455	if err = fileOp.WriteFile(path.Join(dir, "ca.key"), strings.NewReader(ca.PrivateKey), constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 456		return nil, err
 457	}
 458	fileName := ca.Name + ".zip"
 459	if err = fileOp.Compress(context.Background(), []string{path.Join(dir, "ca.crt"), path.Join(dir, "ca.key")}, dir, fileName, files.SdkZip, "", nil); err != nil {
 460		return nil, err
 461	}
 462	return os.Open(path.Join(dir, fileName))
 463}

  29	Create(create request.WebsiteDnsAccountCreate) (request.WebsiteDnsAccountCreate, error)
  30	Update(update request.WebsiteDnsAccountUpdate) (request.WebsiteDnsAccountUpdate, error)

  34func NewIWebsiteDnsAccountService() IWebsiteDnsAccountService {
  35	return &WebsiteDnsAccountService{}
  36}

  38func (w WebsiteDnsAccountService) Page(search dto.PageInfo) (int64, []response.WebsiteDnsAccountDTO, error) {
  39	total, accounts, err := websiteDnsRepo.Page(search.Page, search.PageSize, repo.WithOrderDesc("created_at"))
  40	var accountDTOs []response.WebsiteDnsAccountDTO
  41	for _, account := range accounts {
  42		auth := make(map[string]string)
  43		_ = json.Unmarshal([]byte(account.Authorization), &auth)
  44		accountDTOs = append(accountDTOs, response.WebsiteDnsAccountDTO{
  45			WebsiteDnsAccount: account,
  46			Authorization:     auth,
  47		})
  48	}
  49	return total, accountDTOs, err
  50}
  51
  52func (w WebsiteDnsAccountService) Create(create request.WebsiteDnsAccountCreate) (request.WebsiteDnsAccountCreate, error) {
  53	exist, _ := websiteDnsRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByName(create.Name))
  54	if exist != nil {
  55		return request.WebsiteDnsAccountCreate{}, buserr.New("ErrNameIsExist")
  56	}
  57
  58	authorization, err := json.Marshal(create.Authorization)
  59	if err != nil {
  60		return request.WebsiteDnsAccountCreate{}, err
  61	}
  62
  63	if err := websiteDnsRepo.Create(model.WebsiteDnsAccount{
  64		Name:          create.Name,
  65		Type:          create.Type,
  66		Authorization: string(authorization),
  67	}); err != nil {
  68		return request.WebsiteDnsAccountCreate{}, err
  69	}
  70
  71	return create, nil
  72}
  73
  74func (w WebsiteDnsAccountService) Update(update request.WebsiteDnsAccountUpdate) (request.WebsiteDnsAccountUpdate, error) {
  75	authorization, err := json.Marshal(update.Authorization)
  76	if err != nil {
  77		return request.WebsiteDnsAccountUpdate{}, err
  78	}
  79	exists, _ := websiteDnsRepo.List(repo.WithByName(update.Name))
  80	for _, exist := range exists {
  81		if exist.ID != update.ID {
  82			return request.WebsiteDnsAccountUpdate{}, buserr.New("ErrNameIsExist")
  83		}
  84	}
  85	if err := websiteDnsRepo.Save(model.WebsiteDnsAccount{
  86		BaseModel: model.BaseModel{
  87			ID: update.ID,
  88		},
  89		Name:          update.Name,
  90		Type:          update.Type,
  91		Authorization: string(authorization),
  92	}); err != nil {
  93		return request.WebsiteDnsAccountUpdate{}, err
  94	}
  95
  96	return update, nil
  97}
  98
  99func (w WebsiteDnsAccountService) Delete(id uint) error {
 100	if ssls, _ := websiteSSLRepo.List(websiteSSLRepo.WithByDnsAccountId(id)); len(ssls) > 0 {
 101		return buserr.New("ErrAccountCannotDelete")
 102	}
 103	return websiteDnsRepo.DeleteBy(repo.WithByID(id))
 104}

  23func (w WebsiteService) CreateWebsiteDomain(create request.WebsiteDomainCreate) ([]model.WebsiteDomain, error) {
  24	var (
  25		domainModels []model.WebsiteDomain
  26		addPorts     []int
  27	)
  28	httpPort, httpsPort, err := getAppInstallPort(constant.AppOpenresty)
  29	if err != nil {
  30		return nil, err
  31	}
  32	website, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(create.WebsiteID))
  33	if err != nil {
  34		return nil, err
  35	}
  36
  37	domainModels, addPorts, _, err = getWebsiteDomains(create.Domains, httpPort, httpsPort, create.WebsiteID)
  38	if err != nil {
  39		return nil, err
  40	}
  41	go func() {
  42		_ = OperateFirewallPort(nil, addPorts)
  43	}()
  44
  45	nginxInstall, err := getAppInstallByKey(constant.AppOpenresty)
  46	if err != nil {
  47		return nil, err
  48	}
  49	wafDataPath := path.Join(nginxInstall.GetPath(), "1pwaf", "data")
  50	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
  51	if fileOp.Stat(wafDataPath) {
  52		websitesConfigPath := path.Join(wafDataPath, "conf", "sites.json")
  53		content, err := fileOp.GetContent(websitesConfigPath)
  54		if err != nil {
  55			return nil, err
  56		}
  57		var websitesArray []request.WafWebsite
  58		if content != nil {
  59			if err := json.Unmarshal(content, &websitesArray); err != nil {
  60				return nil, err
  61			}
  62		}
  63		for index, wafWebsite := range websitesArray {
  64			if wafWebsite.Key == website.Alias {
  65				wafSite := request.WafWebsite{
  66					Key:     website.Alias,
  67					Domains: wafWebsite.Domains,
  68					Host:    wafWebsite.Host,
  69				}
  70				for _, domain := range domainModels {
  71					wafSite.Domains = append(wafSite.Domains, domain.Domain)
  72					wafSite.Host = append(wafSite.Host, domain.Domain+":"+strconv.Itoa(domain.Port))
  73				}
  74				if len(wafSite.Host) == 0 {
  75					wafSite.Host = []string{}
  76				}
  77				websitesArray[index] = wafSite
  78				break
  79			}
  80		}
  81		websitesContent, err := json.Marshal(websitesArray)
  82		if err != nil {
  83			return nil, err
  84		}
  85		if err := fileOp.SaveFileWithByte(websitesConfigPath, websitesContent, constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
  86			return nil, err
  87		}
  88	}
  89
  90	if err = addListenAndServerName(website, domainModels); err != nil {
  91		return nil, err
  92	}
  93
  94	return domainModels, websiteDomainRepo.BatchCreate(context.TODO(), domainModels)
  95}

 101func (w WebsiteService) DeleteWebsiteDomain(domainId uint) error {
 102	webSiteDomain, err := websiteDomainRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(domainId))
 103	if err != nil {
 104		return err
 105	}
 106
 107	if websiteDomains, _ := websiteDomainRepo.GetBy(websiteDomainRepo.WithWebsiteId(webSiteDomain.WebsiteID)); len(websiteDomains) == 1 {
 108		return fmt.Errorf("can not delete last domain")
 109	}
 110	website, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(webSiteDomain.WebsiteID))
 111	if err != nil {
 112		return err
 113	}
 114	var ports []int
 115	if oldDomains, _ := websiteDomainRepo.GetBy(websiteDomainRepo.WithWebsiteId(webSiteDomain.WebsiteID), websiteDomainRepo.WithPort(webSiteDomain.Port)); len(oldDomains) == 1 {
 116		ports = append(ports, webSiteDomain.Port)
 117	}
 118
 119	var domains []string
 120	if oldDomains, _ := websiteDomainRepo.GetBy(websiteDomainRepo.WithWebsiteId(webSiteDomain.WebsiteID), websiteDomainRepo.WithDomain(webSiteDomain.Domain)); len(oldDomains) == 1 {
 121		domains = append(domains, webSiteDomain.Domain)
 122	}
 123
 124	if len(ports) > 0 || len(domains) > 0 {
 125		stringBinds := make([]string, len(ports))
 126		for i := 0; i < len(ports); i++ {
 127			stringBinds[i] = strconv.Itoa(ports[i])
 128		}
 129		if err := deleteListenAndServerName(website, stringBinds, domains); err != nil {
 130			return err
 131		}
 132	}
 133
 134	nginxInstall, err := getAppInstallByKey(constant.AppOpenresty)
 135	if err != nil {
 136		return err
 137	}
 138	wafDataPath := path.Join(nginxInstall.GetPath(), "1pwaf", "data")
 139	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
 140	if fileOp.Stat(wafDataPath) {
 141		websitesConfigPath := path.Join(wafDataPath, "conf", "sites.json")
 142		content, err := fileOp.GetContent(websitesConfigPath)
 143		if err != nil {
 144			return err
 145		}
 146		var websitesArray []request.WafWebsite
 147		var newWebsitesArray []request.WafWebsite
 148		if content != nil {
 149			if err := json.Unmarshal(content, &websitesArray); err != nil {
 150				return err
 151			}
 152		}
 153		for _, wafWebsite := range websitesArray {
 154			if wafWebsite.Key == website.Alias {
 155				wafSite := wafWebsite
 156				oldDomains := wafSite.Domains
 157				var newDomains []string
 158				for _, domain := range oldDomains {
 159					if domain == webSiteDomain.Domain {
 160						continue
 161					}
 162					newDomains = append(newDomains, domain)
 163				}
 164				wafSite.Domains = newDomains
 165				oldHostArray := wafSite.Host
 166				var newHostArray []string
 167				for _, host := range oldHostArray {
 168					if host == webSiteDomain.Domain+":"+strconv.Itoa(webSiteDomain.Port) {
 169						continue
 170					}
 171					newHostArray = append(newHostArray, host)
 172				}
 173				wafSite.Host = newHostArray
 174				if len(wafSite.Host) == 0 {
 175					wafSite.Host = []string{}
 176				}
 177				newWebsitesArray = append(newWebsitesArray, wafSite)
 178			} else {
 179				newWebsitesArray = append(newWebsitesArray, wafWebsite)
 180			}
 181		}
 182		websitesContent, err := json.Marshal(newWebsitesArray)
 183		if err != nil {
 184			return err
 185		}
 186		if err = fileOp.SaveFileWithByte(websitesConfigPath, websitesContent, constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 187			return err
 188		}
 189	}
 190
 191	return websiteDomainRepo.DeleteBy(context.TODO(), repo.WithByID(domainId))
 192}

  29func (w WebsiteService) GetLoadBalances(id uint) ([]dto.NginxUpstream, error) {
  30	website, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(id))
  31	if err != nil {
  32		return nil, err
  33	}
  34	includeDir := GetSitePath(website, SiteUpstreamDir)
  35	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
  36	if !fileOp.Stat(includeDir) {
  37		return nil, nil
  38	}
  39	entries, err := os.ReadDir(includeDir)
  40	if err != nil {
  41		return nil, err
  42	}
  43	var res []dto.NginxUpstream
  44	for _, entry := range entries {
  45		if entry.IsDir() {
  46			continue
  47		}
  48		name := entry.Name()
  49		if !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".conf") {
  50			continue
  51		}
  52		upstreamName := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".conf")
  53		upstream := dto.NginxUpstream{
  54			Name: upstreamName,
  55		}
  56		upstreamPath := path.Join(includeDir, name)
  57		content, err := fileOp.GetContent(upstreamPath)
  58		if err != nil {
  59			return nil, err
  60		}
  61		upstream.Content = string(content)
  62		nginxParser, err := parser.NewParser(upstreamPath)
  63		if err != nil {
  64			return nil, err
  65		}
  66		config, err := nginxParser.Parse()
  67		if err != nil {
  68			return nil, err
  69		}
  70		upstreams := config.FindUpstreams()
  71		for _, up := range upstreams {
  72			if up.UpstreamName == upstreamName {
  73				directives := up.GetDirectives()
  74				for _, d := range directives {
  75					dName := d.GetName()
  76					if _, ok := dto.LBAlgorithms[dName]; ok {
  77						upstream.Algorithm = dName
  78					}
  79				}
  80				upstream.Servers = getNginxUpstreamServers(up.UpstreamServers)
  81			}
  82		}
  83		res = append(res, upstream)
  84	}
  85	return res, nil
  86}
  87
  88func (w WebsiteService) CreateLoadBalance(req request.WebsiteLBCreate) error {
  89	website, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.WebsiteID))
  90	if err != nil {
  91		return err
  92	}
  93	includeDir := GetSitePath(website, SiteUpstreamDir)
  94	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
  95	if !fileOp.Stat(includeDir) {
  96		_ = fileOp.CreateDir(includeDir, constant.DirPerm)
  97	}
  98	safeName := path.Base(req.Name)
  99	if safeName != req.Name || strings.Contains(safeName, "..") {
 100		return buserr.New("ErrInvalidParams")
 101	}
 102	filePath := path.Join(includeDir, fmt.Sprintf("%s.conf", req.Name))
 103	if fileOp.Stat(filePath) {
 104		return buserr.New("ErrNameIsExist")
 105	}
 106	config, err := parser.NewStringParser(string(nginx_conf.Upstream)).Parse()
 107	if err != nil {
 108		return err
 109	}
 110	config.Block = &components.Block{}
 111	config.FilePath = filePath
 112	upstream := components.Upstream{
 113		UpstreamName: req.Name,
 114	}
 115	if req.Algorithm != "default" {
 116		upstream.UpdateDirective(req.Algorithm, []string{})
 117	}
 118	upstream.UpstreamServers = parseUpstreamServers(req.Servers)
 119	config.Block.Directives = append(config.Block.Directives, &upstream)
 120
 121	defer func() {
 122		if err != nil {
 123			_ = fileOp.DeleteFile(filePath)
 124		}
 125	}()
 126
 127	if err = nginx.WriteConfig(config, nginx.IndentedStyle); err != nil {
 128		return buserr.WithErr("ErrUpdateBuWebsite", err)
 129	}
 130	nginxInclude := fmt.Sprintf("/www/sites/%s/upstream/*.conf", website.Alias)
 131	if err = updateNginxConfig("", []dto.NginxParam{{Name: "include", Params: []string{nginxInclude}}}, &website); err != nil {
 132		return err
 133	}
 134	return nil
 135}

 137func (w WebsiteService) UpdateLoadBalance(req request.WebsiteLBUpdate) error {
 138	website, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.WebsiteID))
 139	if err != nil {
 140		return err
 141	}
 142	nginxInstall, err := getAppInstallByKey(constant.AppOpenresty)
 143	if err != nil {
 144		return err
 145	}
 146	includeDir := GetSitePath(website, SiteUpstreamDir)
 147	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
 148	safeName := path.Base(req.Name)
 149	if safeName != req.Name || strings.Contains(safeName, "..") {
 150		return buserr.New("ErrInvalidParams")
 151	}
 152	filePath := path.Join(includeDir, fmt.Sprintf("%s.conf", req.Name))
 153	if !fileOp.Stat(filePath) {
 154		return nil
 155	}
 156	oldContent, err := fileOp.GetContent(filePath)
 157	if err != nil {
 158		return err
 159	}
 160	parser, err := parser.NewParser(filePath)
 161	if err != nil {
 162		return err
 163	}
 164	config, err := parser.Parse()
 165	if err != nil {
 166		return err
 167	}
 168	upstreams := config.FindUpstreams()
 169	for _, up := range upstreams {
 170		if up.UpstreamName == req.Name {
 171			directives := up.GetDirectives()
 172			for _, d := range directives {
 173				dName := d.GetName()
 174				if _, ok := dto.LBAlgorithms[dName]; ok {
 175					up.RemoveDirective(dName, nil)
 176				}
 177			}
 178			if req.Algorithm != "default" {
 179				up.UpdateDirective(req.Algorithm, []string{})
 180			}
 181			up.UpstreamServers = parseUpstreamServers(req.Servers)
 182		}
 183	}
 184	if err = nginx.WriteConfig(config, nginx.IndentedStyle); err != nil {
 185		return buserr.WithErr("ErrUpdateBuWebsite", err)
 186	}
 187	return nginxCheckAndReload(string(oldContent), filePath, nginxInstall.ContainerName)
 188}

 190func (w WebsiteService) DeleteLoadBalance(req request.WebsiteLBDelete) error {
 191	website, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.WebsiteID))
 192	if err != nil {
 193		return err
 194	}
 195	nginxInstall, err := getAppInstallByKey(constant.AppOpenresty)
 196	if err != nil {
 197		return err
 198	}
 199	proxies, _ := w.GetProxies(website.ID)
 200	if len(proxies) > 0 {
 201		for _, proxy := range proxies {
 202			if strings.HasSuffix(proxy.ProxyPass, fmt.Sprintf(":">//%s", req.Name)) {
 203				return buserr.New("ErrProxyIsUsed")
 204			}
 205		}
 206	}
 207
 208	includeDir := GetSitePath(website, SiteUpstreamDir)
 209	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
 210	safeName := path.Base(req.Name)
 211	if safeName != req.Name || strings.Contains(safeName, "..") {
 212		return buserr.New("ErrInvalidParams")
 213	}
 214	filePath := path.Join(includeDir, fmt.Sprintf("%s.conf", req.Name))
 215	if !fileOp.Stat(filePath) {
 216		return nil
 217	}
 218	if err = fileOp.DeleteFile(filePath); err != nil {
 219		return err
 220	}
 221	return opNginx(nginxInstall.ContainerName, constant.NginxReload)
 222}

 224func (w WebsiteService) UpdateLoadBalanceFile(req request.WebsiteLBUpdateFile) error {
 225	website, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.WebsiteID))
 226	if err != nil {
 227		return err
 228	}
 229	nginxInstall, err := getAppInstallByKey(constant.AppOpenresty)
 230	if err != nil {
 231		return err
 232	}
 233	includeDir := GetSitePath(website, SiteUpstreamDir)
 234	safeName := path.Base(req.Name)

 236		return buserr.New("ErrInvalidParams")

 238	filePath := path.Join(includeDir, fmt.Sprintf("%s.conf", req.Name))
 239	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
 240	oldContent, err := fileOp.GetContent(filePath)
 241	if err != nil {
 242		return err
 243	}
 244	if err = fileOp.WriteFile(filePath, strings.NewReader(req.Content), constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 245		return err

 247	defer func() {

 249			_ = fileOp.WriteFile(filePath, bytes.NewReader(oldContent), constant.DirPerm)
 250		}
 251	}()
 252	return opNginx(nginxInstall.ContainerName, constant.NginxReload)
 253}

   8package service
   9
  10import (
  11	"context"
  12	"fmt"
  13	"github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/agent/app/dto/request"
  14	"github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/agent/app/repo"

  20
  21func (w WebsiteService) BatchOpWebsite(req request.BatchWebsiteOp) error {
  22	websites, _ := websiteRepo.List(repo.WithByIDs(req.IDs))
  23	opTask, err := task.NewTaskWithOps(i18n.GetMsgByKey("Status"), task.TaskBatch, task.TaskScopeWebsite, req.TaskID, 0)
  24	if err != nil {
  25		return err
  26	}
  27	sort.SliceStable(websites, func(i, j int) bool {
  28		if websites[i].Type == constant.Subsite && websites[j].Type != constant.Subsite {
  29			return true
  30		}
  31		if websites[i].Type != constant.Subsite && websites[j].Type == constant.Subsite {
  32			return false
  33		}
  34		return false
  35	})
  36	opWebsiteTask := func(t *task.Task) error {
  37		for _, web := range websites {
  38			msg := fmt.Sprintf("%s %s", i18n.GetMsgByKey(req.Operate), web.PrimaryDomain)
  39			switch req.Operate {
  40			case constant.StopWeb, constant.StartWeb:
  41				if err := opWebsite(&web, req.Operate); err != nil {
  42					t.LogFailedWithErr(msg, err)
  43					continue
  44				}
  45				_ = websiteRepo.Save(context.Background(), &web)
  46			case "delete":
  47				if err := w.DeleteWebsite(request.WebsiteDelete{
  48					ID: web.ID,
  49				}); err != nil {
  50					t.LogFailedWithErr(msg, err)
  51					continue
  52				}
  53			}
  54
  55			t.LogSuccess(msg)
  56		}
  57		return nil
  58	}
  59	opTask.AddSubTask("", opWebsiteTask, nil)
  60
  61	go func() {
  62		_ = opTask.Execute()
  63	}()
  64	return nil
  65}

  78func (w WebsiteService) BatchSetHttps(ctx context.Context, req request.BatchWebsiteHttps) error {
  79	websites, _ := websiteRepo.List(repo.WithByIDs(req.IDs))
  80	opTask, err := task.NewTaskWithOps(i18n.GetMsgByKey("SSL"), task.TaskBatch, task.TaskScopeWebsite, req.TaskID, 0)
  81	if err != nil {
  82		return err
  83	}
  84	websiteHttpsOp := request.WebsiteHTTPSOp{
  85		Enable:                true,
  86		WebsiteSSLID:          req.WebsiteSSLID,
  87		Type:                  req.Type,
  88		PrivateKey:            req.PrivateKey,
  89		Certificate:           req.Certificate,
  90		PrivateKeyPath:        req.PrivateKeyPath,
  91		CertificatePath:       req.CertificatePath,
  92		ImportType:            req.ImportType,
  93		HttpConfig:            req.HttpConfig,
  94		SSLProtocol:           req.SSLProtocol,
  95		Algorithm:             req.Algorithm,
  96		Hsts:                  req.Hsts,
  97		HstsIncludeSubDomains: req.HstsIncludeSubDomains,
  98		HttpsPorts:            req.HttpsPorts,
  99		Http3:                 req.Http3,
 100	}
 101	if req.Type == constant.SSLManual {
 102		websiteSSL, err := getManualWebsiteSSL(websiteHttpsOp)
 103		if err != nil {
 104			return err
 105		}
 106		if err = websiteSSLRepo.Create(ctx, &websiteSSL); err != nil {
 107			return err
 108		}
 109		websiteHttpsOp.Type = constant.SSLExisted
 110		websiteHttpsOp.WebsiteSSLID = websiteSSL.ID
 111	}
 112	opWebsiteTask := func(t *task.Task) error {
 113		for _, web := range websites {
 114			if web.Type == constant.Stream {
 115				continue
 116			}
 117			websiteHttpsOp.WebsiteID = web.ID
 118			msg := fmt.Sprintf("%s [%s] %s", i18n.GetMsgByKey("Set"), web.PrimaryDomain, i18n.GetMsgByKey("SSL"))
 119			if _, err := w.OpWebsiteHTTPS(ctx, websiteHttpsOp); err != nil {
 120				t.LogFailedWithErr(msg, err)
 121				continue
 122			}
 123			t.LogSuccess(msg)
 124		}
 125		return nil
 126	}
 127
 128	opTask.AddSubTask("", opWebsiteTask, nil)
 129	go func() {
 130		_ = opTask.Execute()
 131	}()
 132	return nil
 133}

  33func (w WebsiteService) OperateProxy(req request.WebsiteProxyConfig) (err error) {
  34	switch req.Operate {
  35	case "delete":
  36		return w.DeleteProxy(request.WebsiteProxyDel{
  37			ID:   req.ID,
  38			Name: req.Name,
  39		})
  40	case "disable":
  41		fallthrough
  42	case "enable":
  43		return w.UpdateProxyStatus(request.WebsiteProxyStatusUpdate{
  44			ID:     req.ID,
  45			Name:   req.Name,
  46			Status: req.Operate,
  47		})
  48	}
  49	var (
  50		website    model.Website
  51		par        *parser.Parser
  52		oldContent []byte
  53	)
  54
  55	website, err = websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.ID))
  56	if err != nil {
  57		return
  58	}
  59	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
  60	includeDir := GetSitePath(website, SiteProxyDir)
  61	if !fileOp.Stat(includeDir) {
  62		_ = fileOp.CreateDir(includeDir, constant.DirPerm)
  63	}
  64	fileName := fmt.Sprintf("%s.conf", req.Name)
  65	includePath := path.Join(includeDir, fileName)
  66	backName := fmt.Sprintf("%s.bak", req.Name)
  67	backPath := path.Join(includeDir, backName)
  68
  69	if req.Operate == "create" && (fileOp.Stat(includePath) || fileOp.Stat(backPath)) {
  70		err = buserr.New("ErrNameIsExist")
  71		return
  72	}
  73
  74	defer func() {
  75		if err != nil {
  76			switch req.Operate {
  77			case "create":
  78				_ = fileOp.DeleteFile(includePath)
  79			case "edit":
  80				_ = fileOp.WriteFile(includePath, bytes.NewReader(oldContent), constant.DirPerm)
  81			}
  82		}
  83	}()
  84
  85	var config *components.Config
  86
  87	switch req.Operate {
  88	case "create":
  89		config, err = parser.NewStringParser(string(nginx_conf.GetWebsiteFile("proxy.conf"))).Parse()
  90		if err != nil {
  91			return
  92		}
  93	case "edit":
  94		par, err = parser.NewParser(includePath)
  95		if err != nil {
  96			return
  97		}
  98		config, err = par.Parse()
  99		if err != nil {
 100			return
 101		}
 102		oldContent, err = fileOp.GetContent(includePath)
 103		if err != nil {
 104			return
 105		}
 106	default:
 107		return errors.New("unknown operate")
 108	}
 109
 110	config.FilePath = includePath
 111	directives := config.Directives
 112
 113	var location *components.Location
 114	for _, directive := range directives {
 115		if loc, ok := directive.(*components.Location); ok {
 116			location = loc
 117			break
 118		}
 119	}
 120	if location == nil {
 121		err = errors.New("invalid proxy config, no location found")
 122		return
 123	}
 124	applyLocationProxyPass(location, req.ProxyPass, &req.SNI, req.ProxySSLName)
 125	if isHTTPSProxyPass(req.ProxyPass) && req.SSLVerify {
 126		location.UpdateDirective("proxy_ssl_verify", []string{"on"})
 127		location.UpdateDirective("proxy_ssl_trusted_certificate", []string{"/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt"})
 128	} else {
 129		location.RemoveDirective("proxy_ssl_verify", []string{})
 130		location.RemoveDirective("proxy_ssl_trusted_certificate", []string{})
 131	}
 132	location.UpdateDirective("proxy_set_header", []string{"Host", req.ProxyHost})
 133	location.ChangePath(req.Modifier, req.Match)
 134	"cmt">// Server Cache Settings
 135	if req.Cache {
 136		if err = openProxyCache(website); err != nil {
 137			return
 138		}
 139		location.AddServerCache(fmt.Sprintf("proxy_cache_zone_of_%s", website.Alias), req.ServerCacheTime, req.ServerCacheUnit)
 140	} else {
 141		location.RemoveServerCache(fmt.Sprintf("proxy_cache_zone_of_%s", website.Alias))
 142	}
 143	"cmt">// Browser Cache Settings
 144	"cmt">// cacheTime > 0: enable expires;
 145	"cmt">// cacheTime == 0: use upstream cache-control, remove self-set;
 146	"cmt">// cacheTime < 0: force no-cache
 147	if req.CacheTime > 0 {
 148		location.AddBrowserCache(req.CacheTime, req.CacheUnit)
 149	} else if req.CacheTime < 0 {
 150		location.AddBroswerNoCache()
 151	} else {
 152		location.RemoveBrowserCache()
 153	}
 154	"cmt">// Content Replace Settings
 155	if len(req.Replaces) > 0 {
 156		location.AddSubFilter(req.Replaces)
 157	} else {
 158		location.RemoveSubFilter()
 159	}
 160	"cmt">// Explicit SNI configuration still takes precedence over the automatic HTTPS upstream default.
 161	"cmt">// CORS Settings
 162	if req.Cors {
 163		location.UpdateDirective("add_header", []string{"Access-Control-Allow-Origin", req.AllowOrigins, "always"})
 164		if req.AllowMethods != "" {
 165			location.UpdateDirective("add_header", []string{"Access-Control-Allow-Methods", req.AllowMethods, "always"})
 166		} else {
 167			location.RemoveDirective("add_header", []string{"Access-Control-Allow-Methods"})
 168		}
 169		if req.AllowHeaders != "" {
 170			location.UpdateDirective("add_header", []string{"Access-Control-Allow-Headers", req.AllowHeaders, "always"})
 171		} else {
 172			location.RemoveDirective("add_header", []string{"Access-Control-Allow-Headers"})
 173		}
 174		if req.AllowCredentials {
 175			location.UpdateDirective("add_header", []string{"Access-Control-Allow-Credentials", "true", "always"})
 176		} else {
 177			location.RemoveDirective("add_header", []string{"Access-Control-Allow-Credentials"})
 178		}
 179		if req.Preflight {
 180			location.AddCorsOption()
 181		} else {
 182			location.RemoveCorsOption()
 183		}
 184	} else {
 185		location.RemoveDirective("add_header", []string{"Access-Control-Allow-Origin"})
 186		location.RemoveDirective("add_header", []string{"Access-Control-Allow-Methods"})
 187		location.RemoveDirective("add_header", []string{"Access-Control-Allow-Headers"})
 188		location.RemoveDirective("add_header", []string{"Access-Control-Allow-Credentials"})
 189		location.RemoveDirectiveByFullParams("if", []string{"(", "$request_method", "=", "'OPTIONS'", ")"})
 190	}
 191	if err = nginx.WriteConfig(config, nginx.IndentedStyle); err != nil {
 192		return buserr.WithErr("ErrUpdateBuWebsite", err)
 193	}
 194	nginxInclude := fmt.Sprintf("/www/sites/%s/proxy/*.conf", website.Alias)
 195	return updateNginxConfig(constant.NginxScopeServer, []dto.NginxParam{{Name: "include", Params: []string{nginxInclude}}}, &website)

 198func (w WebsiteService) UpdateProxyCache(req request.NginxProxyCacheUpdate) (err error) {
 199	website, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.WebsiteID))
 200	if err != nil {
 201		return
 202	}
 203	cacheDir := GetSitePath(website, SiteCacheDir)
 204	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
 205	if !fileOp.Stat(cacheDir) {
 206		_ = fileOp.CreateDir(cacheDir, constant.DirPerm)
 207	}
 208	if req.Open {
 209		proxyCachePath := fmt.Sprintf("/www/sites/%s/cache levels=1:2 keys_zone=proxy_cache_zone_of_%s:%d%s max_size=%d%s inactive=%d%s", website.Alias, website.Alias, req.ShareCache, req.ShareCacheUnit, req.CacheLimit, req.CacheLimitUnit, req.CacheExpire, req.CacheExpireUnit)
 210		return updateNginxConfig("", []dto.NginxParam{{Name: "proxy_cache_path", Params: []string{proxyCachePath}}}, &website)
 211	}
 212	return deleteNginxConfig("", []dto.NginxParam{{Name: "proxy_cache_path"}}, &website)
 213}

 215func (w WebsiteService) GetProxyCache(id uint) (res response.NginxProxyCache, err error) {
 216	var (
 217		website model.Website
 218	)
 219	website, err = websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(id))
 220	if err != nil {
 221		return
 222	}
 223
 224	parser, err := parser.NewParser(GetSitePath(website, SiteConf))
 225	if err != nil {
 226		return
 227	}
 228	config, err := parser.Parse()
 229	if err != nil {
 230		return
 231	}
 232	var params []string
 233	for _, d := range config.GetDirectives() {
 234		if d.GetName() == "proxy_cache_path" {
 235			params = d.GetParameters()
 236		}
 237	}
 238	if len(params) == 0 {
 239		return
 240	}
 241	for _, param := range params {
 242		if re.GetRegex(re.ProxyCacheZonePattern).MatchString(param) {
 243			matches := re.GetRegex(re.ProxyCacheZonePattern).FindStringSubmatch(param)
 244			if len(matches) > 0 {
 245				res.ShareCache, _ = strconv.Atoi(matches[1])
 246				res.ShareCacheUnit = matches[2]
 247			}
 248		}
 249
 250		if re.GetRegex(re.ProxyCacheMaxSizeValidationPattern).MatchString(param) {
 251			matches := re.GetRegex(re.ProxyCacheMaxSizePattern).FindStringSubmatch(param)
 252			if len(matches) > 0 {
 253				res.CacheLimit, _ = strconv.ParseFloat(matches[1], 64)
 254				res.CacheLimitUnit = matches[2]
 255			}
 256		}
 257		if re.GetRegex(re.ProxyCacheInactivePattern).MatchString(param) {
 258			matches := re.GetRegex(re.ProxyCacheInactivePattern).FindStringSubmatch(param)
 259			if len(matches) > 0 {
 260				res.CacheExpire, _ = strconv.Atoi(matches[1])
 261				res.CacheExpireUnit = matches[2]
 262			}
 263		}
 264	}
 265	res.Open = true
 266	return
 267}

 269func (w WebsiteService) GetProxies(id uint) (res []request.WebsiteProxyConfig, err error) {
 270	var (
 271		website  model.Website
 272		fileList response.FileInfo
 273	)
 274	website, err = websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(id))
 275	if err != nil {
 276		return
 277	}
 278	includeDir := GetSitePath(website, SiteProxyDir)
 279	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
 280	if !fileOp.Stat(includeDir) {
 281		return
 282	}
 283	fileList, err = NewIFileService().GetFileList(request.FileOption{FileOption: files.FileOption{Path: includeDir, Expand: true, Page: 1, PageSize: 100}})
 284	if len(fileList.Items) == 0 {
 285		return
 286	}
 287	var (
 288		content []byte
 289		config  *components.Config
 290	)
 291	for _, configFile := range fileList.Items {
 292		proxyConfig := request.WebsiteProxyConfig{
 293			ID: website.ID,
 294		}
 295		parts := strings.Split(configFile.Name, ".")
 296		proxyConfig.Name = parts[0]
 297		if parts[1] == "conf" {
 298			proxyConfig.Enable = true
 299		} else {
 300			proxyConfig.Enable = false
 301		}
 302		proxyConfig.FilePath = configFile.Path
 303		content, err = fileOp.GetContent(configFile.Path)
 304		if err != nil {
 305			return
 306		}
 307		proxyConfig.Content = string(content)
 308		config, err = parser.NewStringParser(string(content)).Parse()
 309		if err != nil {
 310			return nil, err
 311		}
 312		directives := config.GetDirectives()
 313
 314		var location *components.Location
 315		for _, directive := range directives {
 316			if loc, ok := directive.(*components.Location); ok {
 317				location = loc
 318				break
 319			}
 320		}
 321		if location == nil {
 322			err = errors.New("invalid proxy config, no location found")
 323			return
 324		}
 325		proxyConfig.ProxyPass = location.ProxyPass
 326		proxyConfig.Cache = location.Cache
 327		if location.CacheTime > 0 {
 328			proxyConfig.CacheTime = location.CacheTime
 329			proxyConfig.CacheUnit = location.CacheUint
 330		}
 331		if location.ServerCacheTime > 0 {
 332			proxyConfig.ServerCacheTime = location.ServerCacheTime
 333			proxyConfig.ServerCacheUnit = location.ServerCacheUint
 334		}
 335		proxyConfig.Match = location.Match
 336		proxyConfig.Modifier = location.Modifier
 337		proxyConfig.ProxyHost = location.Host
 338		proxyConfig.Replaces = location.Replaces
 339		for _, directive := range location.Directives {
 340			if directive.GetName() == "proxy_ssl_server_name" {
 341				proxyConfig.SNI = directive.GetParameters()[0] == "on"
 342			}
 343			if directive.GetName() == "proxy_ssl_name" && len(directive.GetParameters()) > 0 {
 344				proxyConfig.ProxySSLName = directive.GetParameters()[0]
 345			}
 346			if directive.GetName() == "proxy_ssl_verify" {
 347				proxyConfig.SSLVerify = len(directive.GetParameters()) > 0 && directive.GetParameters()[0] == "on"
 348			}
 349		}
 350		proxyConfig.Cors = location.Cors
 351		proxyConfig.AllowCredentials = location.AllowCredentials
 352		proxyConfig.AllowHeaders = location.AllowHeaders
 353		proxyConfig.AllowOrigins = location.AllowOrigins
 354		proxyConfig.AllowMethods = location.AllowMethods
 355		proxyConfig.Preflight = location.Preflight
 356		res = append(res, proxyConfig)
 357	}
 358	return
 359}

 361func (w WebsiteService) UpdateProxyFile(req request.NginxProxyUpdate) (err error) {

 429func (w WebsiteService) UpdateProxyStatus(req request.WebsiteProxyStatusUpdate) (err error) {
 430	website, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.ID))
 431	if err != nil {
 432		return
 433	}
 434	includeDir := GetSitePath(website, SiteProxyDir)
 435	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
 436	if !fileOp.Stat(includeDir) {
 437		return
 438	}
 439	fileName := fmt.Sprintf("%s.conf", req.Name)
 440	includePath := path.Join(includeDir, fileName)
 441	backName := fmt.Sprintf("%s.bak", req.Name)
 442	backPath := path.Join(includeDir, backName)
 443
 444	switch req.Status {
 445	case "disable":
 446		_ = fileOp.Rename(includePath, backPath)
 447		return updateNginxConfig(constant.NginxScopeServer, nil, &website)
 448	case "enable":
 449		_ = fileOp.Rename(backPath, includePath)
 450		return updateNginxConfig(constant.NginxScopeServer, nil, &website)
 451	}
 452	return errors.New("unknown status")
 453}

  28func (w WebsiteService) UpdateRewriteConfig(req request.NginxRewriteUpdate) error {
  29	website, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.WebsiteID))
  30	if err != nil {
  31		return err
  32	}
  33	includePath := fmt.Sprintf("/www/sites/%s/rewrite/%s.conf", website.Alias, website.Alias)
  34	absolutePath := GetSitePath(website, SiteReWritePath)
  35	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
  36	var oldRewriteContent []byte
  37	if !fileOp.Stat(path.Dir(absolutePath)) {
  38		if err := fileOp.CreateDir(path.Dir(absolutePath), constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
  39			return err
  40		}
  41	}
  42	if !fileOp.Stat(absolutePath) {
  43		if err := fileOp.CreateFile(absolutePath); err != nil {
  44			return err
  45		}
  46	} else {
  47		oldRewriteContent, err = fileOp.GetContent(absolutePath)
  48		if err != nil {
  49			return err
  50		}
  51	}
  52	if err := fileOp.WriteFile(absolutePath, strings.NewReader(req.Content), constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
  53		return err
  54	}
  55
  56	if err := updateNginxConfig(constant.NginxScopeServer, []dto.NginxParam{{Name: "include", Params: []string{includePath}}}, &website); err != nil {
  57		_ = fileOp.WriteFile(absolutePath, bytes.NewReader(oldRewriteContent), constant.DirPerm)
  58		return err
  59	}
  60	website.Rewrite = req.Name
  61	return websiteRepo.Save(context.Background(), &website)
  62}
  63
  64func (w WebsiteService) GetRewriteConfig(req request.NginxRewriteReq) (*response.NginxRewriteRes, error) {
  65	website, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.WebsiteID))
  66	if err != nil {
  67		return nil, err
  68	}
  69	var contentByte []byte
  70	if req.Name == "current" {
  71		rewriteConfPath := GetSitePath(website, SiteReWritePath)
  72		fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
  73		if fileOp.Stat(rewriteConfPath) {
  74			contentByte, err = fileOp.GetContent(rewriteConfPath)
  75			if err != nil {
  76				return nil, err
  77			}
  78		}
  79	} else {
  80		safeName, err := getSafeRewriteName(req.Name)
  81		if err != nil {
  82			return nil, err
  83		}
  84		customRewriteFile := path.Join(GetOpenrestyDir(DefaultRewriteDir), fmt.Sprintf("%s.conf", safeName))
  85		if files.NewFileOp().Stat(customRewriteFile) {
  86			contentByte, err = files.NewFileOp().GetContent(customRewriteFile)
  87		} else {
  88			rewriteFile := fmt.Sprintf("rewrite/%s.conf", strings.ToLower(safeName))
  89			contentByte, _ = nginx_conf.Rewrites.ReadFile(rewriteFile)
  90		}
  91	}
  92	return &response.NginxRewriteRes{
  93		Content: string(contentByte),
  94	}, err
  95}
  96
  97func (w WebsiteService) OperateCustomRewrite(req request.CustomRewriteOperate) error {
  98	rewriteDir := GetOpenrestyDir(DefaultRewriteDir)
  99	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
 100	if !fileOp.Stat(rewriteDir) {
 101		if err := fileOp.CreateDir(rewriteDir, constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 102			return err
 103		}
 104	}
 105	safeName, err := getSafeRewriteName(req.Name)
 106	if err != nil {
 107		return err
 108	}
 109	rewriteFile := path.Join(rewriteDir, fmt.Sprintf("%s.conf", safeName))
 110	switch req.Operate {
 111	case "create":
 112		exist, err := customRewriteNameExist(rewriteDir, safeName)
 113		if err != nil {
 114			return err
 115		}
 116		if exist || builtinRewriteNameExist(safeName) {
 117			return buserr.New("ErrNameIsExist")
 118		}
 119		return fileOp.WriteFile(rewriteFile, strings.NewReader(req.Content), constant.DirPerm)
 120	case "delete":
 121		return fileOp.DeleteFile(rewriteFile)
 122	}
 123	return nil
 124}
 125
 126func getSafeRewriteName(name string) (string, error) {
 127	safeName := path.Base(name)
 128	if safeName != name || strings.Contains(safeName, "..") {
 129		return "", buserr.New("ErrInvalidParams")
 130	}
 131	return safeName, nil
 132}
 133
 134func builtinRewriteNameExist(name string) bool {
 135	rewriteFile := fmt.Sprintf("rewrite/%s.conf", strings.ToLower(name))
 136	contentByte, _ := nginx_conf.Rewrites.ReadFile(rewriteFile)
 137	return contentByte != nil
 138}
 139
 140func customRewriteNameExist(rewriteDir, name string) (bool, error) {
 141	entries, err := os.ReadDir(rewriteDir)
 142	if err != nil {
 143		return false, err
 144	}
 145	for _, entry := range entries {
 146		if entry.IsDir() {
 147			continue
 148		}
 149		entryName := strings.TrimSuffix(entry.Name(), ".conf")
 150		if strings.EqualFold(entryName, name) {
 151			return true, nil
 152		}
 153	}
 154	return false, nil
 155}
 156
 157func (w WebsiteService) ListCustomRewrite() ([]string, error) {
 158	rewriteDir := GetOpenrestyDir(DefaultRewriteDir)
 159	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
 160	if !fileOp.Stat(rewriteDir) {
 161		return nil, nil
 162	}
 163	entries, err := os.ReadDir(rewriteDir)
 164	if err != nil {
 165		return nil, err
 166	}
 167	var res []string
 168	for _, entry := range entries {
 169		if entry.IsDir() {
 170			continue
 171		}
 172		res = append(res, strings.TrimSuffix(entry.Name(), ".conf"))
 173	}
 174	return res, nil
 175}

  53var legoLogMu sync.Mutex
  54
  55func withLegoLogger(logger *log.Logger, fn func() error) error {
  56	if logger == nil {
  57		logger = log.New(io.Discard, "", log.LstdFlags)
  58	}
  59
  60	legoLogMu.Lock()
  61	defer legoLogMu.Unlock()
  62
  63	oldLogger := legoLogger.Default()
  64	legoLogger.SetDefault(slog.New(slog.NewTextHandler(logger.Writer(), nil)))
  65	defer legoLogger.SetDefault(oldLogger)
  66
  67	return fn()
  68}
  69
  70func withLegoLoggerTimeout(logger *log.Logger, timeout time.Duration, fn func(context.Context) error) error {
  71	return withLegoLogger(logger, func() error {
  72		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), timeout)
  73		defer cancel()
  74		return fn(ctx)
  75	})
  76}

  78func newWebsiteSSLLegoClient(ctx context.Context, acmeAccount *model.WebsiteAcmeAccount) (*ssl.AcmeClient, error) {
  79	client, err := ssl.NewAcmeClientWithContext(ctx, acmeAccount, getSystemProxy(acmeAccount.UseProxy))
  80	if err == nil {
  81		return client, nil
  82	}
  83	if !errors.Is(err, ssl.ErrAcmeAccountURLMissing) {
  84		return nil, err
  85	}
  86
  87	client, err = ssl.NewRegisterClientWithContext(ctx, acmeAccount, getSystemProxy(acmeAccount.UseProxy))
  88	if err != nil {
  89		return nil, err
  90	}
  91	if client.User.GetRegistration() == nil || client.User.GetRegistration().Location == "" {
  92		return nil, ssl.ErrAcmeAccountURLMissing
  93	}
  94
  95	acmeAccount.URL = client.User.GetRegistration().Location
  96	if acmeAccount.PrivateKey == "" {
  97		return nil, errors.New("private key can not blank")
  98	}
  99	if err := websiteAcmeRepo.Save(*acmeAccount); err != nil {
 100		return nil, err
 101	}
 102	return client, nil
 103}

 189func (w WebsiteSSLService) Create(create request.WebsiteSSLCreate) (request.WebsiteSSLCreate, error) {
 190	if create.Nameserver1 != "" && !common.IsValidIP(create.Nameserver1) {
 191		return create, buserr.New("ErrParseIP")
 192	}
 193	if create.Nameserver2 != "" && !common.IsValidIP(create.Nameserver2) {
 194		return create, buserr.New("ErrParseIP")
 195	}
 196	var res request.WebsiteSSLCreate
 197	acmeAccount, err := websiteAcmeRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(create.AcmeAccountID))
 198	if err != nil {
 199		return res, err
 200	}
 201	websiteSSL := model.WebsiteSSL{
 202		Status:        constant.SSLInit,
 203		Provider:      create.Provider,
 204		AcmeAccountID: acmeAccount.ID,
 205		PrimaryDomain: create.PrimaryDomain,
 206		ExpireDate:    time.Now(),
 207		KeyType:       create.KeyType,
 208		PushDir:       create.PushDir,
 209		Description:   create.Description,
 210		Nameserver1:   create.Nameserver1,
 211		Nameserver2:   create.Nameserver2,
 212		SkipDNS:       create.SkipDNS,
 213		DisableCNAME:  create.DisableCNAME,
 214		ExecShell:     create.ExecShell,
 215		IsIp:          create.IsIp,
 216	}
 217	if create.ExecShell {
 218		websiteSSL.Shell = create.Shell
 219	}
 220	if create.PushDir {
 221		fileOP := files.NewFileOp()
 222		if !fileOP.Stat(create.Dir) {
 223			return res, buserr.New("ErrLinkPathNotFound")
 224		}
 225		websiteSSL.Dir = create.Dir
 226	}
 227	setSSLPushConfig(&websiteSSL, create.PushNode, create.Nodes)
 228
 229	var domains []string
 230	if create.OtherDomains != "" {
 231		otherDomainArray := strings.Split(create.OtherDomains, "\n")
 232		for _, domain := range otherDomainArray {
 233			if !common.IsValidDomain(domain) {
 234				err = buserr.WithName("ErrDomainFormat", domain)
 235				return res, err
 236			}
 237			domains = append(domains, domain)
 238		}
 239	}
 240	if create.Provider == constant.Http {
 241		if strings.Contains(create.PrimaryDomain, "*") {
 242			return res, buserr.New("ErrWildcardDomain")
 243		}
 244		for _, domain := range domains {
 245			if strings.Contains(domain, "*") {
 246				return res, buserr.New("ErrWildcardDomain")
 247			}
 248		}
 249	}
 250	websiteSSL.Domains = strings.Join(domains, ",")
 251
 252	if create.Provider == constant.DNSAccount || create.Provider == constant.Http {
 253		websiteSSL.AutoRenew = create.AutoRenew
 254	}
 255	if create.Provider == constant.DNSAccount {
 256		dnsAccount, err := websiteDnsRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(create.DnsAccountID))
 257		if err != nil {
 258			return res, err
 259		}
 260		websiteSSL.DnsAccountID = dnsAccount.ID
 261	}
 262
 263	if err := websiteSSLRepo.Create(context.TODO(), &websiteSSL); err != nil {
 264		return res, err
 265	}
 266	create.ID = websiteSSL.ID
 267	logFile, err := os.OpenFile(path.Join(global.Dir.SSLLogDir, fmt.Sprintf("%s-ssl-%d.log", websiteSSL.PrimaryDomain, websiteSSL.ID)), os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_TRUNC, constant.FilePerm)
 268	if err != nil {
 269		global.LOG.Errorf("open ssl log file failed, domain: %s, err: %v", websiteSSL.PrimaryDomain, err)
 270	} else {
 271		logFile.Close()
 272	}
 273	go func() {
 274		if create.Provider != constant.DnsManual {
 275			if err = w.ObtainSSL(request.WebsiteSSLApply{
 276				ID: websiteSSL.ID,
 277			}); err != nil {
 278				global.LOG.Errorf("obtain ssl failed, err: %v", err)
 279			}
 280		}
 281	}()
 282	return create, nil
 283}

 333func newWebsiteSSLLogger(websiteSSL *model.WebsiteSSL, autoRenew bool) (*os.File, *log.Logger) {
 334	flags := os.O_CREATE | os.O_WRONLY | os.O_TRUNC
 335	if autoRenew {
 336		flags = os.O_CREATE | os.O_WRONLY | os.O_APPEND
 337	}
 338
 339	logFile, err := os.OpenFile(websiteSSL.GetLogPath(), flags, constant.FilePerm)
 340	if err != nil {
 341		global.LOG.Errorf("open ssl log file failed, domain: %s, err: %v", websiteSSL.PrimaryDomain, err)
 342		return nil, log.New(io.Discard, "", log.LstdFlags)
 343	}
 344
 345	if autoRenew {
 346		if info, statErr := logFile.Stat(); statErr == nil && info.Size() > 0 {
 347			_, _ = logFile.WriteString("\n")
 348		}
 349		_, _ = logFile.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("========== [%s] auto renew attempt ==========\n", time.Now().Format(constant.DateTimeLayout)))
 350	}
 351
 352	return logFile, log.New(logFile, "", log.LstdFlags)
 353}

 355func reloadSystemSSL(websiteSSL *model.WebsiteSSL, logger *log.Logger) {
 356	if !global.IsMaster {
 357		return
 358	}
 359	systemSSLEnable, sslID := GetSystemSSL()
 360	if systemSSLEnable && sslID == websiteSSL.ID {
 361		fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
 362		certPath := path.Join(global.Dir.DataDir, "secret/server.crt")
 363		keyPath := path.Join(global.Dir.DataDir, "secret/server.key")
 364		printSSLLog(logger, "StartUpdateSystemSSL", nil)
 365		if err := fileOp.WriteFile(certPath, strings.NewReader(websiteSSL.Pem), 0600); err != nil {
 366			logger.Printf("Failed to update the SSL certificate File for 1Panel System domain [%s] , err:%s", websiteSSL.PrimaryDomain, err.Error())
 367			return
 368		}
 369		if err := fileOp.WriteFile(keyPath, strings.NewReader(websiteSSL.PrivateKey), 0600); err != nil {
 370			logger.Printf("Failed to update the SSL certificate for 1Panel System domain [%s] , err:%s", websiteSSL.PrimaryDomain, err.Error())
 371			return
 372		}
 373		if err := req_helper.PostLocalCore("/core/settings/ssl/reload"); err != nil {
 374			logger.Printf("Failed to update the SSL certificate for 1Panel System domain [%s] , err:%s", websiteSSL.PrimaryDomain, err.Error())
 375			return
 376		}
 377		printSSLLog(logger, "UpdateSystemSSLSuccess", nil)
 378	}
 379}

 381"cmt">// SyncSystemSSL reconciles the panel certificate on disk with the WebsiteSSL
 382"cmt">// row referenced by the SSLID setting. When they differ (typically because a
 383"cmt">// previous renewal's reloadSystemSSL was skipped by a transient nginx reload
 384"cmt">// failure or because the panel was restarted between the DB save and the file
 385"cmt">// rewrite), the on-disk cert is refreshed and core is asked to reload its TLS
 386"cmt">// store. Safe to call on every renewal cron tick: it is a no-op when SSL is
 387"cmt">// not enabled, when SSLID does not resolve, or when the cert already matches.
 388func SyncSystemSSL() {
 389	if !global.IsMaster {
 390		return
 391	}
 392	systemSSLEnable, sslID := GetSystemSSL()
 393	if !systemSSLEnable {
 394		return
 395	}
 396	websiteSSL, err := websiteSSLRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(sslID))
 397	if err != nil {
 398		return
 399	}
 400	if strings.TrimSpace(websiteSSL.Pem) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(websiteSSL.PrivateKey) == "" {
 401		return
 402	}
 403	certPath := path.Join(global.Dir.DataDir, "secret/server.crt")
 404	keyPath := path.Join(global.Dir.DataDir, "secret/server.key")
 405	diskCert, _ := os.ReadFile(certPath)
 406	diskKey, _ := os.ReadFile(keyPath)
 407	if strings.TrimSpace(string(diskCert)) == strings.TrimSpace(websiteSSL.Pem) &&
 408		strings.TrimSpace(string(diskKey)) == strings.TrimSpace(websiteSSL.PrivateKey) {
 409		return
 410	}
 411	global.LOG.Infof("panel SSL on disk diverged from DB (SSLID=%d, domain=%s), syncing", websiteSSL.ID, websiteSSL.PrimaryDomain)
 412	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
 413	if err := fileOp.WriteFile(certPath, strings.NewReader(websiteSSL.Pem), 0600); err != nil {
 414		global.LOG.Errorf("sync panel SSL: write cert failed: %s", err.Error())
 415		return
 416	}
 417	if err := fileOp.WriteFile(keyPath, strings.NewReader(websiteSSL.PrivateKey), 0600); err != nil {
 418		global.LOG.Errorf("sync panel SSL: write key failed: %s", err.Error())
 419		return
 420	}
 421	if err := req_helper.PostLocalCore("/core/settings/ssl/reload"); err != nil {
 422		global.LOG.Errorf("sync panel SSL: notify core failed: %s", err.Error())
 423		return
 424	}
 425	global.LOG.Info("panel SSL synced from DB to disk")
 426}
