 436func (w WebsiteSSLService) obtainSSL(id uint, autoRenew bool) error {
 437	var (
 438		err         error
 439		websiteSSL  *model.WebsiteSSL
 440		acmeAccount *model.WebsiteAcmeAccount
 441		dnsAccount  *model.WebsiteDnsAccount
 442		logFile     *os.File
 443		logger      *log.Logger
 444		resource    certificate.Resource
 445		httpRoot    string
 446	)
 447
 448	websiteSSL, err = websiteSSLRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(id))
 449	if err != nil {
 450		return err
 451	}
 452	if websiteSSL.Status == constant.SSLApply {
 453		return buserr.New("InExecuting")
 454	}
 455	acmeAccount, err = websiteAcmeRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(websiteSSL.AcmeAccountID))
 456	if err != nil {
 457		return err
 458	}
 459	domains := []string{websiteSSL.PrimaryDomain}
 460	if websiteSSL.Domains != "" {
 461		domains = append(domains, strings.Split(websiteSSL.Domains, ",")...)
 462	}
 463	if websiteSSL.Provider != constant.DnsManual {
 464		switch websiteSSL.Provider {
 465		case constant.DNSAccount:
 466			dnsAccount, err = websiteDnsRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(websiteSSL.DnsAccountID))
 467			if err != nil {
 468				return err
 469			}
 470		case constant.Http:
 471			appInstall, err := getAppInstallByKey(constant.AppOpenresty)
 472			if err != nil {
 473				if errors.Is(err, gormv2.ErrRecordNotFound) {
 474					return buserr.New("ErrOpenrestyNotFound")
 475				}
 476				return err
 477			}
 478			for _, domain := range domains {
 479				if strings.Contains(domain, "*") {
 480					return buserr.New("ErrWildcardDomain")
 481				}
 482			}
 483			httpRoot = path.Join(appInstall.GetPath(), "root")
 484		}
 485	}
 486	marked, err := websiteSSLRepo.TryMarkApplying(websiteSSL.ID)
 487	if err != nil {
 488		return err
 489	}
 490	if !marked {
 491		return buserr.New("InExecuting")
 492	}
 493	websiteSSL.Status = constant.SSLApply
 494
 495	logFile, logger = newWebsiteSSLLogger(websiteSSL, autoRenew)
 496	logFileOwnedByGoroutine := false
 497	if logFile != nil {
 498		defer func() {
 499			if !logFileOwnedByGoroutine {
 500				_ = logFile.Close()
 501			}
 502		}()
 503	}
 504	startMsg := i18n.GetMsgWithMap("ApplySSLStart", map[string]interface{}{"domain": strings.Join(domains, ","), "type": i18n.GetMsgByKey(websiteSSL.Provider)})
 505	if websiteSSL.Provider == constant.DNSAccount {
 506		startMsg = startMsg + i18n.GetMsgWithMap("DNSAccountName", map[string]interface{}{"name": dnsAccount.Name, "type": dnsAccount.Type})
 507	}
 508	logger.Println(startMsg)
 509
 510	logFileOwnedByGoroutine = true
 511	go func(logFile *os.File, logger *log.Logger) {
 512		if logFile != nil {
 513			defer func() {
 514				_ = logFile.Close()
 515			}()
 516		}
 517		if websiteSSL.Provider != constant.DnsManual {
 518			privateKey, err := ssl.GetPrivateKeyByType(websiteSSL.KeyType, websiteSSL.PrivateKey)
 519			if err != nil {
 520				handleError(websiteSSL, logger, err)
 521				return
 522			}
 523			err = withLegoLoggerTimeout(logger, sslObtainTimeout, func(ctx context.Context) error {
 524				client, err := newWebsiteSSLLegoClient(ctx, acmeAccount)
 525				if err != nil {
 526					return err
 527				}
 528				switch websiteSSL.Provider {
 529				case constant.DNSAccount:
 530					if err = client.UseDns(ssl.DnsType(dnsAccount.Type), dnsAccount.Authorization, *websiteSSL); err != nil {
 531						return err
 532					}
 533				case constant.Http:
 534					if err = client.UseHTTP(httpRoot); err != nil {
 535						return err
 536					}
 537				}
 538				if websiteSSL.IsIp {
 539					resource, err = client.ObtainIPSSL(ctx, domains[0], privateKey)
 540				} else {
 541					resource, err = client.ObtainSSL(ctx, domains, privateKey)
 542				}
 543				return err
 544			})
 545			if err != nil {
 546				handleError(websiteSSL, logger, err)
 547				return
 548			}
 549		} else {
 550			manualClient, err := ssl.NewCustomAcmeClient(acmeAccount, getSystemProxy(acmeAccount.UseProxy), logger)
 551			if err != nil {
 552				handleError(websiteSSL, logger, err)
 553				return
 554			}
 555			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), sslObtainTimeout)
 556			resource, err = manualClient.RequestCertificate(ctx, websiteSSL)
 557			cancel()
 558			if err != nil {
 559				handleError(websiteSSL, logger, err)
 560				return
 561			}
 562		}
 563
 564		websiteSSL.PrivateKey = string(resource.PrivateKey)
 565		websiteSSL.Pem = string(resource.Certificate)
 566		websiteSSL.CertURL = resource.CertURL
 567		cert, err := parseCertificatePEM(resource.Certificate)
 568		if err != nil {
 569			handleError(websiteSSL, logger, err)
 570			return
 571		}
 572		websiteSSL.ExpireDate = cert.NotAfter
 573		websiteSSL.StartDate = cert.NotBefore
 574		websiteSSL.Type = cert.Issuer.CommonName
 575		if len(cert.Issuer.Organization) > 0 {
 576			websiteSSL.Organization = cert.Issuer.Organization[0]
 577		}
 578		websiteSSL.Status = constant.SSLReady
 579		printSSLLog(logger, "ApplySSLSuccess", map[string]interface{}{"domain": strings.Join(domains, ",")})
 580		saveCertificateFile(websiteSSL, logger)
 581
 582		if websiteSSL.ExecShell {
 583			workDir := global.Dir.DataDir
 584			if websiteSSL.PushDir {
 585				workDir = websiteSSL.Dir
 586			}
 587			printSSLLog(logger, "ExecShellStart", nil)
 588			if err = runShellScriptFile(workDir, websiteSSL.Shell, logger); err != nil {
 589				printSSLLog(logger, "ErrExecShell", map[string]interface{}{"err": err.Error()})
 590			} else {
 591				printSSLLog(logger, "ExecShellSuccess", nil)
 592			}
 593		}
 594
 595		err = websiteSSLRepo.Save(websiteSSL)
 596		if err != nil {
 597			return
 598		}
 599
 600		websites, _ := websiteRepo.GetBy(websiteRepo.WithWebsiteSSLID(websiteSSL.ID))
 601		if len(websites) > 0 {
 602			for _, website := range websites {
 603				printSSLLog(logger, "ApplyWebSiteSSLLog", map[string]interface{}{"name": website.PrimaryDomain})
 604				if err := createPemFile(website, *websiteSSL); err != nil {
 605					printSSLLog(logger, "ErrUpdateWebsiteSSL", map[string]interface{}{"name": website.PrimaryDomain, "err": err.Error()})
 606				}
 607			}
 608			if nginxInstall, err := getAppInstallByKey(constant.AppOpenresty); err == nil {
 609				if err := opNginx(nginxInstall.ContainerName, constant.NginxReload); err != nil {
 610					printSSLLog(logger, "ErrSSLApply", nil)
 611				} else {
 612					printSSLLog(logger, "ApplyWebSiteSSLSuccess", nil)
 613				}
 614			}
 615		}
 616		reloadSystemSSL(websiteSSL, logger)
 617		if websiteSSL.PushNode {
 618			if err = pushSSLToNode(websiteSSL, logger); err != nil {
 619				return
 620			}
 621		}
 622	}(logFile, logger)
 623
 624	return nil
 625}
 626
 627func runShellScriptFile(workDir, shell string, logger *log.Logger) error {
 628	file, err := os.CreateTemp("", "1panel-shell-*.sh")
 629	if err != nil {
 630		return err
 631	}
 632	defer func() { _ = os.Remove(file.Name()) }()
 633	if _, err := file.WriteString(shell); err != nil {
 634		_ = file.Close()
 635		return err
 636	}
 637	if err := file.Close(); err != nil {
 638		return err
 639	}
 640	cmdMgr := cmd.NewCommandMgr(cmd.WithTimeout(30*time.Minute), cmd.WithLogger(logger), cmd.WithWorkDir(workDir))
 641	return cmdMgr.Run("bash", file.Name())
 642}
 643
 644func parseCertificatePEM(certPEM []byte) (*x509.Certificate, error) {
 645	certBlock, _ := pem.Decode(certPEM)
 646	if certBlock == nil {
 647		return nil, errors.New("invalid certificate PEM")
 648	}
 649	return x509.ParseCertificate(certBlock.Bytes)
 650}

 652func handleError(websiteSSL *model.WebsiteSSL, logger *log.Logger, err error) {
 653	if websiteSSL.Status == constant.SSLInit || websiteSSL.Status == constant.SSLError {
 654		websiteSSL.Status = constant.StatusError
 655	} else {
 656		websiteSSL.Status = constant.SSLApplyError
 657	}
 658	websiteSSL.Message = err.Error()
 659	if logger != nil {
 660		logger.Println(i18n.GetErrMsg("ApplySSLFailed", map[string]interface{}{"domain": websiteSSL.PrimaryDomain, "detail": err.Error()}))
 661	}
 662	_ = websiteSSLRepo.Save(websiteSSL)
 663}

 665func (w WebsiteSSLService) GetDNSResolve(req request.WebsiteDNSReq) ([]response.WebsiteDNSRes, error) {
 666	acmeAccount, err := websiteAcmeRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.AcmeAccountID))
 667	if err != nil {
 668		return nil, err
 669	}
 670	client, err := ssl.NewCustomAcmeClient(acmeAccount, getSystemProxy(acmeAccount.UseProxy), nil)
 671	if err != nil {
 672		return nil, err
 673	}
 674	websiteSSL, err := websiteSSLRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.WebsiteSSLID))
 675	if err != nil {
 676		return nil, err
 677	}
 678	resolves, err := client.GetDNSResolve(context.TODO(), websiteSSL)
 679	if err != nil {
 680		return nil, err
 681	}
 682	var res []response.WebsiteDNSRes
 683	for k, v := range resolves {
 684		res = append(res, response.WebsiteDNSRes{
 685			Domain: k,
 686			Key:    v.Key,
 687			Value:  v.Value,
 688			Err:    v.Err,
 689		})
 690	}
 691	return res, nil
 692}

 708func (w WebsiteSSLService) Delete(ids []uint) error {
 709	var (
 710		websiteSSLS []string
 711		applySSLS   []string
 712	)
 713	for _, id := range ids {
 714		if websites, _ := websiteRepo.GetBy(websiteRepo.WithWebsiteSSLID(id)); len(websites) > 0 {
 715			oldSSL, _ := websiteSSLRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(id))
 716			if oldSSL != nil && oldSSL.ID > 0 {
 717				websiteSSLS = append(websiteSSLS, oldSSL.PrimaryDomain)
 718			}
 719			continue
 720		}
 721		sslSetting, _ := settingRepo.Get(settingRepo.WithByKey("SSL"))
 722		if sslSetting.Value == "enable" {
 723			sslID, _ := settingRepo.Get(settingRepo.WithByKey("SSLID"))
 724			idValue, _ := strconv.Atoi(sslID.Value)
 725			if idValue > 0 && uint(idValue) == id {
 726				return buserr.New("ErrDeleteWithPanelSSL")
 727			}
 728		}
 729		websiteSSL, err := websiteSSLRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(id))
 730		if err != nil {
 731			return err
 732		}
 733		if websiteSSL.Status == constant.SSLApply {
 734			applySSLS = append(applySSLS, websiteSSL.PrimaryDomain)
 735			continue
 736		}
 737		if websiteSSL.Provider != constant.Manual && websiteSSL.Provider != constant.SelfSigned {
 738			go func() {
 739				acmeAccount, err := websiteAcmeRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(websiteSSL.AcmeAccountID))
 740				if err != nil {
 741					global.LOG.Errorf("Failed to get acme account for SSL revoke, err: %v", err)
 742					return
 743				}
 744				err = withLegoLogger(nil, func() error {
 745					client, err := newWebsiteSSLLegoClient(context.Background(), acmeAccount)
 746					if err != nil {
 747						return err
 748					}
 749					return client.RevokeSSL([]byte(websiteSSL.Pem))
 750				})
 751				if err != nil {
 752					global.LOG.Errorf("Failed to revoke SSL for domain %s, err: %v", websiteSSL.PrimaryDomain, err)
 753					return
 754				}
 755			}()
 756		}
 757		_ = websiteSSLRepo.DeleteBy(repo.WithByID(id))
 758	}
 759	if len(websiteSSLS) > 0 {
 760		return buserr.WithName("ErrSSLCannotDelete", strings.Join(websiteSSLS, ","))
 761	}
 762	if len(applySSLS) > 0 {
 763		return buserr.WithName("ErrApplySSLCanNotDelete", strings.Join(applySSLS, ","))
 764	}
 765	return nil
 766}

 768func (w WebsiteSSLService) Update(update request.WebsiteSSLUpdate) error {
 769	websiteSSL, err := websiteSSLRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(update.ID))
 770	if err != nil {
 771		return err
 772	}
 773	updateParams := make(map[string]interface{})
 774	updateParams["primary_domain"] = update.PrimaryDomain
 775	updateParams["description"] = update.Description
 776	updateParams["provider"] = update.Provider
 777	updateParams["push_dir"] = update.PushDir
 778	updateParams["disable_cname"] = update.DisableCNAME
 779	updateParams["skip_dns"] = update.SkipDNS
 780	updateParams["nameserver1"] = update.Nameserver1
 781	updateParams["nameserver2"] = update.Nameserver2
 782	updateParams["exec_shell"] = update.ExecShell
 783	if update.ExecShell {
 784		updateParams["shell"] = update.Shell
 785	} else {
 786		updateParams["shell"] = ""
 787	}
 788	pushNode, nodes := normalizeSSLPushConfig(update.PushNode, update.Nodes)
 789	if !global.IsMaster || !xpack.MultiNodeProvider.IsXpack() {
 790		pushNode = false
 791		nodes = ""
 792	}
 793	updateParams["push_node"] = pushNode
 794	updateParams["nodes"] = nodes
 795
 796	if websiteSSL.Provider != constant.SelfSigned && websiteSSL.Provider != constant.Manual {
 797		acmeAccount, err := websiteAcmeRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(update.AcmeAccountID))
 798		if err != nil {
 799			return err
 800		}
 801		updateParams["acme_account_id"] = acmeAccount.ID
 802	}
 803
 804	if update.PushDir {
 805		fileOP := files.NewFileOp()
 806		if !fileOP.Stat(update.Dir) {
 807			_ = fileOP.CreateDir(update.Dir, constant.DirPerm)
 808		}
 809		updateParams["dir"] = update.Dir
 810	}
 811	var domains []string
 812	if update.OtherDomains != "" {
 813		otherDomainArray := strings.Split(update.OtherDomains, "\n")
 814		for _, domain := range otherDomainArray {
 815			if websiteSSL.Provider != constant.SelfSigned && !common.IsValidDomain(domain) {
 816				return buserr.WithName("ErrDomainFormat", domain)
 817			}
 818			domains = append(domains, domain)
 819		}
 820	}
 821	updateParams["domains"] = strings.Join(domains, ",")
 822	if update.Provider == constant.DNSAccount || update.Provider == constant.Http || update.Provider == constant.SelfSigned {
 823		updateParams["auto_renew"] = update.AutoRenew
 824	} else {
 825		updateParams["auto_renew"] = false
 826	}
 827	if update.Provider == constant.DNSAccount {
 828		dnsAccount, err := websiteDnsRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(update.DnsAccountID))
 829		if err != nil {
 830			return err
 831		}
 832		updateParams["dns_account_id"] = dnsAccount.ID
 833	} else {
 834		updateParams["dns_account_id"] = 0
 835	}
 836	return websiteSSLRepo.SaveByMap(websiteSSL, updateParams)
 837}
 838
 839func (w WebsiteSSLService) Upload(req request.WebsiteSSLUpload) error {
 840	websiteSSL := &model.WebsiteSSL{
 841		Provider:    constant.Manual,
 842		Description: req.Description,
 843		Status:      constant.SSLReady,
 844	}
 845	setSSLPushConfig(websiteSSL, req.PushNode, req.Nodes)
 846	var err error
 847	if req.SSLID > 0 {
 848		websiteSSL, err = websiteSSLRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.SSLID))
 849		if err != nil {
 850			return err
 851		}
 852		websiteSSL.Description = req.Description
 853		setSSLPushConfig(websiteSSL, req.PushNode, req.Nodes)
 854	}
 855	if req.Type == "local" {
 856		fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
 857		if !fileOp.Stat(req.PrivateKeyPath) {
 858			return buserr.New("ErrSSLKeyNotFound")
 859		}
 860		if !fileOp.Stat(req.CertificatePath) {
 861			return buserr.New("ErrSSLCertificateNotFound")
 862		}
 863		if content, err := fileOp.GetContent(req.PrivateKeyPath); err != nil {
 864			return err
 865		} else {
 866			websiteSSL.PrivateKey = string(content)
 867		}
 868		if content, err := fileOp.GetContent(req.CertificatePath); err != nil {
 869			return err
 870		} else {
 871			websiteSSL.Pem = string(content)
 872		}
 873		websiteSSL.CertPath = req.CertificatePath
 874		websiteSSL.PrivateKeyPath = req.PrivateKeyPath
 875	} else {
 876		websiteSSL.PrivateKey = req.PrivateKey
 877		websiteSSL.Pem = req.Certificate
 878		websiteSSL.CertPath = ""
 879		websiteSSL.PrivateKeyPath = ""
 880	}
 881
 882	privateKeyCertBlock, _ := pem.Decode([]byte(websiteSSL.PrivateKey))
 883	if privateKeyCertBlock == nil {
 884		return buserr.New("ErrSSLKeyFormat")
 885	}
 886
 887	var (
 888		cert    *x509.Certificate
 889		pemData = []byte(websiteSSL.Pem)
 890	)
 891	for {
 892		certBlock, reset := pem.Decode(pemData)
 893		if certBlock == nil {
 894			break
 895		}
 896		cert, err = x509.ParseCertificate(certBlock.Bytes)
 897		if err != nil {
 898			return err
 899		}
 900		if len(cert.DNSNames) > 0 || len(cert.IPAddresses) > 0 {
 901			break
 902		}
 903		pemData = reset
 904	}
 905	if pemData == nil || cert == nil {
 906		return buserr.New("ErrSSLCertificateFormat")
 907	}
 908
 909	websiteSSL.ExpireDate = cert.NotAfter
 910	websiteSSL.StartDate = cert.NotBefore
 911	websiteSSL.Type = cert.Issuer.CommonName
 912	if len(cert.Issuer.Organization) > 0 {
 913		websiteSSL.Organization = cert.Issuer.Organization[0]
 914	} else {
 915		websiteSSL.Organization = cert.Issuer.CommonName
 916	}
 917
 918	var domains []string
 919	if len(cert.DNSNames) > 0 {
 920		websiteSSL.PrimaryDomain = cert.DNSNames[0]
 921		domains = cert.DNSNames[1:]
 922	}
 923	if len(cert.IPAddresses) > 0 {
 924		if websiteSSL.PrimaryDomain == "" {
 925			websiteSSL.PrimaryDomain = cert.IPAddresses[0].String()
 926			for _, ip := range cert.IPAddresses[1:] {
 927				domains = append(domains, ip.String())
 928			}
 929		} else {
 930			for _, ip := range cert.IPAddresses {
 931				domains = append(domains, ip.String())
 932			}
 933		}
 934	}
 935	websiteSSL.Domains = strings.Join(domains, ",")
 936
 937	if websiteSSL.ID > 0 {
 938		if err := UpdateSSLConfig(*websiteSSL); err != nil {
 939			return err
 940		}
 941		if err := websiteSSLRepo.Save(websiteSSL); err != nil {
 942			return err
 943		}
 944		return pushSSLToNodeWithNewLogger(websiteSSL)
 945	}
 946	if err := websiteSSLRepo.Create(context.Background(), websiteSSL); err != nil {
 947		return err
 948	}
 949	return pushSSLToNodeWithNewLogger(websiteSSL)
 950}
 951
 952func (w WebsiteSSLService) PushToNode(req request.WebsiteSSLPush) error {
 953	if !global.IsMaster {
 954		return errors.New("only master node can push SSL to nodes")
 955	}
 956	if !xpack.MultiNodeProvider.IsXpack() {
 957		return errors.New("SSL node push is an XPack feature")
 958	}
 959	pushNode, nodes := normalizeSSLPushConfig(req.PushNode, req.Nodes)
 960	if !pushNode {
 961		return errors.New("please select nodes to push SSL")
 962	}
 963	websiteSSL, err := websiteSSLRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(req.ID))
 964	if err != nil {
 965		return err
 966	}
 967	if websiteSSL.Provider == constant.FromMaster {
 968		return errors.New("SSL imported from master node can not be pushed")
 969	}
 970	if websiteSSL.Status != constant.SSLReady {
 971		return errors.New("only ready SSL can be pushed")
 972	}
 973	if task.CheckResourceTaskIsExecuting(task.TaskPush, task.TaskScopeWebsite, websiteSSL.ID) {
 974		return buserr.New("TaskIsExecuting")
 975	}
 976	if err := websiteSSLRepo.SaveByMap(websiteSSL, map[string]interface{}{
 977		"push_node": pushNode,
 978		"nodes":     nodes,
 979	}); err != nil {
 980		return err
 981	}
 982	websiteSSL.PushNode = pushNode
 983	websiteSSL.Nodes = nodes
 984
 985	if req.Sync {
 986		return xpack.MultiNodeProvider.PushSSLToNode(websiteSSL)
 987	}
 988
 989	pushTask, err := task.NewTask(task.GetTaskName(websiteSSL.PrimaryDomain, task.TaskPush, "SSL"), task.TaskPush, task.TaskScopeWebsite, req.TaskID, websiteSSL.ID)
 990	if err != nil {
 991		return err
 992	}
 993	pushTask.AddSubTask(i18n.GetMsgByKey("StartPushSSLToNode"), func(t *task.Task) error {
 994		t.Log(i18n.GetMsgByKey("StartPushSSLToNode"))
 995		if err := xpack.MultiNodeProvider.PushSSLToNode(websiteSSL); err != nil {
 996			t.Log(i18n.GetMsgWithMap("PushSSLToNodeFailed", map[string]interface{}{"err": err.Error()}))
 997			return err
 998		}
 999		t.Log(i18n.GetMsgByKey("PushSSLToNodeSuccess"))
1000		return nil
1001	}, nil)
1002	go func() {
1003		if err := pushTask.Execute(); err != nil {
1004			global.LOG.Errorf("push ssl to node failed, sslID: %d, err: %v", websiteSSL.ID, err)
1005		}
1006	}()
1007	return nil
1008}

1010func (w WebsiteSSLService) DownloadFile(id uint) (*os.File, error) {
1011	websiteSSL, err := websiteSSLRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(id))
1012	if err != nil {
1013		return nil, err
1014	}
1015	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
1016	dir := path.Join(global.Dir.DataDir, "tmp/ssl", websiteSSL.PrimaryDomain)
1017	if fileOp.Stat(dir) {
1018		if err = fileOp.DeleteDir(dir); err != nil {
1019			return nil, err
1020		}
1021	}
1022	if err = fileOp.CreateDir(dir, constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
1023		return nil, err
1024	}
1025	if err = fileOp.WriteFile(path.Join(dir, "fullchain.pem"), strings.NewReader(websiteSSL.Pem), constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
1026		return nil, err
1027	}
1028	if err = fileOp.WriteFile(path.Join(dir, "privkey.pem"), strings.NewReader(websiteSSL.PrivateKey), constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
1029		return nil, err
1030	}
1031	fileName := websiteSSL.PrimaryDomain + ".zip"
1032	if err = fileOp.Compress(context.Background(), []string{path.Join(dir, "fullchain.pem"), path.Join(dir, "privkey.pem")}, dir, fileName, files.SdkZip, "", nil); err != nil {
1033		return nil, err
1034	}
1035	return os.Open(path.Join(dir, fileName))
1036}

1038func (w WebsiteSSLService) SyncForRestart() error {
1039	sslList, err := websiteSSLRepo.List()
1040	if err != nil {
1041		return err
1042	}
1043	for _, ssl := range sslList {
1044		if ssl.Status == constant.SSLApply {
1045			ssl.Status = constant.SystemRestart
1046			ssl.Message = "System restart causing interrupt"
1047			_ = websiteSSLRepo.Save(&ssl)
1048		}
1049	}
1050	return nil
1051}

1053func (w WebsiteSSLService) ImportMasterSSL(create model.WebsiteSSL) error {
1054	websiteSSL, err := websiteSSLRepo.GetFirst(websiteSSLRepo.WithByMasterSSLID(create.ID))
1055	if err != nil {
1056		if !errors.Is(err, gormv2.ErrRecordNotFound) {
1057			return err
1058		}
1059		websiteSSL = &model.WebsiteSSL{}
1060	}
1061	websiteSSL.Status = constant.SSLReady
1062	websiteSSL.Provider = constant.FromMaster

1074	if websiteSSL.ID == 0 {

1077		}
1078	} else {

1080			return err
1081		}

1083	websites, _ := websiteRepo.GetBy(websiteRepo.WithWebsiteSSLID(websiteSSL.ID))
1084	if len(websites) == 0 {

1086	}
1087	for _, website := range websites {
1088		if err := createPemFile(website, *websiteSSL); err != nil {
1089			continue
1090		}
1091	}
1092	nginxInstall, err := getAppInstallByKey(constant.AppOpenresty)
1093	if err == nil {

1095			return err
1096		}

 171func (w WebsiteTemplateService) SaveUploadZip(fileName string, content []byte) (string, []string, error) {
 172	if !strings.HasSuffix(strings.ToLower(fileName), ".zip") {
 173		return "", nil, buserr.WithName("ErrNotSupportType", fileName)
 174	}
 175	dir := templateFileDir()
 176	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 177		return "", nil, err
 178	}
 179	filePath := path.Join(dir, fmt.Sprintf("%d_%s", time.Now().Unix(), filepath.Base(fileName)))
 180	if err := os.WriteFile(filePath, content, constant.FilePerm); err != nil {
 181		return "", nil, err
 182	}
 183	return filePath, scanZipVariables(filePath), nil
 184}
 185
 186func scanZipVariables(zipPath string) []string {
 187	variables := []string{}
 188	reader, err := zip.OpenReader(zipPath)
 189	if err != nil {
 190		return variables
 191	}
 192	defer reader.Close()
 193	seen := make(map[string]struct{})
 194	for _, file := range reader.File {
 195		if file.FileInfo().IsDir() || !isTextFile(file.Name) {
 196			continue
 197		}
 198		rc, err := file.Open()
 199		if err != nil {
 200			continue
 201		}
 202		content, err := io.ReadAll(rc)
 203		_ = rc.Close()
 204		if err != nil {
 205			continue
 206		}
 207		for _, match := range templateVarRegex.FindAllStringSubmatch(string(content), -1) {
 208			if _, ok := seen[match[1]]; !ok {
 209				seen[match[1]] = struct{}{}
 210				variables = append(variables, match[1])
 211			}
 212		}
 213	}
 214	return variables
 215}

 305var templateVarRegex = regexp.MustCompile(`\{\{(\w+)\}\}`)
 306
 307func renderContent(content string, values map[string]string) string {
 308	rendered := templateVarRegex.ReplaceAllStringFunc(content, func(match string) string {
 309		key := templateVarRegex.FindStringSubmatch(match)[1]
 310		if val, ok := values[key]; ok {
 311			return val
 312		}
 313		return ""
 314	})
 315	return rendered
 316}
 317
 318func renderToDir(template *model.WebsiteTemplate, values map[string]string, outputDir string) error {
 319	if err := os.MkdirAll(outputDir, constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 320		return err
 321	}
 322	if template.Type == "single" {
 323		html := renderContent(template.Content, values)
 324		return os.WriteFile(path.Join(outputDir, "index.html"), []byte(html), constant.FilePerm)
 325	}
 326	return unzipAndRender(template.FilePath, outputDir, values)
 327}
 328
 329func unzipAndRender(zipPath, outputDir string, values map[string]string) error {
 330	if zipPath == "" {
 331		return buserr.WithName("ErrFileNotFound", "ZIP")
 332	}
 333	reader, err := zip.OpenReader(zipPath)
 334	if err != nil {
 335		return err
 336	}
 337	defer reader.Close()
 338	for _, file := range reader.File {
 339		if err := extractAndRenderFile(file, outputDir, values); err != nil {
 340			return err
 341		}
 342	}
 343	return nil
 344}
 345
 346func extractAndRenderFile(file *zip.File, outputDir string, values map[string]string) error {
 347	targetPath := filepath.Join(outputDir, file.Name)
 348	if !strings.HasPrefix(targetPath, filepath.Clean(outputDir)+string(os.PathSeparator)) {
 349		return fmt.Errorf("invalid file path in zip: %s", file.Name)
 350	}
 351	if file.FileInfo().IsDir() {
 352		return os.MkdirAll(targetPath, constant.DirPerm)
 353	}
 354	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(targetPath), constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 355		return err
 356	}
 357	rc, err := file.Open()
 358	if err != nil {
 359		return err
 360	}
 361	defer rc.Close()
 362	content, err := io.ReadAll(rc)
 363	if err != nil {
 364		return err
 365	}
 366	if isTextFile(file.Name) {
 367		content = []byte(renderContent(string(content), values))
 368	}
 369	return os.WriteFile(targetPath, content, constant.FilePerm)
 370}
 371
 372func isTextFile(name string) bool {
 373	switch strings.ToLower(filepath.Ext(name)) {
 374	case ".html", ".htm", ".css", ".js", ".json", ".xml", ".txt", ".svg", ".md":
 375		return true
 376	}
 377	return false
 378}
 379
 380func renderMainHTMLFromZip(zipPath string, values map[string]string) (string, error) {
 381	if zipPath == "" {
 382		return "", buserr.WithName("ErrFileNotFound", "ZIP")
 383	}
 384	reader, err := zip.OpenReader(zipPath)
 385	if err != nil {
 386		return "", err
 387	}
 388	defer reader.Close()
 389	var mainFile *zip.File
 390	for _, file := range reader.File {
 391		if file.FileInfo().IsDir() {
 392			continue
 393		}
 394		name := strings.ToLower(filepath.Base(file.Name))
 395		if name == "index.html" || name == "index.htm" {
 396			if mainFile == nil || len(file.Name) < len(mainFile.Name) {
 397				mainFile = file
 398			}
 399		}
 400	}
 401	if mainFile == nil {
 402		return "", buserr.WithName("ErrFileNotFound", "index.html")
 403	}
 404	rc, err := mainFile.Open()
 405	if err != nil {
 406		return "", err
 407	}
 408	defer rc.Close()
 409	content, err := io.ReadAll(rc)
 410	if err != nil {
 411		return "", err
 412	}
 413	return renderContent(string(content), values), nil
 414}
 415
 416func copyDir(src, dst string) error {
 417	return filepath.Walk(src, func(p string, info os.FileInfo, err error) error {
 418		if err != nil {
 419			return err
 420		}
 421		relPath, err := filepath.Rel(src, p)
 422		if err != nil {
 423			return err
 424		}
 425		targetPath := filepath.Join(dst, relPath)
 426		if info.IsDir() {
 427			return os.MkdirAll(targetPath, constant.DirPerm)
 428		}
 429		return copyFile(p, targetPath)
 430	})
 431}
 432
 433func copyFile(src, dst string) error {
 434	srcFile, err := os.Open(src)
 435	if err != nil {
 436		return err
 437	}
 438	defer srcFile.Close()
 439	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(dst), constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 440		return err
 441	}
 442	dstFile, err := os.Create(dst)
 443	if err != nil {
 444		return err
 445	}
 446	defer dstFile.Close()
 447	_, err = io.Copy(dstFile, srcFile)
 448	return err
 449}

  50func handleChineseDomain(domain string) (string, error) {

  57func isHTTPSProxyPass(proxyPass string) bool {
  58	return strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(proxyPass)), "https:">//")
  59}
  60
  61func normalizeProxyPass(proxyPass string) string {
  62	proxyPass = strings.TrimSpace(proxyPass)
  63	if proxyPass == "" {
  64		return ""
  65	}
  66	if strings.Contains(proxyPass, ":">//") || strings.HasPrefix(proxyPass, "unix:") {
  67		return proxyPass
  68	}
  69	return fmt.Sprintf("http:">//%s", proxyPass)
  70}

  72func getAppInstallProxyPass(appInstall *model.AppInstall) (string, error) {
  73	if appInstall == nil {
  74		return "", errors.New("app install is nil")
  75	}
  76	if appInstall.HttpPort > 0 {
  77		return fmt.Sprintf("http:">//127.0.0.1:%d", appInstall.HttpPort), nil
  78	}
  79	if appInstall.HttpsPort > 0 {
  80		return fmt.Sprintf("https:">//127.0.0.1:%d", appInstall.HttpsPort), nil
  81	}
  82	return "", fmt.Errorf("app %s has no available http or https port", appInstall.Name)
  83}
  84
  85func getAppInstallProxyPassOrEmpty(appInstall *model.AppInstall) string {
  86	proxyPass, err := getAppInstallProxyPass(appInstall)

  89	}
  90	return proxyPass
  91}

  93func hasAppInstallProxyPassChanged(before *model.AppInstall, after *model.AppInstall) bool {

  97func getRootProxyDirectives(proxyPass string) []components.IDirective {
  98	server := &components.Server{}
  99	server.UpdateRootProxy([]string{normalizeProxyPass(proxyPass)})
 100
 101	locations := server.FindDirectives("location")
 102	if len(locations) == 0 || locations[0].GetBlock() == nil {

 104	}

 113func applyLocationProxyPass(location *components.Location, proxyPass string, sni *bool, proxySSLName string) {
 114	location.UpdateDirective("proxy_pass", []string{proxyPass})
 115
 116	enableSNI := isHTTPSProxyPass(proxyPass)
 117	if sni != nil {
 118		enableSNI = enableSNI && *sni
 119	}
 120	if enableSNI {
 121		location.UpdateDirective("proxy_ssl_server_name", []string{"on"})
 122	} else {
 123		location.UpdateDirective("proxy_ssl_server_name", []string{"off"})
 124	}
 125
 126	sslName := "$proxy_host"
 127	if proxySSLName != "" {
 128		sslName = proxySSLName
 129	}
 130	location.UpdateDirective("proxy_ssl_name", []string{sslName})
 131}

 133func createIndexFile(website *model.Website, runtime *model.Runtime) error {

 143		indexPath = path.Join(indexFolder, "index.html")
 144		indexHtml, _ := websiteService.GetDefaultHtml("index")
 145		indexContent = indexHtml.Content
 146	case constant.Runtime:
 147		if runtime.Type == constant.RuntimePHP {
 148			indexPath = path.Join(indexFolder, "index.php")
 149			indexPhp, _ := websiteService.GetDefaultHtml("php")
 150			indexContent = indexPhp.Content
 151		}
 152	}
 153
 154	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
 155	if !fileOp.Stat(indexFolder) {
 156		if err := fileOp.CreateDir(indexFolder, constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 157			return err
 158		}
 159	}
 160	if !fileOp.Stat(indexPath) {
 161		if err := fileOp.CreateFile(indexPath); err != nil {
 162			return err
 163		}
 164	}
 165	if website.Type == constant.Runtime && runtime.Resource == constant.ResourceAppstore {
 166		if err := chownRootDir(indexFolder); err != nil {
 167			return err
 168		}
 169	}
 170	if err := fileOp.WriteFile(indexPath, strings.NewReader(indexContent), constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 171		return err
 172	}
 173
 174	html404, _ := websiteService.GetDefaultHtml("404")
 175	path404 := path.Join(indexFolder, "404.html")
 176	if err := fileOp.WriteFile(path404, strings.NewReader(html404.Content), constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 177		return err
 178	}
 179
 180	return nil
 181}

 183func createProxyFile(website *model.Website) error {
 184	proxyFolder := GetSitePath(*website, SiteProxyDir)
 185	filePath := path.Join(proxyFolder, "root.conf")
 186	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
 187	if !fileOp.Stat(proxyFolder) {
 188		if err := fileOp.CreateDir(proxyFolder, constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 189			return err
 190		}
 191	}
 192	if !fileOp.Stat(filePath) {
 193		if err := fileOp.CreateFile(filePath); err != nil {
 194			return err
 195		}
 196	}
 197	config, err := parser.NewStringParser(string(nginx_conf.Proxy)).Parse()
 198	if err != nil {
 199		return err
 200	}
 201	config.FilePath = filePath
 202	directives := config.Directives
 203	location, ok := directives[0].(*components.Location)
 204	if !ok {
 205		return errors.New("error")
 206	}
 207	location.ChangePath("^~", "/")
 208	applyLocationProxyPass(location, website.Proxy, nil, "")
 209	location.UpdateDirective("proxy_set_header", []string{"Host", "$host"})
 210	if err := nginx.WriteConfig(config, nginx.IndentedStyle); err != nil {
 211		return buserr.WithErr("ErrUpdateBuWebsite", err)
 212	}
 213	return nil
 214}

 216func createWebsiteFolder(website *model.Website, runtime *model.Runtime) error {
 217	siteFolder := GetSiteDir(website.Alias)
 218	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
 219	if !fileOp.Stat(siteFolder) {
 220		if err := fileOp.CreateDir(siteFolder, constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 221			return err
 222		}
 223		if err := fileOp.CreateDir(path.Join(siteFolder, "log"), constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 224			return err
 225		}
 226		if err := fileOp.CreateFile(path.Join(siteFolder, "log", "access.log")); err != nil {
 227			return err
 228		}
 229		if err := fileOp.CreateFile(path.Join(siteFolder, "log", "error.log")); err != nil {
 230			return err
 231		}
 232		if website.Type != constant.Stream {
 233			if err := fileOp.CreateDir(path.Join(siteFolder, "index"), constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 234				return err
 235			}
 236			if err := fileOp.CreateDir(path.Join(siteFolder, "ssl"), constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 237				return err
 238			}
 239		}
 240		if website.Type == constant.Runtime {
 241			if runtime.Type == constant.RuntimePHP && runtime.Resource == constant.ResourceLocal {
 242				phpPoolDir := path.Join(siteFolder, "php-pool")
 243				if err := fileOp.CreateDir(phpPoolDir, constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 244					return err
 245				}
 246				if err := fileOp.CreateFile(path.Join(phpPoolDir, "php-fpm.sock")); err != nil {
 247					return err
 248				}
 249			}
 250		}
 251		if website.Type == constant.Static || (website.Type == constant.Runtime && runtime.Type == constant.RuntimePHP) {
 252			if err := createIndexFile(website, runtime); err != nil {
 253				return err
 254			}
 255		}
 256		if website.Type == constant.Proxy {
 257			if err := createProxyFile(website); err != nil {
 258				return err
 259			}
 260		}
 261	}
 262	return nil
 263}

 265func configDefaultNginx(website *model.Website, domains []model.WebsiteDomain, appInstall *model.AppInstall, runtime *model.Runtime, streamConfig request.StreamConfig) error {
 266	nginxInstall, err := getAppInstallByKey(constant.AppOpenresty)
 267	if err != nil {
 268		return err
 269	}
 270	if err = createWebsiteFolder(website, runtime); err != nil {
 271		return err
 272	}
 273	var (
 274		configPath string
 275		config     *components.Config
 276	)
 277	if website.Type == constant.Stream {
 278		if streamConfig.StreamPorts == "" {
 279			return buserr.New("ErrTypePortRange")
 280		}
 281		nginxContent := nginx_conf.GetWebsiteFile("stream_default.conf")
 282		config, err = parser.NewStringParser(string(nginxContent)).Parse()
 283		if err != nil {
 284			return err
 285		}
 286		servers := config.FindServers()
 287		if len(servers) == 0 {
 288			return errors.New("nginx config is not valid")
 289		}
 290		server := servers[0]
 291		ports := strings.Split(streamConfig.StreamPorts, ",")
 292		var params []string
 293		if streamConfig.UDP {
 294			params = []string{"udp"}
 295		}
 296		for _, port := range ports {
 297			server.UpdateListen(port, false, params...)
 298			if website.IPV6 {
 299				server.UpdateListen("[::]:"+port, false, params...)
 300			}
 301		}
 302		siteFolder := path.Join("/www", "sites", website.Alias)
 303		server.UpdateDirective("access_log", []string{path.Join(siteFolder, "log", "access.log"), "streamlog"})
 304		server.UpdateDirective("error_log", []string{path.Join(siteFolder, "log", "error.log")})
 305		server.UpdateDirective("proxy_pass", []string{website.Alias})
 306
 307		upstream := components.Upstream{
 308			UpstreamName: website.Alias,
 309		}
 310		if streamConfig.Algorithm != "default" {
 311			upstream.UpdateDirective(streamConfig.Algorithm, []string{})
 312		}
 313		upstream.UpstreamServers = parseUpstreamServers(streamConfig.Servers)
 314		config.Block.Directives = append(config.Block.Directives, &upstream)
 315		configPath = GetSitePath(*website, StreamConf)
 316	} else {
 317		configPath = GetSitePath(*website, SiteConf)
 318		nginxContent := nginx_conf.GetWebsiteFile("website_default.conf")
 319		config, err = parser.NewStringParser(string(nginxContent)).Parse()
 320		if err != nil {
 321			return err
 322		}
 323		servers := config.FindServers()
 324		if len(servers) == 0 {
 325			return errors.New("nginx config is not valid")
 326		}
 327		server := servers[0]
 328		server.DeleteListen("80")
 329		var serverNames []string
 330		for _, domain := range domains {
 331			serverNames = append(serverNames, domain.Domain)
 332			setListen(server, strconv.Itoa(domain.Port), website.IPV6, false, website.DefaultServer, false)
 333		}
 334		server.UpdateServerName(serverNames)
 335
 336		siteFolder := path.Join("/www", "sites", website.Alias)
 337		server.UpdateDirective("access_log", []string{path.Join(siteFolder, "log", "access.log"), "main"})
 338		server.UpdateDirective("error_log", []string{path.Join(siteFolder, "log", "error.log")})
 339
 340		rootIndex := path.Join("/www/sites", website.Alias, "index")
 341		switch website.Type {
 342		case constant.Deployment:
 343			proxy, err := getAppInstallProxyPass(appInstall)
 344			if err != nil {
 345				return err
 346			}
 347			server.UpdateRootProxy([]string{proxy})
 348		case constant.Static:
 349			server.UpdateRoot(rootIndex)
 350			server.UpdateDirective("error_page", []string{"404", "/404.html"})
 351		case constant.Proxy:
 352			nginxInclude := fmt.Sprintf("/www/sites/%s/proxy/*.conf", website.Alias)
 353			server.UpdateDirective("include", []string{nginxInclude})
 354			server.UpdateRoot(rootIndex)
 355		case constant.Runtime:
 356			switch runtime.Type {
 357			case constant.RuntimePHP:
 358				server.UpdateDirective("error_page", []string{"404", "/404.html"})
 359				if runtime.Resource == constant.ResourceLocal {
 360					server.UpdateRoot(rootIndex)
 361					localPath := path.Join(rootIndex, "index.php")
 362					server.UpdatePHPProxy([]string{website.Proxy}, localPath)
 363				} else {
 364					server.UpdateRoot(rootIndex)
 365					server.UpdatePHPProxy([]string{website.Proxy}, "")
 366				}
 367			case constant.RuntimeNode, constant.RuntimeJava, constant.RuntimeGo, constant.RuntimePython, constant.RuntimeDotNet:
 368				server.UpdateRootProxy([]string{normalizeProxyPass(website.Proxy)})
 369			}
 370		case constant.Subsite:
 371			parentWebsite, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(website.ParentWebsiteID))
 372			if err != nil {
 373				return err
 374			}
 375			website.Proxy = parentWebsite.Proxy
 376			rootIndex = path.Join("/www/sites", parentWebsite.Alias, "index", website.SiteDir)
 377			server.UpdateDirective("error_page", []string{"404", "/404.html"})
 378			if parentWebsite.Type == constant.Runtime {
 379				parentRuntime, err := runtimeRepo.GetFirst(context.Background(), repo.WithByID(parentWebsite.RuntimeID))
 380				if err != nil {
 381					return err
 382				}
 383				website.RuntimeID = parentRuntime.ID
 384				if parentRuntime.Type == constant.RuntimePHP {
 385					if parentRuntime.Resource == constant.ResourceLocal {
 386						server.UpdateRoot(rootIndex)
 387						localPath := path.Join(rootIndex, "index.php")
 388						server.UpdatePHPProxy([]string{website.Proxy}, localPath)
 389					} else {
 390						server.UpdateRoot(rootIndex)
 391						server.UpdatePHPProxy([]string{website.Proxy}, "")
 392					}
 393				}
 394			}
 395			if parentWebsite.Type == constant.Static {
 396				server.UpdateRoot(rootIndex)
 397			}
 398		}
 399	}
 400	config.FilePath = configPath
 401	if err = nginx.WriteConfig(config, nginx.IndentedStyle); err != nil {
 402		return err
 403	}
 404	if err = opNginx(nginxInstall.ContainerName, constant.NginxCheck); err != nil {
 405		return err
 406	}
 407	if err = opNginx(nginxInstall.ContainerName, constant.NginxReload); err != nil {
 408		return err
 409	}
 410	return nil
 411}

 413func moveDefaultWafConfig(websiteDir string, defaultConfigContent []byte, defaultRuleDir string, fileOp files.FileOp) error {
 414	if !fileOp.Stat(websiteDir) {
 415		if err := fileOp.CreateDir(websiteDir, constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 416			return err
 417		}
 418	}
 419	if err := fileOp.SaveFileWithByte(path.Join(websiteDir, "config.json"), defaultConfigContent, constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 420		return err
 421	}
 422	websiteRuleDir := path.Join(websiteDir, "rules")
 423	if !fileOp.Stat(websiteRuleDir) {
 424		if err := fileOp.CreateDir(websiteRuleDir, constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 425			return err
 426		}
 427	}
 428	defaultRulesName := []string{"acl", "args", "cookie", "defaultUaBlack", "defaultUrlBlack", "fileExt", "header", "methodWhite", "cdn"}
 429	for _, ruleName := range defaultRulesName {
 430		srcPath := path.Join(defaultRuleDir, ruleName+".json")
 431		if fileOp.Stat(srcPath) {
 432			_ = fileOp.Copy(srcPath, websiteRuleDir)
 433		}
 434	}
 435	return nil
 436}

 438func createAllWebsitesWAFConfig(websites []model.Website) error {
 439	nginxInstall, err := getAppInstallByKey(constant.AppOpenresty)
 440	if err != nil {
 441		return err
 442	}
 443	wafDataPath := path.Join(nginxInstall.GetPath(), "1pwaf", "data")
 444	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
 445	if !fileOp.Stat(wafDataPath) {
 446		return nil
 447	}
 448	websitesConfigPath := path.Join(wafDataPath, "conf", "sites.json")
 449	var websitesArray []request.WafWebsite
 450	for _, website := range websites {
 451		wafWebsite := request.WafWebsite{
 452			Key:     website.Alias,
 453			Domains: make([]string, 0),
 454			Host:    make([]string, 0),
 455		}
 456		websiteDomains, _ := websiteDomainRepo.GetBy(websiteDomainRepo.WithWebsiteId(website.ID))
 457		for _, domain := range websiteDomains {
 458			wafWebsite.Domains = append(wafWebsite.Domains, domain.Domain)
 459			wafWebsite.Host = append(wafWebsite.Host, domain.Domain+":"+strconv.Itoa(domain.Port))
 460		}
 461		websitesArray = append(websitesArray, wafWebsite)
 462	}
 463	websitesContent, err := json.Marshal(websitesArray)
 464	if err != nil {
 465		return err
 466	}
 467	if err := fileOp.SaveFileWithByte(websitesConfigPath, websitesContent, constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 468		return err
 469	}
 470	var (
 471		defaultConfigPath = path.Join(wafDataPath, "conf", "siteConfig.json")
 472		defaultRuleDir    = path.Join(wafDataPath, "rules")
 473		sitesDir          = path.Join(wafDataPath, "sites")
 474	)
 475	defaultConfigContent, err := fileOp.GetContent(defaultConfigPath)
 476	if err != nil {
 477		return err
 478	}
 479
 480	for _, website := range websites {
 481		websiteDir := path.Join(sitesDir, website.Alias)
 482		if err := moveDefaultWafConfig(websiteDir, defaultConfigContent, defaultRuleDir, fileOp); err != nil {
 483			return err
 484		}
 485	}
 486	return nil
 487}

 496func createWafConfig(website *model.Website, domains []model.WebsiteDomain) error {
 497	nginxInstall, err := getAppInstallByKey(constant.AppOpenresty)
 498	if err != nil {
 499		return err
 500	}
 501	wafDataPath := path.Join(nginxInstall.GetPath(), "1pwaf", "data")
 502	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
 503	if !fileOp.Stat(wafDataPath) {
 504		return nil
 505	}
 506	websitesConfigPath := path.Join(wafDataPath, "conf", "sites.json")
 507	content, err := fileOp.GetContent(websitesConfigPath)
 508	if err != nil {
 509		return err
 510	}
 511	var websitesArray []request.WafWebsite
 512	if len(content) != 0 {
 513		if err := json.Unmarshal(content, &websitesArray); err != nil {
 514			return err
 515		}
 516	}
 517	wafWebsite := request.WafWebsite{
 518		Key:     website.Alias,
 519		Domains: make([]string, 0),
 520		Host:    make([]string, 0),
 521	}
 522
 523	for _, domain := range domains {
 524		wafWebsite.Domains = append(wafWebsite.Domains, domain.Domain)
 525		wafWebsite.Host = append(wafWebsite.Host, domain.Domain+":"+strconv.Itoa(domain.Port))
 526	}
 527	websitesArray = append(websitesArray, wafWebsite)
 528	websitesContent, err := json.Marshal(websitesArray)
 529	if err != nil {
 530		return err
 531	}
 532	if err := fileOp.SaveFileWithByte(websitesConfigPath, websitesContent, constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 533		return err
 534	}
 535
 536	var (
 537		sitesDir          = path.Join(wafDataPath, "sites")
 538		defaultConfigPath = path.Join(wafDataPath, "conf", "siteConfig.json")
 539		defaultRuleDir    = path.Join(wafDataPath, "rules")
 540		websiteDir        = path.Join(sitesDir, website.Alias)
 541	)
 542
 543	defaultConfigContent, err := fileOp.GetContent(defaultConfigPath)
 544	if err != nil {
 545		return err
 546	}
 547
 548	defer func() {
 549		if err != nil {
 550			_ = fileOp.DeleteDir(websiteDir)
 551		}
 552	}()
 553
 554	if err := moveDefaultWafConfig(websiteDir, defaultConfigContent, defaultRuleDir, fileOp); err != nil {
 555		return err
 556	}
 557
 558	if err = opNginx(nginxInstall.ContainerName, constant.NginxCheck); err != nil {
 559		return err
 560	}
 561	if err = opNginx(nginxInstall.ContainerName, constant.NginxReload); err != nil {
 562		return err
 563	}
 564
 565	return nil
 566}

 568func delNginxConfig(website model.Website, force bool) error {

 571		configPath string
 572	)

 574		configPath = GetSitePath(website, StreamConf)
 575
 576	} else {

 578	}

 582		}
 583	}
 584	sitePath := GetSiteDir(website.Alias)
 585	if fileOp.Stat(sitePath) {

 589

 591	if err != nil {

 593	}
 594	nginxInstall, err := appInstallRepo.GetFirst(appInstallRepo.WithAppId(nginxApp.ID))
 595	if err != nil {
 596		if errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {

 598		}

 610func delWafConfig(website model.Website, force bool) error {
 611	nginxInstall, err := getAppInstallByKey(constant.AppOpenresty)
 612	if err != nil {
 613		return err
 614	}
 615	if !common.CompareVersion(nginxInstall.Version, "1.21.4.3-2-0") {
 616		return nil
 617	}
 618	wafDataPath := path.Join(nginxInstall.GetPath(), "1pwaf", "data")
 619	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
 620	if !fileOp.Stat(wafDataPath) {
 621		return nil
 622	}
 623	websitesConfigPath := path.Join(wafDataPath, "conf", "sites.json")
 624	content, err := fileOp.GetContent(websitesConfigPath)
 625	if err != nil {
 626		return err
 627	}
 628	var websitesArray []request.WafWebsite
 629	var newWebsiteArray []request.WafWebsite
 630	if len(content) > 0 {
 631		if err = json.Unmarshal(content, &websitesArray); err != nil {
 632			return err
 633		}
 634	}
 635	for _, wafWebsite := range websitesArray {
 636		if wafWebsite.Key != website.Alias {
 637			newWebsiteArray = append(newWebsiteArray, wafWebsite)
 638		}
 639	}
 640	websitesContent, err := json.Marshal(newWebsiteArray)
 641	if err != nil {
 642		return err
 643	}
 644	if err := fileOp.SaveFileWithByte(websitesConfigPath, websitesContent, constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 645		return err
 646	}
 647
 648	for _, websiteDataDir := range []string{
 649		path.Join(wafDataPath, "sites", website.Alias),
 650		path.Join(wafDataPath, "db", "monitor", website.Alias),
 651		path.Join(wafDataPath, "db", "sites", website.Alias),
 652	} {
 653		_ = fileOp.DeleteDir(websiteDataDir)
 654	}
 655
 656	if err := opNginx(nginxInstall.ContainerName, constant.NginxReload); err != nil {
 657		if force {
 658			return nil
 659		}
 660		return err
 661	}
 662	return nil
 663}

 665func isHttp3(server *components.Server) bool {
 666	for _, listen := range server.Listens {
 667		for _, param := range listen.Parameters {
 668			if param == "quic" {
 669				return true
 670			}
 671		}
 672	}
 673	return false
 674}

 676func addListenAndServerName(website model.Website, domains []model.WebsiteDomain) error {
 677	nginxFull, err := getNginxFull(&website)
 678	if err != nil {
 679		return nil
 680	}
 681	nginxConfig := nginxFull.SiteConfig
 682	config := nginxFull.SiteConfig.Config
 683	server := config.FindServers()[0]
 684	http3 := isHttp3(server)
 685
 686	var allDomains []string
 687	existDomains, _ := websiteDomainRepo.GetBy(websiteDomainRepo.WithWebsiteId(website.ID))
 688	for _, domain := range existDomains {
 689		allDomains = append(allDomains, domain.Domain)
 690	}
 691
 692	for _, domain := range domains {
 693		setListen(server, strconv.Itoa(domain.Port), website.IPV6, http3, website.DefaultServer, website.Protocol == constant.ProtocolHTTPS && domain.SSL)
 694		allDomains = append(allDomains, domain.Domain)
 695	}
 696	server.UpdateServerName(allDomains)
 697
 698	if err = nginx.WriteConfig(config, nginx.IndentedStyle); err != nil {
 699		return err
 700	}
 701	return nginxCheckAndReload(nginxConfig.OldContent, nginxConfig.FilePath, nginxFull.Install.ContainerName)
 702}

 704func deleteListenAndServerName(website model.Website, binds []string, domains []string) error {
 705	nginxFull, err := getNginxFull(&website)
 706	if err != nil {
 707		return nil
 708	}
 709	nginxConfig := nginxFull.SiteConfig
 710	config := nginxFull.SiteConfig.Config
 711	server := config.FindServers()[0]
 712	for _, bind := range binds {
 713		server.DeleteListen(bind)
 714		server.DeleteListen("[::]:" + bind)
 715	}
 716	for _, domain := range domains {
 717		server.DeleteServerName(domain)
 718	}
 719
 720	if err := nginx.WriteConfig(config, nginx.IndentedStyle); err != nil {
 721		return err
 722	}
 723	return nginxCheckAndReload(nginxConfig.OldContent, nginxConfig.FilePath, nginxFull.Install.ContainerName)
 724}

 726func setListen(server *components.Server, port string, ipv6, http3, defaultServer, ssl bool) {
 727	var params []string
 728	if ssl {
 729		params = []string{"ssl"}
 730	}
 731	server.UpdateListen(port, defaultServer, params...)
 732	if ssl && http3 {
 733		server.UpdateListen(port, defaultServer, "quic")
 734	}
 735	if !ipv6 {
 736		return
 737	}
 738	server.UpdateListen("[::]:"+port, defaultServer, params...)
 739	if ssl && http3 {
 740		server.UpdateListen("[::]:"+port, defaultServer, "quic")
 741	}
 742}
 743
 744func removeSSLListen(website model.Website, binds []string) error {
 745	nginxFull, err := getNginxFull(&website)
 746	if err != nil {
 747		return nil
 748	}
 749	nginxConfig := nginxFull.SiteConfig
 750	config := nginxFull.SiteConfig.Config
 751	server := config.FindServers()[0]
 752	http3 := isHttp3(server)
 753	for _, bind := range binds {
 754		server.DeleteListen(bind)
 755		if website.IPV6 {
 756			server.DeleteListen("[::]:" + bind)
 757		}
 758		setListen(server, bind, website.IPV6, http3, website.DefaultServer, website.Protocol == constant.ProtocolHTTPS)
 759	}
 760	if err := nginx.WriteConfig(config, nginx.IndentedStyle); err != nil {
 761		return err
 762	}
 763	return nginxCheckAndReload(nginxConfig.OldContent, nginxConfig.FilePath, nginxFull.Install.ContainerName)
 764}

 766func createPemFile(website model.Website, websiteSSL model.WebsiteSSL) error {
 767	configDir := GetSitePath(website, SiteSSLDir)
 768	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
 769
 770	if !fileOp.Stat(configDir) {
 771		if err := fileOp.CreateDir(configDir, constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 772			return err
 773		}
 774	}
 775
 776	fullChainFile := path.Join(configDir, "fullchain.pem")
 777	privatePemFile := path.Join(configDir, "privkey.pem")
 778
 779	if !fileOp.Stat(fullChainFile) {
 780		if err := fileOp.CreateFile(fullChainFile); err != nil {
 781			return err
 782		}
 783	}
 784	if !fileOp.Stat(privatePemFile) {
 785		if err := fileOp.CreateFile(privatePemFile); err != nil {
 786			return err
 787		}
 788	}
 789
 790	if err := fileOp.WriteFile(fullChainFile, strings.NewReader(websiteSSL.Pem), constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 791		return err
 792	}
 793	if err := fileOp.WriteFile(privatePemFile, strings.NewReader(websiteSSL.PrivateKey), constant.DirPerm); err != nil {
 794		return err
 795	}
 796	return nil
 797}

 799func getHttpsPort(websiteID uint) map[int]struct{} {
 800	domains, err := websiteDomainRepo.GetBy(websiteDomainRepo.WithWebsiteId(websiteID))
 801	if err != nil {
 802		return nil
 803	}
 804	httpsPorts := make(map[int]struct{})
 805	nginxInstall, _ := getAppInstallByKey(constant.AppOpenresty)
 806	hasDefaultPort := false
 807	for _, domain := range domains {
 808		if domain.Port == nginxInstall.HttpPort {
 809			hasDefaultPort = true
 810		}
 811		if domain.SSL {
 812			httpsPorts[domain.Port] = struct{}{}
 813		}
 814	}
 815	if hasDefaultPort {
 816		httpsPorts[nginxInstall.HttpsPort] = struct{}{}
 817	}
 818	if len(httpsPorts) == 0 {
 819		for _, domain := range domains {
 820			if !domain.SSL {
 821				httpsPorts[domain.Port] = struct{}{}
 822			}
 823		}
 824	}
 825	return httpsPorts
 826}

 828func applySSL(website *model.Website, websiteSSL model.WebsiteSSL, req request.WebsiteHTTPSOp) error {
 829	nginxFull, err := getNginxFull(website)
 830	if err != nil {
 831		return nil
 832	}
 833	domains, err := websiteDomainRepo.GetBy(websiteDomainRepo.WithWebsiteId(website.ID))
 834	if err != nil {
 835		return nil
 836	}
 837	httpPorts := make(map[int]struct{})
 838	httpsPorts := make(map[int]struct{})
 839	sslPort := 0
 840
 841	hasDefaultPort := false
 842	for _, domain := range domains {
 843		if domain.Port == nginxFull.Install.HttpPort {
 844			hasDefaultPort = true
 845		}
 846		if domain.SSL {
 847			httpsPorts[domain.Port] = struct{}{}
 848		} else {
 849			httpPorts[domain.Port] = struct{}{}
 850		}
 851	}
 852	if hasDefaultPort {
 853		httpsPorts[nginxFull.Install.HttpsPort] = struct{}{}
 854	}
 855	if len(httpsPorts) == 0 {
 856		for port := range httpPorts {
 857			httpsPorts[port] = struct{}{}
 858		}
 859	}
 860	config := nginxFull.SiteConfig.Config
 861	server := config.FindServers()[0]
 862
 863	defaultHttpPort := strconv.Itoa(nginxFull.Install.HttpPort)
 864	defaultHttpPortIPV6 := "[::]:" + defaultHttpPort
 865
 866	for port := range httpsPorts {
 867		sslPort = port
 868		portStr := strconv.Itoa(port)
 869		server.RemoveListenByBind(portStr)
 870		server.RemoveListenByBind("[::]:" + portStr)
 871		setListen(server, portStr, website.IPV6, req.Http3, website.DefaultServer, true)
 872	}
 873
 874	server.UpdateDirective("http2", []string{"on"})
 875
 876	switch req.HttpConfig {
 877	case constant.HTTPSOnly:
 878		server.RemoveListenByBind(defaultHttpPort)
 879		server.RemoveListenByBind(defaultHttpPortIPV6)
 880		server.RemoveDirective("if", []string{"($scheme"})
 881	case constant.HTTPToHTTPS:
 882		if hasDefaultPort {
 883			server.UpdateListen(defaultHttpPort, website.DefaultServer)
 884			if website.IPV6 {
 885				server.UpdateListen(defaultHttpPortIPV6, website.DefaultServer)
 886			}
 887		}
 888		server.AddHTTP2HTTPS(sslPort)
 889	case constant.HTTPAlso:
 890		if hasDefaultPort {
 891			server.UpdateListen(defaultHttpPort, website.DefaultServer)
 892			if website.IPV6 {
 893				server.UpdateListen(defaultHttpPortIPV6, website.DefaultServer)
 894			}
 895		}
 896		server.RemoveDirective("if", []string{"($scheme"})
 897	}
 898
 899	if !req.Hsts {
 900		server.RemoveDirective("add_header", []string{"Strict-Transport-Security", "\"max-age=31536000\""})
 901		server.RemoveDirective("add_header", []string{"Strict-Transport-Security", "\"max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains\""})
 902	}
 903	if !req.Http3 {
 904		for port := range httpsPorts {
 905			server.RemoveListen(strconv.Itoa(port), "quic")
 906			if website.IPV6 {
 907				httpsPortIPV6 := "[::]:" + strconv.Itoa(port)
 908				server.RemoveListen(httpsPortIPV6, "quic")
 909			}
 910		}
 911		server.RemoveDirective("add_header", []string{"Alt-Svc"})
 912	}
 913
 914	if err = nginx.WriteConfig(config, nginx.IndentedStyle); err != nil {
 915		return err
 916	}
 917	if err = createPemFile(*website, websiteSSL); err != nil {
 918		return err
 919	}
 920	nginxParams := getNginxParamsFromStaticFile(dto.SSL, []dto.NginxParam{})
 921	for i, param := range nginxParams {
 922		if param.Name == "ssl_certificate" {
 923			nginxParams[i].Params = []string{path.Join("/www", "sites", website.Alias, "ssl", "fullchain.pem")}
 924		}
 925		if param.Name == "ssl_certificate_key" {
 926			nginxParams[i].Params = []string{path.Join("/www", "sites", website.Alias, "ssl", "privkey.pem")}
 927		}
 928		if param.Name == "ssl_protocols" {
 929			nginxParams[i].Params = req.SSLProtocol
 930			if len(req.SSLProtocol) == 0 {
 931				nginxParams[i].Params = []string{"TLSv1.3", "TLSv1.2"}
 932			}
 933		}
 934		if param.Name == "ssl_ciphers" {
 935			nginxParams[i].Params = []string{req.Algorithm}
 936			if len(req.Algorithm) == 0 {
 937				nginxParams[i].Params = []string{"ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-ECDSA-CHACHA20-POLY1305:ECDHE-RSA-CHACHA20-POLY1305:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:DHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:DHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256:!aNULL:!eNULL:!EXPORT:!DSS:!DES:!RC4:!3DES:!MD5:!PSK:!KRB5:!SRP:!CAMELLIA:!SEED"}
 938			}
 939		}
 940		if param.Name == "error_page" {
 941			if len(param.Params) < 2 {
 942				continue
 943			}
 944			code := param.Params[0]
 945			if code == "497" {
 946				if sslPort != 443 && param.Params[1] == "https:">//$host$request_uri" {
 947					param.Params[1] = fmt.Sprintf("https:">//$host:%d$request_uri", sslPort)
 948				}
 949			}
 950		}
 951	}
 952	if req.Hsts {
 953		var hstsValue string
 954		if req.HstsIncludeSubDomains {
 955			hstsValue = "\"max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains\""
 956		} else {
 957			hstsValue = "\"max-age=31536000\""
 958		}
 959		nginxParams = append(nginxParams, dto.NginxParam{
 960			Name:   "add_header",
 961			Params: []string{"Strict-Transport-Security", hstsValue},
 962		})
 963	}
 964	if req.Http3 {
 965		nginxParams = append(nginxParams, dto.NginxParam{
 966			Name:   "add_header",
 967			Params: []string{"Alt-Svc", "'h3=\":443\"; ma=2592000'"},
 968		})
 969	}
 970
 971	if err := updateNginxConfig(constant.NginxScopeServer, nginxParams, website); err != nil {
 972		return err
 973	}
 974	return nil
 975}

 977func getParamArray(key string, param interface{}) []string {
 978	var res []string
 979	switch p := param.(type) {
 980	case string:
 981		if key == "index" {
 982			res = strings.Split(p, "\n")
 983			return res
 984		}
 985
 986		res = strings.Split(p, " ")
 987		return res
 988	}
 989	return res
 990}
 991
 992func handleParamMap(paramMap map[string]string, keys []string) []dto.NginxParam {
 993	var nginxParams []dto.NginxParam
 994	for k, v := range paramMap {
 995		for _, name := range keys {
 996			if name == k {
 997				param := dto.NginxParam{
 998					Name:   k,
 999					Params: getParamArray(k, v),
1000				}
1001				nginxParams = append(nginxParams, param)
1002			}
1003		}
1004	}
1005	return nginxParams
1006}
1007
1008func getNginxParams(params interface{}, keys []string) []dto.NginxParam {
1009	var nginxParams []dto.NginxParam
1010
1011	switch p := params.(type) {
1012	case map[string]interface{}:
1013		return handleParamMap(toMapStr(p), keys)
1014	case []interface{}:
1015		for _, mA := range p {
1016			if m, ok := mA.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
1017				nginxParams = append(nginxParams, handleParamMap(toMapStr(m), keys)...)
1018			}
1019		}
1020	}
1021	return nginxParams
1022}
1023
1024func toMapStr(m map[string]interface{}) map[string]string {
1025	ret := make(map[string]string, len(m))
1026	for k, v := range m {
1027		ret[k] = fmt.Sprint(v)
1028	}
1029	return ret
1030}

1052func opWebsite(website *model.Website, operate string) error {
1053	nginxInstall, err := getNginxFull(website)
1054	if err != nil {
1055		return err
1056	}
1057	config := nginxInstall.SiteConfig.Config
1058	servers := config.FindServers()
1059	if len(servers) == 0 {
1060		return errors.New("nginx config is not valid")
1061	}
1062	server := servers[0]
1063	if operate == constant.StopWeb {
1064		proxyInclude := fmt.Sprintf("/www/sites/%s/proxy/*.conf", website.Alias)
1065		server.RemoveDirective("include", []string{proxyInclude})
1066		rewriteInclude := fmt.Sprintf("/www/sites/%s/rewrite/%s.conf", website.Alias, website.Alias)
1067		server.RemoveDirective("include", []string{rewriteInclude})
1068		redirectInclude := getWebsiteRedirectInclude(*website)
1069		server.RemoveDirective("include", []string{redirectInclude})
1070
1071		switch website.Type {
1072		case constant.Deployment:
1073			server.RemoveDirective("location", []string{"/"})
1074		case constant.Runtime:
1075			runtime, err := runtimeRepo.GetFirst(context.Background(), repo.WithByID(website.RuntimeID))
1076			if err != nil {
1077				return err
1078			}
1079			if runtime.Type == constant.RuntimePHP {
1080				server.RemoveDirective("location", []string{"~", "[^/]\\.php(/|$)"})
1081			} else {
1082				server.RemoveDirective("location", []string{"/"})
1083			}
1084		}
1085		server.UpdateRoot("/usr/share/nginx/html/stop")
1086		website.Status = constant.WebStopped
1087	}
1088	if operate == constant.StartWeb {
1089		absoluteIncludeDir := GetSitePath(*website, SiteProxyDir)
1090		fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
1091		if fileOp.Stat(absoluteIncludeDir) && !files.IsEmptyDir(absoluteIncludeDir) {
1092			proxyInclude := fmt.Sprintf("/www/sites/%s/proxy/*.conf", website.Alias)
1093			server.UpdateDirective("include", []string{proxyInclude})
1094		}
1095		rewriteInclude := fmt.Sprintf("/www/sites/%s/rewrite/%s.conf", website.Alias, website.Alias)
1096		absoluteRewritePath := GetSitePath(*website, SiteReWritePath)
1097		if fileOp.Stat(absoluteRewritePath) {
1098			server.UpdateDirective("include", []string{rewriteInclude})
1099		}
1100		redirectInclude := getWebsiteRedirectInclude(*website)
1101		absoluteRedirectPath := GetSitePath(*website, SiteRedirectDir)
1102		if fileOp.Stat(absoluteRedirectPath) {
1103			server.UpdateDirective("include", []string{redirectInclude})
1104		}
1105		rootIndex := path.Join("/www/sites", website.Alias, "index")
1106		if website.SiteDir != "/" {
1107			rootIndex = path.Join(rootIndex, website.SiteDir)
1108		}
1109		switch website.Type {
1110		case constant.Deployment:
1111			server.RemoveDirective("root", nil)
1112			appInstall, err := appInstallRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(website.AppInstallID))
1113			if err != nil {
1114				return err
1115			}
1116			proxy, err := getAppInstallProxyPass(&appInstall)
1117			if err != nil {
1118				return err
1119			}
1120			server.UpdateRootProxy([]string{proxy})
1121		case constant.Static:
1122			server.UpdateRoot(rootIndex)
1123			server.UpdateRootLocation()
1124		case constant.Proxy:
1125			server.RemoveDirective("root", nil)
1126		case constant.Runtime:
1127			server.UpdateRoot(rootIndex)
1128			localPath := ""
1129			runtime, err := runtimeRepo.GetFirst(context.Background(), repo.WithByID(website.RuntimeID))
1130			if err != nil {
1131				return err
1132			}
1133			if runtime.Type == constant.RuntimePHP {
1134				if website.ProxyType == constant.RuntimeProxyUnix || website.ProxyType == constant.RuntimeProxyTcp {
1135					localPath = path.Join(rootIndex, "index.php")
1136				}
1137				server.UpdatePHPProxy([]string{website.Proxy}, localPath)
1138			} else {
1139				proxy := normalizeProxyPass(website.Proxy)
1140				server.UpdateRootProxy([]string{proxy})
1141			}
1142		case constant.Subsite:
1143			parentWebsite, err := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(website.ParentWebsiteID))
1144			if err != nil {
1145				return err
1146			}
1147			website.Proxy = parentWebsite.Proxy
1148			rootIndex = path.Join("/www/sites", parentWebsite.Alias, "index", website.SiteDir)
1149			if parentWebsite.Type == constant.Runtime {
1150				parentRuntime, err := runtimeRepo.GetFirst(context.Background(), repo.WithByID(parentWebsite.RuntimeID))
1151				if err != nil {
1152					return err
1153				}
1154				website.RuntimeID = parentRuntime.ID
1155				if parentRuntime.Type == constant.RuntimePHP {
1156					server.UpdateRoot(rootIndex)
1157					localPath := ""
1158					if parentRuntime.Resource == constant.ResourceLocal {
1159						localPath = path.Join(rootIndex, "index.php")
1160					}
1161					server.UpdatePHPProxy([]string{website.Proxy}, localPath)
1162				}
1163			}
1164			if parentWebsite.Type == constant.Static {
1165				server.UpdateRoot(rootIndex)
1166			}
1167		}
1168		website.Status = constant.WebRunning
1169		now := time.Now()
1170		if website.ExpireDate.Before(now) {
1171			defaultDate, _ := time.Parse(constant.DateLayout, constant.WebsiteDefaultExpireDate)
1172			website.ExpireDate = defaultDate
1173		}
1174	}
1175
1176	if err := nginx.WriteConfig(config, nginx.IndentedStyle); err != nil {
1177		return err
1178	}
1179	return nginxCheckAndReload(nginxInstall.SiteConfig.OldContent, config.FilePath, nginxInstall.Install.ContainerName)
1180}
1181
1182func changeIPV6(website model.Website, enable bool) error {
1183	nginxFull, err := getNginxFull(&website)
1184	if err != nil {
1185		return nil
1186	}
1187	config := nginxFull.SiteConfig.Config
1188	server := config.FindServers()[0]
1189	listens := server.Listens
1190	if enable {
1191		for _, listen := range listens {
1192			if strings.HasPrefix(listen.Bind, "[::]:") {
1193				continue
1194			}
1195			exist := false
1196			ipv6Bind := fmt.Sprintf("[::]:%s", listen.Bind)
1197			for _, li := range listens {
1198				if li.Bind == ipv6Bind {
1199					exist = true
1200					break
1201				}
1202			}
1203			if !exist {
1204				server.UpdateListen(ipv6Bind, false, listen.GetParameters()[1:]...)
1205			}
1206		}
1207	} else {
1208		for _, listen := range listens {
1209			if strings.HasPrefix(listen.Bind, "[::]:") {
1210				server.RemoveListenByBind(listen.Bind)
1211			}
1212		}
1213	}
1214	if err := nginx.WriteConfig(config, nginx.IndentedStyle); err != nil {
1215		return err
1216	}
1217	return nginxCheckAndReload(nginxFull.SiteConfig.OldContent, config.FilePath, nginxFull.Install.ContainerName)
1218}

1240func getWebsiteDomains(domains []request.WebsiteDomain, defaultHTTPPort, defaultHTTPsPort int, websiteID uint) (domainModels []model.WebsiteDomain, addPorts []int, addDomains []string, err error) {
1241	var (
1242		ports     = make(map[int]struct{})
1243		existPort = make(map[int]struct{})
1244	)
1245	existDomains, _ := websiteDomainRepo.GetBy(websiteDomainRepo.WithWebsiteId(websiteID))
1246	for _, domain := range existDomains {
1247		existPort[domain.Port] = struct{}{}
1248	}
1249	for _, domain := range domains {
1250		if domain.Domain == "" {
1251			continue
1252		}
1253		if !(common.IsValidNginxServerName(domain.Domain) || common.IsValidIP(domain.Domain)) {
1254			err = buserr.WithName("ErrDomainFormat", domain.Domain)
1255			return
1256		}
1257		var domainModel model.WebsiteDomain
1258		domainModel.Domain, err = handleChineseDomain(domain.Domain)
1259		if err != nil {
1260			return
1261		}
1262		domainModel.Domain = strings.ToLower(domainModel.Domain)
1263		domainModel.Port = domain.Port
1264		if domain.Port == 0 {
1265			domain.Port = defaultHTTPPort
1266		}
1267		domainModel.SSL = domain.SSL
1268		domainModel.WebsiteID = websiteID
1269		domainModels = append(domainModels, domainModel)
1270		if _, ok := existPort[domainModel.Port]; !ok {
1271			ports[domainModel.Port] = struct{}{}
1272		}
1273		if exist, _ := websiteDomainRepo.GetFirst(websiteDomainRepo.WithDomain(domainModel.Domain), websiteDomainRepo.WithWebsiteId(websiteID)); exist.ID == 0 {
1274			addDomains = append(addDomains, domainModel.Domain)
1275		}
1276	}
1277	for _, domain := range domainModels {
1278		if exist, _ := websiteDomainRepo.GetFirst(websiteDomainRepo.WithDomain(domain.Domain), websiteDomainRepo.WithPort(domain.Port)); exist.ID > 0 {
1279			website, _ := websiteRepo.GetFirst(repo.WithByID(exist.WebsiteID))
1280			err = buserr.WithName("ErrDomainIsUsed", website.PrimaryDomain)
1281			return
1282		}
1283	}
1284
1285	for port := range ports {
1286		if port == defaultHTTPPort || port == defaultHTTPsPort {
1287			addPorts = append(addPorts, port)
1288			continue
1289		}
1290		if err = checkWebsitePort(defaultHTTPsPort, port, ""); err != nil {
1291			return
1292		}
1293		if existPorts, _ := websiteDomainRepo.GetBy(websiteDomainRepo.WithWebsiteId(websiteID), websiteDomainRepo.WithPort(port)); len(existPorts) == 0 {
1294			addPorts = append(addPorts, port)
1295		}
1296	}
1297
1298	return
1299}
1300
1301func checkWebsitePort(defaultHTTPsPort, port int, websiteType string) error {
1302	if existPorts, _ := websiteDomainRepo.GetBy(websiteDomainRepo.WithPort(port)); len(existPorts) > 0 {
1303		return nil
1304	}
1305	if websiteType == constant.Stream {
1306		websites, _ := websiteRepo.List(websiteRepo.WithType(constant.Stream))
1307		for _, website := range websites {
1308			ports := strings.Split(website.StreamPorts, ",")
1309			for _, p := range ports {
1310				pInt, _ := strconv.Atoi(p)
1311				if pInt == port {
1312					return nil
1313				}
1314			}
1315		}
1316	}
1317
1318	errMap := make(map[string]interface{})
1319	errMap["port"] = port
1320	appInstall, _ := appInstallRepo.GetFirst(appInstallRepo.WithPort(port))
1321	if appInstall.ID > 0 {
1322		errMap["type"] = i18n.GetMsgByKey("TYPE_APP")
1323		errMap["name"] = appInstall.Name
1324		return buserr.WithMap("ErrPortExist", errMap, nil)
1325	}
1326	runtime, _ := runtimeRepo.GetFirst(context.Background(), runtimeRepo.WithPort(port))
1327	if runtime != nil {
1328		errMap["type"] = i18n.GetMsgByKey("TYPE_RUNTIME")
1329		errMap["name"] = runtime.Name
1330		return buserr.WithMap("ErrPortExist", errMap, nil)
1331	}
1332	if port != defaultHTTPsPort && common.ScanPort(port) {
1333		return buserr.WithDetail("ErrPortInUsed", port, nil)
1334	}
1335	return nil
1336}
1337
1338func saveCertificateFile(websiteSSL *model.WebsiteSSL, logger *log.Logger) {
1339	if websiteSSL.PushDir {
1340		fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
1341		var (
1342			pushErr error
1343			MsgMap  = map[string]interface{}{"path": websiteSSL.Dir, "status": i18n.GetMsgByKey("Success")}
1344		)
1345		if pushErr = fileOp.SaveFile(path.Join(websiteSSL.Dir, "privkey.pem"), websiteSSL.PrivateKey, constant.FilePerm); pushErr != nil {

1348			logger.Println("Push dir failed:" + pushErr.Error())
1349		}
1350		if pushErr = fileOp.SaveFile(path.Join(websiteSSL.Dir, "fullchain.pem"), websiteSSL.Pem, constant.FilePerm); pushErr != nil {
1351			MsgMap["status"] = i18n.GetMsgByKey("Failed")
1352			logger.Println(i18n.GetMsgWithMap("PushDirLog", MsgMap))
1353			logger.Println("Push dir failed:" + pushErr.Error())
1354		}
1355		if pushErr == nil {
1356			logger.Println(i18n.GetMsgWithMap("PushDirLog", MsgMap))

1401		}
1402		if err := fileOp.WriteFile(path.Join(secretDir, "server.key"), strings.NewReader(websiteSSL.PrivateKey), 0600); err != nil {

1410func ChangeHSTSConfig(enable bool, includeSubDomains bool, http3Enable bool, website model.Website) error {
1411	includeDir := GetSitePath(website, SiteProxyDir)
1412	fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
1413	if !fileOp.Stat(includeDir) {
1414		return nil
1415	}
1416	err := filepath.Walk(includeDir, func(path string, info os.FileInfo, err error) error {
1417		if err != nil {
1418			return err
1419		}
1420		if !info.IsDir() {
1421			if filepath.Ext(path) == ".conf" {
1422				par, err := parser.NewParser(path)
1423				if err != nil {
1424					return err
1425				}
1426				config, err := par.Parse()
1427				if err != nil {
1428					return err
1429				}
1430				config.FilePath = path
1431				directives := config.Directives
1432				location, ok := directives[0].(*components.Location)
1433				if !ok {
1434					return nil
1435				}
1436				"cmt">//前置移除HSTS配置
1437				location.RemoveDirective("add_header", []string{"Strict-Transport-Security", "\"max-age=31536000\""})
1438				location.RemoveDirective("add_header", []string{"Strict-Transport-Security", "\"max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains\""})
1439				if enable {
1440					var hstsValue string
1441					if includeSubDomains {
1442						hstsValue = "\"max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains\""
1443					} else {
1444						hstsValue = "\"max-age=31536000\""
1445					}
1446					location.UpdateDirective("add_header", []string{"Strict-Transport-Security", hstsValue})
1447				}
1448
1449				if http3Enable {
1450					location.UpdateDirective("add_header", []string{"Alt-Svc", "'h3=\":443\"; ma=2592000'"})
1451				} else {
1452					location.RemoveDirective("add_header", []string{"Alt-Svc", "'h3=\":443\"; ma=2592000'"})
1453				}
1454				if err = nginx.WriteConfig(config, nginx.IndentedStyle); err != nil {
1455					return buserr.WithErr("ErrUpdateBuWebsite", err)
1456				}
1457			}
1458		}
1459		return nil
1460	})
1461	if err != nil {
1462		return err
1463	}
1464	return nil
1465}

1664func handleDefaultOwn(dir string) {
1665	parentDir := path.Dir(dir)
1666	info, err := os.Stat(parentDir)
1667	if err != nil {
1668		return
1669	}
1670	stat, ok := info.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t)
1671	uid, gid := -1, -1
1672	if ok {
1673		uid, gid = int(stat.Uid), int(stat.Gid)
1674	}
1675	_ = os.Chown(dir, uid, gid)
1676}

1724func updateWebsiteConfig(website model.Website, updateFunc func(server *components.Server) error) error {
1725	configPath := GetSitePath(website, SiteConf)
1726	nginxContent, err := files.NewFileOp().GetContent(configPath)
1727	if err != nil {
1728		return err
1729	}
1730
1731	config, err := parser.NewStringParser(string(nginxContent)).Parse()
1732	if err != nil {
1733		return err
1734	}
1735	config.FilePath = configPath
1736	servers := config.FindServers()
1737	if len(servers) == 0 {
1738		return errors.New("nginx config is not valid")
1739	}
1740	server := servers[0]
1741	if err := updateFunc(server); err != nil {
1742		return err
1743	}
1744	if err = nginx.WriteConfig(config, nginx.IndentedStyle); err != nil {
1745		return err
1746	}
1747	nginxInstall, err := getAppInstallByKey(constant.AppOpenresty)
1748	if err != nil {
1749		return err
1750	}
1751	return nginxCheckAndReload(string(nginxContent), configPath, nginxInstall.ContainerName)
1752}

1774func parseTimeString(input string) (int, string, error) {
1775	input = strings.TrimSpace(input)
1776
1777	matches := re.GetRegex(re.DurationWithOptionalUnitPattern).FindStringSubmatch(input)
1778
1779	if len(matches) < 2 {
1780		return 0, "", fmt.Errorf("invalid time format: %s", input)
1781	}
1782
1783	value, err := strconv.Atoi(matches[1])
1784	if err != nil {
1785		return 0, "", fmt.Errorf("invalid number: %s", matches[1])
1786	}
1787
1788	unit := matches[2]
1789	if unit == "" {
1790		unit = "s"
1791	}
1792	return value, unit, nil
1793}

1795func parseUpstreamServers(reqServers []dto.NginxUpstreamServer) []*components.UpstreamServer {
1796	var servers []*components.UpstreamServer
1797	for _, server := range reqServers {
1798		upstreamServer := &components.UpstreamServer{
1799			Address: server.Server,
1800		}
1801		parameters := make(map[string]string)
1802		if server.Weight > 0 {
1803			parameters["weight"] = strconv.Itoa(server.Weight)
1804		}
1805		if server.MaxFails > 0 {
1806			parameters["max_fails"] = strconv.Itoa(server.MaxFails)
1807		}
1808		if server.FailTimeout > 0 {
1809			parameters["fail_timeout"] = fmt.Sprintf("%d%s", server.FailTimeout, server.FailTimeoutUnit)
1810		}
1811		if server.MaxConns > 0 {
1812			parameters["max_conns"] = strconv.Itoa(server.MaxConns)
1813		}
1814		if server.Flag != "" {
1815			upstreamServer.Flags = []string{server.Flag}
1816		}
1817		upstreamServer.Parameters = parameters
1818		servers = append(servers, upstreamServer)
1819	}
1820	return servers
1821}

1823func getNginxUpstreamServers(upstreamServers []*components.UpstreamServer) []dto.NginxUpstreamServer {
1824	var servers []dto.NginxUpstreamServer
1825	for _, ups := range upstreamServers {
1826		server := dto.NginxUpstreamServer{
1827			Server: ups.Address,
1828		}
1829		parameters := ups.Parameters
1830		if weight, ok := parameters["weight"]; ok {
1831			num, err := strconv.Atoi(weight)
1832			if err == nil {
1833				server.Weight = num
1834			}
1835		}
1836		if maxFails, ok := parameters["max_fails"]; ok {
1837			num, err := strconv.Atoi(maxFails)
1838			if err == nil {
1839				server.MaxFails = num
1840			}
1841		}
1842		if failTimeout, ok := parameters["fail_timeout"]; ok {
1843			server.FailTimeout, server.FailTimeoutUnit, _ = parseTimeString(failTimeout)
1844		}
1845		if maxConns, ok := parameters["max_conns"]; ok {
1846			num, err := strconv.Atoi(maxConns)
1847			if err == nil {
1848				server.MaxConns = num
1849			}
1850		}
1851		for _, flag := range ups.Flags {
1852			server.Flag = flag
1853		}
1854		servers = append(servers, server)
1855	}
1856	return servers
1857}

1859func getManualWebsiteSSL(req request.WebsiteHTTPSOp) (model.WebsiteSSL, error) {
1860	var websiteSSL model.WebsiteSSL
1861	var (
1862		certificate string
1863		privateKey  string
1864	)
1865	switch req.ImportType {
1866	case "paste":
1867		certificate = req.Certificate
1868		privateKey = req.PrivateKey
1869	case "local":
1870		fileOp := files.NewFileOp()
1871		if !fileOp.Stat(req.PrivateKeyPath) {
1872			return websiteSSL, buserr.New("ErrSSLKeyNotFound")
1873		}
1874		if !fileOp.Stat(req.CertificatePath) {
1875			return websiteSSL, buserr.New("ErrSSLCertificateNotFound")
1876		}
1877		if content, err := fileOp.GetContent(req.PrivateKeyPath); err != nil {
1878			return websiteSSL, err
1879		} else {
1880			privateKey = string(content)
1881		}
1882		if content, err := fileOp.GetContent(req.CertificatePath); err != nil {
1883			return websiteSSL, err
1884		} else {
1885			certificate = string(content)
1886		}
1887	}
1888
1889	privateKeyCertBlock, _ := pem.Decode([]byte(privateKey))
1890	if privateKeyCertBlock == nil {
1891		return websiteSSL, buserr.New("ErrSSLKeyFormat")
1892	}
1893
1894	certBlock, _ := pem.Decode([]byte(certificate))
1895	if certBlock == nil {
1896		return websiteSSL, buserr.New("ErrSSLCertificateFormat")
1897	}
1898	cert, err := x509.ParseCertificate(certBlock.Bytes)
1899	if err != nil {
1900		return websiteSSL, err
1901	}
1902	websiteSSL.ExpireDate = cert.NotAfter
1903	websiteSSL.StartDate = cert.NotBefore
1904	websiteSSL.Type = cert.Issuer.CommonName
1905	if len(cert.Issuer.Organization) > 0 {
1906		websiteSSL.Organization = cert.Issuer.Organization[0]
1907	} else {
1908		websiteSSL.Organization = cert.Issuer.CommonName
1909	}
1910	if len(cert.DNSNames) > 0 {
1911		websiteSSL.PrimaryDomain = cert.DNSNames[0]
1912		websiteSSL.Domains = strings.Join(cert.DNSNames, ",")
1913	}
1914	websiteSSL.Provider = constant.Manual
1915	websiteSSL.PrivateKey = privateKey
1916	websiteSSL.Pem = certificate
1917	websiteSSL.Status = constant.SSLReady
1918	return websiteSSL, nil
1919}

  19func (a *NginxRouter) InitRouter(Router *gin.RouterGroup) {
